m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck. Add an onion, 3 garlic cloves, 2 chipotles in adobo and 2 tsp cumin, then 2 tins tomatoes and 2 tins kidney beans. Braise 3 hours. Serve with sour cream and squares of cornbread.

w.note: Cowboy hat and boot cookies in red and white icing
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Chill, roll and cut into cowboy hats and boots. Bake at 180C for 8 minutes. Ice with 300g icing sugar mixed with egg white, some tinted red, in cowgirl colours.

d.note: Sarsaparilla poured over vanilla ice cream until it foams
d.how: Put two scoops of vanilla ice cream in each of four tall glasses. Pour a 375ml can of sarsaparilla slowly down the side of each until it foams to the top. Serve with long spoons.

s.note: Chewy golden Anzac biscuits with oats, coconut and golden syrup
s.how: Mix 90g oats, 150g flour, 85g coconut and 150g brown sugar. Melt 125g butter with 2 tbsp golden syrup, then add 1 tsp bicarb dissolved in 2 tbsp boiling water. Stir together, roll into balls, flatten and bake at 160C for 15 minutes.

s.note: Hummus, baba ganoush, olives and warm flatbread with dukkah
s.how: Blitz a drained tin of chickpeas with 3 tbsp tahini, lemon, garlic and iced water until silky. Char an eggplant over a flame, scoop and mash with tahini and lemon. Serve with warm flatbreads, dukkah, olives, cucumber, paprika and olive oil.

m.note: Garlic rosemary roast lamb with pumpkin, peas and gravy
m.how: Stud a 2kg lamb leg with garlic and rosemary and roast at 180C until 58C inside. Rest 20 minutes. Roast 800g potatoes and 600g pumpkin alongside. Cook 300g peas and make gravy from the pan juices.

w.note: Puffy dumplings simmered in golden syrup sauce
w.how: Rub 30g butter into 150g self-raising flour and mix in 100ml milk to a soft dough. Bring 375ml water, 100g brown sugar, 3 tbsp golden syrup and 30g butter to a simmer. Drop in spoonfuls of dough, cover and cook 20 minutes. Serve with cream.

d.note: Strong billy tea in tin mugs with plenty of sugar
d.how: Boil 1.2L water in a billy or pot. Add 3 tbsp loose leaf tea, boil for a minute and swing to settle. Pour into tin mugs with milk and plenty of sugar.

s.note: Little cinnamon apple pies to welcome the new sheriff
s.how: Cook 3 diced Granny Smiths with 30g butter, 3 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon until soft and cool. Line a 12-hole tin with rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust, fill and lid with a third sheet. Egg wash and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

s.note: Bourbon brown sugar roasted peanuts and pecans
s.how: Melt 40g butter with 3 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tbsp bourbon. Toss with 200g peanuts and 150g pecans. Roast at 160C for 20 minutes, stirring once. Cool on the tray.

m.note: Smoky chuck wagon beans with bacon, molasses and cornbread.
m.how: Fry 200g diced bacon and 1 onion in a heavy pot until golden. Add 2 cans drained pinto beans, 400g crushed tomatoes, 3 tbsp molasses, 1 tbsp mustard, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 250ml water. Simmer 40 minutes until thick. Serve in tin bowls with squares of cornbread made from a 400g packet mix.

w.note: Peach and blackberry cobbler with a sugared biscuit top
w.how: Toss 4 sliced peaches and 250g blackberries with 80g sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour, add 150ml milk and drop over the fruit. Sprinkle with raw sugar and bake at 190C for 40 minutes. Serve with cream.

d.note: Sarsaparilla on ice, or bourbon for the cowboys
d.how: Pour four 375ml cans of sarsaparilla over plenty of ice in tall glasses and serve straight away. For the cowboys, pour 45ml bourbon over ice in a short glass instead, and keep the beans away from the campfire.

s.note: Iced gingerbread men, crisp edges and soft middles.
s.how: Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 120g golden syrup. Stir into 375g flour, 1 tsp bicarbonate of soda and 3 tsp ground ginger with 1 egg. Chill 30 minutes, roll 5mm thick and cut 20 men. Bake at 180C for 9 minutes, cool and pipe buttons with 100g icing sugar mixed with lemon juice.

s.note: White chocolate popcorn with red and green sprinkles
s.how: Pop 100g kernels and spread on a lined tray. Drizzle with 150g melted white chocolate and toss. Scatter red and green sprinkles and a pinch of flaky salt before it sets. Break into clusters.

m.note: Creamy beef and mushroom bake under crisp tater tots
m.how: Brown 600g beef mince with an onion and 200g mushrooms. Stir in 250ml cream and simmer until thick. Tip into a dish, cover with 500g frozen tater tots and 100g cheddar and bake at 200C for 30 minutes until crisp.

w.note: Dark and white chocolate bark with crushed candy canes
w.how: Spread 200g melted dark chocolate thin on a lined tray and set. Melt 200g white chocolate with a drop of peppermint extract and spread over. Scatter crushed candy canes, set again and break into shards.

d.note: Homemade eggnog with nutmeg, brandy for adults
d.how: Whisk 4 yolks with 80g sugar. Pour over 500ml hot milk and 200ml cream, then stir over low heat to 75C. Chill well, grate nutmeg on top and add a splash of brandy to the grown-ups' glasses.

s.note: Little stacked pancakes with butter and maple syrup
s.how: Whisk 200g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tbsp sugar, 300ml buttermilk and 1 egg and rest 15 minutes. Cook small rounds in butter until bubbles set. Stack in threes with butter and maple syrup.

s.note: Crisp golden hash brown cakes fried in butter until deep golden
s.how: Grate 800g potatoes and a small onion, squeeze dry and season with fine salt. Press into flat cakes and fry in 40g butter and a little oil for 5 minutes a side until deep golden.

m.note: Seared rump in a roll with buttery onions and provolone
m.how: Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in 30g butter until golden. Sear 2 rump steaks, rest and slice. Pile into 4 toasted rolls with the onions, 4 slices provolone and mayo mixed with 1 tbsp horseradish.

w.note: Tangy lemon filling under a tall toasted meringue
w.how: Blind bake a 23cm sweet shortcrust case at 180C for 20 minutes. Cook 300ml water, 200g sugar, 40g cornflour, the juice and zest of 3 lemons and 4 egg yolks until thick, add 40g butter and pour in. Whisk 4 egg whites with 200g sugar to stiff peaks, pile on top and bake 12 minutes until golden.

d.note: Strong drip coffee refilled until someone says stop
d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water in a drip machine. Pour into thick mugs with milk and sugar on the table. Keep refilling until someone says stop, and everyone tips.

s.note: Crisp cornmeal calamari strips with tartare and lemon
s.how: Cut 500g calamari into strips and soak in 200ml buttermilk for 20 minutes. Dredge in 100g cornmeal mixed with 50g flour and fry at 185C for 90 seconds. Serve with tartare and lemon wedges.

s.note: Smoked trout dip served in a little bucket
s.how: Flake 200g hot-smoked trout into 150g cream cheese and 100g sour cream with lemon juice, chopped dill and a little horseradish. Spoon into a small bucket and serve with crackers.

m.note: Buttered toasted rolls full of lemony lobster, with chips
m.how: Chop 400g cooked lobster meat and fold with 3 tbsp mayo, lemon juice, a finely diced celery stick and chives. Butter and toast 4 split hot dog buns and fill. Fry 800g potato chips twice and serve alongside.

w.note: Hot fudge sundae with a dark chocolate shark fin
w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate with 100ml cream, then spread 50g of it into fin shapes on baking paper and chill. Scoop vanilla and chocolate ice cream into bowls, pour over the fudge and top with cream, peanuts and a fin.

d.note: Ice-cold lager drunk straight from the can
d.how: Chill eight 375ml cans of American lager for at least three hours. Crush the empties in one hand if you can manage it. You're going to need a bigger esky.

s.note: Buttermilk fried drumsticks, served before midnight
s.how: Brine 1kg chicken drumsticks overnight in 400ml buttermilk and 2 tbsp hot sauce. Dredge twice in 250g flour with 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder and white pepper. Fry at 165C until 75C at the bone. Serve well before 12.

s.note: Little gingerbread houses piped with white icing like snowy rooftops
s.how: Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 100g golden syrup. Stir in 300g flour, 2 tsp ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon and half a tsp bicarb. Chill an hour, roll and cut into little houses. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes and pipe with 200g icing sugar.

m.note: Lamb mince and carrot under golden buttery mash.
m.how: Brown 800g lamb mince with 1 diced onion and 2 diced carrots. Add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and 250ml beef stock and simmer for 20 minutes. Top with mash made from 1kg potatoes, 50g butter and 100ml milk, then bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.note: Marshmallow-frosted cupcakes rolled in coconut like little snowballs
w.how: Bake 12 cupcakes from 125g butter, 150g sugar, 2 eggs and 200g self-raising flour at 175C for 18 minutes. Whisk 2 whites, then pour in 150g sugar boiled with 50ml water to 118C and beat until thick. Dome on top and roll in 100g coconut.

d.note: Sparkling water with citrus, kept well away from anything furry
d.how: Fill four glasses with ice and slices of lemon and lime. Pour over chilled sparkling water. Keep the jug well away from anything furry and don't spill a drop.

s.note: Warm salty Cajun boiled peanuts in paper cups
s.how: Simmer 500g raw peanuts in the shell for 2 hours in water with 80g salt and 1 tbsp Cajun seasoning. Turn off the heat and soak an hour. Drain and serve warm in paper cups.

s.note: Garlic dill pickled okra with sharp cheddar
s.how: Pack 400g okra into a jar with 3 garlic cloves, dill and a chilli. Pour over 300ml hot white vinegar boiled with 200ml water and 1 tbsp salt. Pickle a week. Serve cold with 200g sharp cheddar.

m.note: Crumbed minute steak smothered in pepper cream gravy
m.how: Pound 4 minute steaks thin. Dredge in seasoned flour, then buttermilk, then flour again and fry until crisp. Whisk 2 tbsp flour into the pan fat, add 400ml milk and lots of cracked pepper and simmer. Serve over mash.

w.note: Brown sugar peach cobbler with vanilla ice cream
w.how: Toss 6 sliced peaches with 80g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and lemon juice. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour, add 150ml milk and drop over the fruit. Bake at 190C for 40 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: Cold lager from the esky, iced tea for drivers
d.how: Bury eight 355ml bottles of light American lager in an esky of ice for an hour. Brew 4 black tea bags in 1L water, sweeten and chill over ice for anyone doing the Atlanta run in 28 hours.

s.note: Green cornflake wreaths with red lolly berries
s.how: Melt 50g butter with 200g marshmallows and a few drops of green colouring. Stir through 120g corn flakes until coated. Shape spoonfuls into little wreaths on baking paper and press on red lollies as berries. Set for an hour.

s.note: A tall mountain of cheese, grapes and crackers with green dip.
s.how: Cube 200g vintage cheddar and 200g gouda and stack them with 300g grapes into a tall peak on a board. Lean 1 box crackers around the base and serve with 200g sour cream blended with a bunch of parsley, salt and lemon.

m.note: Rib roast carved at the table with Yorkshires and gravy
m.how: Season a 2kg beef rib roast overnight. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C inside and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C for 20 minutes. Make gravy with 400ml stock.

w.note: Fruit loaf bread and butter pudding in vanilla custard
w.how: Butter 8 slices fruit loaf and layer in a dish. Whisk 4 eggs, 400ml milk, 200ml cream, 60g sugar and vanilla and pour over. Rest 20 minutes, then bake at 170C for 40 minutes until puffed and golden.

d.note: Frothing green lime sorbet punch, as green as the Grinch himself
d.how: Scoop 500ml lime sorbet into a punch bowl. Pour over 1L lemonade and 250ml pineapple juice so it froths up green. Add lime slices and ladle into cups.

s.note: Steamed pork and prawn siu mai with a dot of roe
s.how: Mix 300g pork mince, 150g chopped prawns, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 3 chopped shiitake and 1 tbsp soy. Spoon into 24 wonton wrappers, pinch up the sides and steam 8 minutes. Top each with a dot of roe.

s.note: Crisp oatcakes with crème fraîche and smoked salmon
s.how: Mix 200g oats with 50g melted butter, salt and a splash of hot water. Press thin, cut rounds and bake at 180C for 20 minutes. Top with crème fraîche, 150g smoked salmon, dill and lemon.

m.note: Juniper venison with whisky redcurrant sauce, neeps and potatoes
m.how: Rub 800g venison backstrap with crushed juniper, thyme and pepper. Sear to rare and rest. Add 60ml whisky, 2 tbsp redcurrant jelly and 150ml stock to the pan and reduce. Mash 600g swede with butter. Roast 800g potatoes.

w.note: Honey whisky cream layered with raspberries and toasted oats
w.how: Toast 60g oats in a dry pan until nutty. Whip 400ml cream with 3 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp whisky. Lightly crush 300g raspberries. Layer cream, raspberries and oats in four glasses, finishing with oats on top.

d.note: Single malt neat with a few drops of water
d.how: Pour 30ml good single malt Scotch into each of four tumblers. Add a few drops of water to open it up. Sip it slowly by the fire.

s.note: Fluffy steamed char siu pork buns
s.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 2 tbsp sugar and 220ml warm water and prove an hour. Chop 300g char siu pork with 2 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp hoisin and 1 tsp sugar. Fill 12 rounds of dough, pleat shut, prove 20 minutes and steam 12 minutes.

s.note: Puffed fried dough sticks with warm soy milk
s.how: Mix 300g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp salt and 200ml water, knead briefly and rest overnight in the fridge. Cut strips, press two together, stretch and fry at 190C until puffed and golden. Serve with warm soy milk.

m.n: Axe Gang salt and pepper pork
m.note: Crisp salt and pepper pork belly tossed with chilli and garlic
m.how: Cut 800g pork belly into strips and toss in 100g potato starch. Fry at 180C until crisp. Wok-toss with 4 sliced garlic cloves, 2 chillies, spring onion and 1 tsp Sichuan pepper ground with salt. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.

w.note: Chilled coconut sago with fresh mango
w.how: Boil 100g sago for 15 minutes until clear, rinse and chill. Mix with 400ml coconut milk and 3 tbsp sugar. Blitz 1 ripe mango and dice another. Spoon the sago into glasses and top with mango purée and cubes.

d.note: Lightly sweet chrysanthemum tea, warm or iced
d.how: Steep 15g dried chrysanthemum flowers in 1L hot water with 50g rock sugar for 5 minutes. Strain and serve warm in cups, or chill and pour over ice.

s.note: Rum eggnog with fresh nutmeg, served in the moose mugs
s.how: Whisk 4 yolks with 80g sugar. Pour over 500ml hot milk and 200ml cream and stir over low heat to 75C. Chill overnight, then stir in 80ml dark rum and grate fresh nutmeg on top.

s.note: Charred kielbasa with buttery onions and grainy mustard
s.how: Slice 500g kielbasa thick on the diagonal and griddle until charred. Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in 30g butter until soft. Toss together with 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard and spear on toothpicks.

m.note: Dry-brined turkey breast roast with stuffing and gravy, carved at the table.
m.how: Rub a 1.5kg turkey breast roast with 1 tbsp sea salt flakes and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Push 50g soft butter and thyme under the skin and roast at 170C until it hits 65C inside, about 75 minutes. Rest 20 minutes under foil. Make 200g stuffing mix and a gravy from the pan juices with 1 tbsp flour and 375ml chicken stock.

w.note: Toasted pecan pie in a crisp pastry case
w.how: Blind-bake a tin lined with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust. Whisk 3 eggs, 250ml golden syrup, 100g brown sugar, 60g melted butter and vanilla. Stir in 200g toasted pecans, pour in and bake at 170C for 50 minutes until just set.

d.note: Frothy hot chocolate topped with marshmallows
d.how: Heat 1L full cream milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate until frothy. Pour into four mugs and pile marshmallows on top. Drink it before the sled run.

s.note: Shaved steak and onions under melted provolone in mini rolls
s.how: Freeze a 400g rib eye for 30 minutes and shave thin. Sear on a hot plate with a sliced onion. Lay over 6 slices provolone to melt, then pile into 12 mini rolls.

s.note: Salami, prosciutto, provolone and antipasti with crusty bread
s.how: Arrange 100g salami, 100g prosciutto and 150g provolone on a board. Add a jar of drained artichoke hearts, olives and roasted capsicum. Serve with a crusty loaf torn into pieces.

m.note: Peppered butter-basted sirloin with roast potatoes
m.how: Dry-brine 4 sirloins overnight and season with cracked pepper. Sear in a smoking cast iron pan, flipping every minute. Baste with 40g butter, garlic and thyme and pull at 54C. Rest and serve with 1kg roast potatoes.

w.note: Pecan caramel chocolate clusters shaped like turtles
w.how: Toast 150g pecans and arrange in clusters of 4 on baking paper. Melt 200g caramels with 2 tbsp cream and spoon onto each cluster. Top with 100g melted dark chocolate and set.

d.note: Banana peanut butter oat shake, no raw eggs
d.how: Blend 2 ripe bananas, 800ml cold milk, 2 tbsp peanut butter, 40g oats and a spoon of honey until thick. Pour into four glasses. Skip the raw eggs, Rocky.

s.note: Smoky salted peanuts in paper cones
s.how: Spread 400g peanuts in the shell on a tray and roast at 180C for 20 minutes. Toss hot with flaky salt and a little smoked paprika. Roll paper into cones and fill them up.

s.note: Crunchy salted caramel popcorn baked low, big top style
s.how: Pop 120g kernels. Boil 150g brown sugar, 80g butter and 3 tbsp golden syrup for 4 minutes, then stir in half a tsp bicarb and a pinch of salt. Pour over, toss and bake at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15.

m.note: Roast sirloin with Yorkshires, potatoes and red wine gravy
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg sirloin at 200C until 52C inside and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C for 20 minutes. Reduce 200ml red wine with the pan juices for gravy.

w.note: Red velvet layer cake with cream cheese frosting and gold
w.how: Beat 125g butter and 250g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, 250ml buttermilk and red colouring. Bake in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Layer and cover with 250g cream cheese beaten with 250g icing sugar. Add gold sprinkles.

d.note: Champagne in coupes, sparkling apple for the kids
d.how: Chill a 750ml bottle of champagne and a 750ml bottle of sparkling apple juice. Pour into coupes, bubbles for the grown-ups and apple for the younger crowd. Raise them to the show.

s.note: Crisp seed and oat crackers broken into shards
s.how: Mix 50g each sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds, 30g linseeds, 30g chia seeds and 100g oats with 250ml water and salt. Rest 30 minutes, spread thin on a lined tray and bake at 160C for an hour. Break into shards.

s.note: Blackened spiced chicken skewers with garlic yoghurt
s.how: Cut 600g chicken thighs into strips and rub with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin and chilli flakes. Thread onto skewers and grill hot until blackened at the edges. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with a crushed garlic clove to dip.

m.note: Slow-roasted harissa lamb with flatbreads, hummus and capsicum
m.how: Rub a 1.8kg lamb shoulder with 3 tbsp harissa, garlic and cumin. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Blitz a tin of chickpeas into hummus. Char 2 red capsicums. Serve with 6 blistered flatbreads.

w.note: Chewy date, oat and almond bars under dark chocolate
w.how: Blitz 250g medjool dates, 100g oats, 100g almonds and 2 tbsp honey until sticky. Press into a lined tray. Pour over 150g melted dark chocolate, sprinkle with sea salt and chill to set. Cut into bars.

d.note: Big jugs of iced water with lime, cucumber and mint
d.how: Fill two big jugs with ice, sliced lime, cucumber ribbons and mint. Top with 2L cold water. Pour freely for everyone, the way the Citadel never does.

s.note: Charred corn with lime mayo, feta and chilli
s.how: Grill 4 corn cobs until charred. Brush with 4 tbsp mayo mixed with lime juice. Roll in 100g crumbled feta and dust with chilli powder and chopped coriander.

s.note: Charred tomatillo green salsa with warm chips
s.how: Char 400g tomatillos and 2 green chillies under the grill. Blitz with half an onion, a garlic clove, coriander and lime juice until chunky. Serve with warm corn chips.

m.note: Achiote pulled pork tacos with pickled onion
m.how: Marinate 1.2kg pork shoulder in 50g achiote paste, the juice of 2 oranges and 3 garlic cloves overnight. Wrap and roast at 160C for 4 hours, then shred. Quick-pickle a red onion in lime. Serve in 16 corn tortillas with habanero salsa.

w.note: Cinnamon sugar churros with dulce de leche and a candle
w.how: Boil 250ml water with 60g butter, beat in 150g flour, then 2 eggs. Pipe into 180C oil and fry until golden. Toss in 100g sugar and 2 tsp cinnamon. Serve with dulce de leche for dipping and a candle in the pile.

d.note: Salt-rimmed tequila margaritas shaken with fresh lime and orange liqueur
d.how: For each drink, shake 45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml lime juice with ice. Strain into a glass with a salted rim. Makes four plethoras of margaritas.

s.note: Devilled eggs, smoked salmon rye and sticky cocktail franks
s.how: Boil 6 eggs, halve and pipe with yolks whipped with mayo. Top buttered rye squares with 100g smoked salmon. Glaze 16 cocktail franks in a pan with 2 tbsp brown sugar and a splash of water. Serve on silver trays.

s.note: Honey cumin roasted baby carrots with whipped feta
s.how: Toss 2 bunches baby carrots with 2 tbsp honey, 1 tsp cumin, thyme and oil. Roast at 200C for 25 minutes until caramelised. Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt for the dip.

m.note: Hot pastrami and Swiss on rye with a pickle
m.how: Steam 400g pastrami for 10 minutes until glossy. Pile onto 8 slices rye with mustard and 4 slices Swiss cheese. Grill until the cheese melts. Serve each with a dill pickle on the side.

w.note: Red velvet layer cake with a glossy red glaze
w.how: Beat 125g butter and 250g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, 250ml buttermilk and red colouring. Bake in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Layer with cream cheese frosting and pour a glossy red icing over the top.

d.note: Rye whisky neat or on the rocks, none for Roger
d.how: Pour 45ml rye whisky into each of four heavy glasses, neat or over a few cubes of ice, and sip it slowly at the desk. Whatever happens, do not give one to Roger, because he cannot handle it.

s.note: Long lean crudités with blue cheese dip
s.how: Cut a cucumber, 3 celery sticks, 2 carrots and radishes into long lean sticks and stand them in a glass on ice. Mash 100g blue cheese into 200g sour cream with lemon, Worcestershire and black pepper.

s.note: Cold cucumber rounds with lemon goat's cheese and salmon
s.how: Cut 2 cucumbers into thick rounds. Whip 150g goat's cheese with lemon zest and pipe on top. Add a curl of smoked salmon from 100g and a dill frond. Keep very cold.

m.note: Creamy vodka rigatoni so hot right now
m.how: Sauté 2 garlic cloves and chilli in 40g butter. Fry 4 tbsp tomato paste until brick red, add 60ml vodka and cook off, then 250ml cream. Toss with 500g rigatoni cooked 2 minutes short, 50g parmesan and basil.

w.note: A proper cake and a tiny teacup cake for the ants
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour and 100ml milk. Bake most in a tin and a little in a teacup at 175C, about 30 and 15 minutes. Cover both in 200g butter beaten with 350g icing sugar.

d.note: Shaken orange mocha iced coffee over ice
d.how: Brew 4 double espressos with 72g coffee. Melt 60g dark chocolate into the hot coffee with orange zest. Shake with 400ml cold milk and ice, then strain over more ice in four tall glasses.

s.note: Puffed pork crackling with chilli lime salt
s.how: Score 600g pork rind, salt and dry uncovered overnight. Roast at 240C for 30 minutes until puffed and crackling. Break up and dust with flaky salt mixed with chilli powder and lime zest.

s.note: Chunky guacamole with serrano and warm chips
s.how: Smash 3 avocados with the juice of 2 limes, finely chopped white onion, a seeded green chilli, coriander and salt. Serve with warm corn chips.

m.note: Chilli pineapple pork tacos with onion and coriander
m.how: Blitz 3 soaked dried chillies, 50g achiote, 200g pineapple and 2 tbsp vinegar and marinate 1.2kg sliced pork shoulder overnight. Roast at 200C for 40 minutes, then slice and crisp in a pan. Serve in 16 small tortillas with pineapple, white onion and coriander.

w.note: Three-milk soaked sponge with cream and cinnamon
w.how: Whisk 5 eggs with 200g sugar until thick and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake at 175C for 25 minutes. Prick all over and pour over 395g condensed milk, 375ml evaporated milk and 125ml milk. Soak overnight and top with 300ml whipped cream and cinnamon.

d.note: Mezcal with chilli salt oranges, or lager and lime
d.how: Pour 30ml mezcal neat into each of four small glasses. Serve with orange wedges dusted in chilli salt. For anyone else, hand over a cold Mexican lager with lime.

s.n: Choose your fate chip and dip
s.note: Three dips from mild to very hot, choose wisely
s.how: Mix 150g sour cream with chives. Blitz a roasted red capsicum with 100g sour cream and smoked paprika. Blitz 2 tomatoes with a habanero and salt. Line them up mild to hot with a 300g bag of corn chips.

s.note: Strong stakeout coffee with warm glazed doughnuts.
s.how: Brew 1L strong filter coffee from 60g ground coffee and keep it hot in a thermos. Warm 8 glazed doughnuts for 10 seconds each so the glaze softens. Serve the coffee black with milk on the side.

m.note: Lemon thyme roast chicken with potatoes and beans
m.how: Rub a 1.8kg chicken with butter, lemon and thyme. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 180C for 50 minutes with 1kg potatoes. Rest and make gravy with 300ml stock. Steam 300g green beans.

w.note: Red velvet cupcakes with a cream cheese spiral
w.how: Beat 125g butter and 200g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, 200ml buttermilk and red colouring. Bake 12 at 175C for 18 minutes. Pipe 250g cream cheese beaten with 250g icing sugar in a spiral.

d.note: Sweet mint lemonade or sharp sugar-free lime soda
d.how: Make one jug with the juice of 4 lemons, 120g sugar syrup and mint, topped with cold water. Make the other with the juice of 4 limes and soda water, no sugar. Let everyone choose.

s.note: Baked brie wheel with honey, thyme and walnuts
s.how: Score the top of a 500g brie wheel. Drizzle with 2 tbsp honey, scatter thyme and 50g walnuts and bake at 180C for 15 minutes until molten. Serve with crackers. Baxter would approve.

s.note: Crisp fries loaded with chopped grilled steak, cheese and guacamole.
s.how: Marinate 500g skirt steak in juice of 2 limes, 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin for 1 hour, grill hot 3 minutes a side and chop. Bake 750g frozen fries until crisp, cover with 150g grated Monterey Jack and grill to melt. Top with the steak, 1 mashed avocado and 100g sour cream.

m.note: Beer-battered fish tacos with lime crema
m.how: Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager. Dip 500g flathead strips and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g sour cream with lime. Serve in 12 warm tortillas with shredded cabbage, pico de gallo and the crema. Stay classy.

w.n: Milk was a bad choice ice cream
w.note: Vanilla milk ice cream, eaten slowly in small bowls
w.how: Warm 500ml milk and 300ml cream with a split vanilla bean. Whisk 5 yolks with 120g sugar, pour over and cook to 82C. Chill overnight and churn. Serve in small bowls, never chugged.

d.note: Blended Scotch over one big cube
d.how: Put one big ice cube in each of four heavy tumblers. Pour 45ml blended Scotch over each and swirl gently. Sip it slowly in a leather chair, surrounded by many leather-bound books, and keep the bottle handy.

s.note: Sharp vegetable teeth with a green goddess dip
s.how: Cut a cucumber, 2 carrots and a red capsicum into sharp triangles like teeth, with 200g sugar snap peas. Blitz 200g sour cream with parsley, lemon and a garlic clove. Fish are friends, not food.

s.note: Fairy bread cut into little fish shapes
s.how: Spread 8 slices fresh white bread with soft butter right to the edges. Press face down into hundreds and thousands. Cut into little fish with a cutter and serve straight away.

m.note: Golden crumbed chicken schnitzel with chips and salad.
m.how: Halve 2 large chicken breasts into 4 thin fillets. Dip in flour, 2 beaten eggs and 2 cups panko crumbs. Shallow fry in oil for 4 minutes a side until golden. Serve with lemon wedges, oven-baked chips and a green salad.

w.note: Orange and white striped ice blocks
w.how: Mix 400ml fresh orange juice with 2 tbsp honey. Freeze a layer in moulds for 40 minutes, then a layer of 200g vanilla yoghurt, then orange again. Add sticks after the second layer. Freeze 6 hours.

d.note: Pineapple coconut mocktail with a blue swirl
d.how: Fill four glasses with crushed ice. Pour in 150ml pineapple juice and 100ml coconut water each, then add a splash of blue raspberry cordial. Garnish with a pineapple wedge.

s.note: Lemony tuna on crisp cucumber rounds
s.how: Mix a 185g tin of tuna with 2 tbsp mayo, a finely diced celery stick, a spring onion and lemon juice. Spoon onto thick cucumber rounds and finish with dill and black pepper. Keep it away from the cat.

s.note: Tangy devilled eggs with paprika and chives
s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes and halve. Whip the yolks with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon and a splash of pickle juice. Pipe back and finish with smoked paprika and chives.

m.note: Herb-crusted salmon with new potatoes and asparagus
m.how: Mix 50g breadcrumbs with dill, parsley and lemon zest. Press onto 4 salmon fillets and roast at 200C for 10 minutes. Boil 800g new potatoes and toss with herbs. Steam 2 bunches asparagus.

w.note: Silky lemon tart dusted with icing sugar
w.how: Blind-bake a tart tin lined with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust. Whisk the juice and zest of 4 lemons, 4 eggs, 150g sugar and 150ml cream. Pour in and bake at 140C for 30 minutes until just set. Chill and dust with icing sugar.

d.note: Cold milk or a malted vanilla shake
d.how: Pour 1L ice-cold full cream milk into four tall glasses. For a malted shake, blend each with a scoop of vanilla ice cream and a spoon of malted milk powder. Can you milk me, Greg?

s.note: Fried tortilla chips with rough charred salsa roja
s.how: Cut 12 corn tortillas into wedges and fry at 180C until crisp, then salt. Char 4 tomatoes, 2 soaked dried chillies, 2 garlic cloves and half a white onion. Blitz rough with salt.

s.note: Charred corn rolled in lime mayo, feta and chilli
s.how: Grill 4 corn cobs until charred. Brush with 4 tbsp mayo mixed with lime juice. Roll in 100g crumbled feta and dust with chilli powder and chopped coriander.

m.note: Slow-roasted achiote pork with pickled onion and tortillas
m.how: Marinate 1.2kg pork shoulder overnight in 50g achiote paste, the juice of 2 oranges and 2 limes, 4 garlic cloves, cumin and oregano. Wrap in banana leaves and foil and roast at 160C for 4 hours. Shred and serve with pickled red onion and tortillas.

w.note: Chocolate cinnamon flan turned out under a dark caramel
w.how: Melt 150g sugar to caramel and pour into 4 ramekins. Warm 400ml milk and 100ml cream with 80g dark chocolate and cinnamon. Whisk into 4 eggs and 80g sugar, pour over and bake in a water bath at 150C for 40 minutes. Chill and turn out.

d.note: Blanco tequila with an orange, lime and tomato chaser
d.how: Mix 200ml orange juice, the juice of a lime, 100ml tomato juice and a pinch of chilli powder for sangrita. Pour 30ml blanco tequila into each of four glasses with a sangrita chaser alongside.

s.note: Golden boardwalk corn dogs on sticks with yellow mustard
s.how: Whisk 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk. Pat 8 franks dry and push onto sticks. Dip and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until golden. Serve with mustard.

s.note: Identical cheese stacks mirrored on each side of the plate
s.how: Build stacks of cracker, a slice of sharp cheddar, a thin apple slice and a dot of fig jam, using 200g cheddar and 2 apples. Put two identical stacks on each side of every plate, mirrored exactly.

m.note: Smoky glazed chicken and corn with coleslaw and rolls
m.how: Grill 1kg chicken thighs and 4 corn cobs over coals, brushing the chicken with 150ml barbecue sauce in the last minutes. Shred a quarter cabbage with mayo. Serve with 4 soft rolls.

w.note: Walnut carrot cake with lemony cream cheese frosting
w.how: Mix 300g grated carrot, 100g walnuts, 200ml oil, 200g brown sugar, 3 eggs, cinnamon and nutmeg. Fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake at 170C for 50 minutes. Frost with 250g cream cheese, 200g icing sugar and lemon zest.

d.note: Pineapple orange grenadine punch with lemonade
d.how: Pour 500ml pineapple juice and 500ml orange juice into a big bowl with ice. Add 60ml grenadine and top with 750ml lemonade. Float orange slices on top and hold hands while you drink it.

s.note: Prawn cucumber rounds, ricotta crostini and prosciutto figs
s.how: Top cucumber rounds with 200g cooked prawns and lemon mayo. Toast baguette slices and top with ricotta whipped with honey. Wrap 6 halved figs in 100g prosciutto. Serve on silver trays.

s.note: Parmesan garlic popcorn for the top and bottom bunk
s.how: Pop 150g kernels and toss with 60g melted butter, 40g grated parmesan, garlic powder and fine salt. Split between two big bowls, one for each bunk.

m.note: Roast snapper with lemon capers, new potatoes and salad
m.how: Lay 4 snapper fillets in a dish with lemon slices, 2 sliced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp capers and olive oil. Roast at 200C for 12 minutes. Boil 800g new potatoes and toss with herbs. Serve with dressed salad leaves.

w.note: Build-your-own sundae bar with hot fudge and toppings
w.how: Put tubs of vanilla and chocolate ice cream on ice. Melt 150g dark chocolate into 150ml cream for hot fudge. Set out sprinkles, 200ml whipped cream and cherries so everyone builds their own.

d.note: Rosé and white wine on ice in a big tub
d.how: Bury a 750ml bottle of rosé and a 750ml bottle of crisp white wine in a big tub of ice for 30 minutes. Pour generously into plastic wine glasses. Welcome to the Catalina Wine Mixer.

s.note: Roasted mushrooms stuffed with gruyère, thyme and garlic
s.how: Remove the stems from 8 Swiss brown mushrooms. Fill with 120g grated gruyère mixed with thyme and a crushed garlic clove. Drizzle with oil and roast at 220C for 12 minutes until bubbling.

s.note: Silky leek and potato soup with chives
s.how: Sweat 2 sliced leeks in 40g butter for 10 minutes. Add 2 diced potatoes and 1L stock and simmer 20 minutes. Blend silky with 100ml cream and finish with chives and white pepper. Anyone can cook.

m.note: Slow-baked spiral of thin-sliced summer vegetables
m.how: Soften a red capsicum, an onion, 2 garlic cloves and 2 tomatoes into a sauce and spread in a dish. Slice 2 zucchini, an eggplant, 2 yellow squash and 3 tomatoes thin and layer in a spiral. Drizzle with thyme oil, cover and bake at 140C for 2 hours.

w.note: Vanilla crème brûlée torched to a crack
w.how: Warm 600ml cream with a split vanilla bean. Whisk 6 yolks with 80g sugar and pour the cream over. Pour into 4 ramekins and bake in a water bath at 150C for 35 minutes. Chill, then sprinkle with sugar and torch until it cracks.

d.note: Decanted Bordeaux red, grape juice for the kids
d.how: Open a 750ml bottle of Bordeaux red blend and decant an hour before dinner. Pour into big glasses for the critics, and red grape juice for the kids.

s.note: Chewy caramel peanut bars coated in milk chocolate
s.how: Boil 150g brown sugar, 3 tbsp golden syrup and 80g butter for 3 minutes. Stir in 250g roasted peanuts and press into a lined tray. Pour over 150g melted milk chocolate and chill. Cut into bars.

s.note: Mini banh mi with pâté, char siu and pickled veg
s.how: Quick-pickle a carrot and some daikon in vinegar and sugar. Split 2 small baguettes, spread with 100g pork pâté and fill with 200g char siu, pickles, cucumber, coriander and chilli. Cut into bites.

m.note: Green chicken curry with Thai eggplant and basil
m.how: Fry 3 tbsp green curry paste in the thick top of 800ml coconut milk until it splits. Add 800g sliced chicken thighs, the rest of the coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar and Thai eggplant. Simmer 15 minutes and add Thai basil. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.

w.note: Coconut sticky rice with ripe mango
w.how: Soak 300g glutinous rice overnight, then steam 25 minutes. Stir in 250ml warm coconut milk with 60g sugar and salt and rest 20 minutes. Serve with 2 sliced mangoes, a spoon of salty coconut cream and sesame seeds.

d.note: Passionfruit lime ginger soda with mint
d.how: Simmer 100g sugar, 100ml water and sliced ginger for 5 minutes and cool. Mix with the pulp of 4 passionfruit and juice of 2 limes. Top with soda over ice and add mint.

s.note: Griddled corn cakes stuffed with melting cheese
s.how: Mix 300g pre-cooked white cornmeal with 500ml warm water and salt into a soft dough. Shape 8 patties and cook on a buttered pan for 5 minutes a side. Split and stuff with 200g sliced mozzarella.

s.note: Crisp corn empanadas of spiced beef and potato with green sauce
s.how: Fry 300g beef mince with a diced potato and 1 tsp cumin until cooked and cool. Mix 250g arepa flour with 350ml warm water and salt. Flatten balls of dough, fill, fold and crimp. Fry at 180C until crisp. Blitz coriander, a green chilli, lime and oil for sauce.

m.note: Hearty chicken soup with corn, potato, cassava and plantain
m.how: Simmer 1kg chicken thighs in 2.5L water with an onion and 2 garlic cloves for 30 minutes. Add 3 corn cobs cut in chunks, 500g potatoes, 400g cassava and a green plantain and simmer an hour until thick. Finish with coriander. Serve with rice and avocado.

w.note: Bright green lime jelly turned out with coconut cream
w.how: Soak 6 gelatine leaves. Heat 300ml water with 150g sugar, stir in the gelatine, then add 250ml fresh lime juice and a drop of green colouring if you like. Set in a mould for 4 hours. Turn out and serve with chilled coconut cream and mint.

d.note: Strong coffee with raw sugar, or iced with milk
d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water so it's strong. Sweeten with raw sugar and pour into mugs, or cool it and pour over ice with cold milk for the jungle heat.

s.note: Crisp-bottomed pork and cabbage potstickers with vinegar dip
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with 2 cups shredded wombok, salted and squeezed, and 1 tbsp grated ginger. Fill 30 gyoza wrappers and pleat. Fry until browned, add water and steam under a lid for 4 minutes. Dip in soy and Chinkiang vinegar.

s.note: Oven-baked nachos with beans, cheese, salsa and sour cream
s.how: Layer a 300g bag of corn chips with a drained tin of black beans, 200g grated cheddar and sliced jalapeños. Bake in the oven at 200C for 8 minutes, not the microwave. Top with diced tomato and 150g sour cream.

m.note: Pastrami piled high on rye with a pickle and potato salad
m.how: Steam 500g pastrami for 10 minutes until soft. Pile high on 8 slices rye spread with spicy mustard. Boil 600g potatoes, cool and toss with mayo, celery and dill. Serve each sandwich with a whole dill pickle.

w.note: Three-colour almond sponge layers with jam and chocolate
w.how: Beat 200g almond meal paste, 200g butter, 200g sugar and 4 eggs, then fold in 150g flour. Divide in three, colour red and green, bake each thin at 180C for 12 minutes. Stack with apricot jam, top with 150g melted chocolate, chill and cut into small bars.

d.note: Sparkling citrus water, still kept away from anything furry
d.how: Fill four glasses with ice and slices of lemon and lime. Pour over chilled sparkling water. Keep every glass well away from anything furry, and never after midnight.

s.note: Deep golden corn dogs with yellow mustard
s.how: Whisk 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk. Pat 8 franks dry and push onto sticks. Dip and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until deep golden. Serve with mustard.

s.note: Thin French crêpes with ham and gruyère or lemon sugar
s.how: Whisk 150g flour, 2 eggs and 375ml milk and rest an hour. Cook thin crêpes in a buttered pan. Fold half around 100g ham and 100g gruyère and warm until melted. Sprinkle the rest with sugar and lemon.

m.note: Fried chicken, pizza and tacos on the table at once
m.how: Fry 1kg buttermilk-brined chicken pieces dredged in seasoned flour at 165C until cooked. Bake a 500g pizza dough base with sauce and 200g mozzarella. Brown 400g beef mince with taco spices and fill 8 hard shells. Put it all out together.

w.note: Fudgy brownies dusted in a chequered flag pattern
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour. Bake at 170C for 25 minutes and cool. Cut into squares and dust every second one with icing sugar like a chequered flag.

d.note: Double espresso marked with foamed milk in a small glass
d.how: Brew 4 double espressos with 72g ground coffee. Froth 100ml hot milk. Mark each espresso with a small spoon of foam and serve in little glasses. Very French, very civilised.

s.note: Lamb, lettuce and tomato on toast with mint mayo
s.how: Sear a 400g lamb backstrap to pink, rest and slice thin. Toast 8 slices sourdough. Mix 100g mayo with chopped mint. Build with crisp cos, ripe tomato and the lamb. When the mutton is nice and lean.

s.note: Salted dark chocolate truffles rolled in cocoa
s.how: Heat 150ml cream and pour over 250g chopped dark chocolate with a pinch of flaky salt. Stir smooth and chill 3 hours. Roll into small balls and coat in cocoa. Have fun storming the castle.

m.note: A giant steak and ale pie under puff pastry
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck, add 2 onions, thyme and 375ml ale and braise 2.5 hours. Thicken and pour into a big pie dish. Cover with 2 sheets puff pastry, egg wash and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.note: Tall chocolate cake with caramel and rough ganache cliffs
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 200g butter, whisk in 4 eggs and 200g sugar and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in three tins at 170C for 25 minutes. Melt 200g caramels with cream for filling. Stack tall and spread ganache of 150g chocolate and 150ml cream roughly over the sides.

d.note: Red wine in goblets, swapped around, grape juice to decide
d.how: Pour a medium-bodied red into goblets and swap them around the table. Pour red grape juice for anyone who can't decide which cup to choose. Never go in against a Sicilian when death is on the line.

s.note: Marmalade sandwiches wrapped in paper, for emergencies
s.how: Butter 8 slices white bread right to the edges. Spread 4 with coarse-cut Seville orange marmalade and close. Leave the crusts on, cut into squares and wrap each in baking paper. Keep one under your hat for emergencies.

s.note: Fruity Dundee cake with almonds on top
s.how: Beat 150g butter and 150g brown sugar, add 3 eggs, then fold in 200g flour, 300g mixed dried fruit and orange zest. Spread in a tin, arrange 50g almonds in circles on top and bake at 150C for 2 hours. Cut into small slices.

m.note: Lamb shepherd's pie with buttered peas
m.how: Brown 750g lamb mince. Add a diced onion and 2 carrots, then 2 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and 250ml stock and simmer 40 minutes. Top with 1kg potatoes mashed with butter and bake at 200C until golden. Serve with 300g buttered peas.

w.note: Marmalade bread and butter pudding in vanilla custard
w.how: Butter 8 slices white bread and spread with marmalade. Layer in a dish. Whisk 4 eggs, 400ml milk, 200ml cream and 60g sugar and pour over. Rest 20 minutes and bake at 170C for 40 minutes.

d.note: Proper cocoa served in china cups
d.how: Whisk 4 tbsp cocoa and 4 tbsp sugar with a splash of milk into a paste. Add 1L milk and a pinch of salt and heat, whisking, until steaming. Pour into china cups. Have a hard-boiled sweet afterwards.

s.note: Crisp hot honey wings with blue cheese and celery
s.how: Dry 1kg chicken wings overnight and bake at 220C for 45 minutes. Toss in 80ml hot sauce melted with 60g butter and 1 tbsp honey. Serve with celery sticks and 80g blue cheese mashed into a little sour cream.

s.note: A long Italian sub cut into thick party slices
s.how: Split a long Italian loaf. Layer with 100g salami, 150g ham, 100g provolone, shredded iceberg, sliced tomato and onion. Drizzle with oil and red wine vinegar and season. Press, then cut into thick slices.

m.note: Pepperoni pizza left in the box on the bench
m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with pizza sauce, add 250g mozzarella, 100g pepperoni and dried oregano. Bake on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes, cut into squares and leave in the box on the bench.

w.note: Chocolate sheet cake with fudge frosting and sprinkles
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 200ml milk. Bake in a tray at 175C for 30 minutes. Beat 150g butter, 300g icing sugar and 40g cocoa, spread on and cover with sprinkles.

d.note: Pineapple orange punch with lemonade and lots of ice
d.how: Pour 500ml pineapple juice and 500ml orange juice into a big bowl with lots of ice. Top with 750ml lemonade and float sliced oranges on top. Ladle into cups between dance-offs.

s.note: Dark cocoa truffles and snowy white chocolate truffles
s.how: Make two ganaches: 150g dark chocolate with 75ml hot cream, and 200g white chocolate with 60ml hot cream. Chill 3 hours. Roll the dark ones in cocoa and the white ones in icing sugar like snow. Pile on a silver plate.

s.note: Honey thyme roasted baby carrots with whipped feta
s.how: Toss 2 bunches baby carrots with 2 tbsp honey, thyme and 30g melted butter. Roast at 200C for 25 minutes until caramelised. Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt for the dip. Share one with the reindeer.

m.note: Creamy Scandinavian meatballs with mash and lingonberry
m.how: Mix 300g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 50g soaked breadcrumbs, a grated onion and half a tsp allspice. Roll and brown in butter, then simmer in 200ml stock and 150ml cream. Serve with 1kg potatoes mashed and lingonberry jam.

w.note: Cardamom custard buns with icing and coconut
w.how: Mix 450g flour, 7g yeast, 1 tsp cardamom, 60g sugar, 250ml warm milk, 1 egg and 60g butter and prove an hour. Shape 12 buns, press a hollow and fill with thick custard. Bake at 200C for 12 minutes. Spread icing on top and dip in coconut.

d.note: Cinnamon cocoa with whipped cream from the trading post and sauna
d.how: Whisk 4 tbsp cocoa, 4 tbsp sugar, a pinch of cinnamon and salt with a splash of milk. Add 1L milk and heat until steaming. Pour into mugs and top with 150ml whipped cream. A big summer blowout, hoo hoo.

s.note: Golden pan-fried crab cakes with lemon wedges, wedding reception style
s.how: Fold 400g crab meat with 2 tbsp mayo, 1 egg, 1 tsp Dijon, celery salt, paprika and 50g breadcrumbs. Shape into 8 cakes and chill 30 minutes. Pan-fry in 40g butter until golden and serve with lemon.

s.note: Lemony prawn rolls toasted in butter
s.how: Chop 400g cooked prawns and fold with 3 tbsp mayo, lemon juice, a finely diced celery stick and chives. Butter the cut sides of 4 hot dog buns and toast. Pile the prawns in.

m.note: Chicken in white wine tarragon cream with potato gratin
m.how: Slice 1kg potatoes thin, layer with 300ml cream and garlic and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Pan-roast 4 chicken breasts. Add 150ml white wine, 1 tbsp Dijon and tarragon to the pan, then 150ml cream. Serve with 300g green beans.

w.note: Vanilla cake fingers layered with jam and meringue buttercream
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 165C for 30 minutes. Heat 3 whites and 150g sugar to 70C, whip, then beat in 250g butter. Layer with raspberry jam and cut into fingers.

d.note: Chilled sparkling wine raised during the speeches
d.how: Chill a 750ml bottle of sparkling wine for three hours. Pour into four flutes and raise them high while someone gives a speech. Crashing is optional.

s.note: Creamy clam dip with potato chips
s.how: Drain a tin of chopped clams, keeping a little juice. Fold into 200g cream cheese and 100g sour cream with lemon juice, a dash of Worcestershire and chives. Serve with a bag of potato chips.

s.note: Sticky soy and ginger glazed bacon-wrapped water chestnuts, retro party style
s.how: Drain a tin of water chestnuts and wrap each in half a rasher of bacon, about 8 rashers in total. Brush with 2 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp brown sugar and grated ginger. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes until sticky.

m.note: Lobster, clams, corn and potatoes steamed and tipped onto the table
m.how: Boil 600g new potatoes for 10 minutes in a big pot. Add 4 halved corn cobs, 250ml white wine, 3 garlic cloves and 80g butter, then 1kg clams and 4 lobster tails. Cover and steam 8 minutes. Tip it all onto the table.

w.note: Caramel pineapple upside-down cake with cherries
w.how: Melt 60g butter with 80g brown sugar in a tin. Lay pineapple rings with a cherry in each. Beat 125g butter and 125g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 175g self-raising flour. Spread over and bake at 175C for 45 minutes. Flip out.

d.note: Rum mai tais with orgeat, lime and mint
d.how: For each drink, shake 30ml white rum, 30ml dark rum, 15ml orange liqueur, 15ml orgeat and 25ml lime juice with ice. Strain over crushed ice and top with a mint sprig. Makes four.

s.note: White chocolate cups filled with vanilla mousse
s.how: Brush 200g melted white chocolate inside 8 small paper cups in two coats and set. Peel off the paper. Whip 200ml cream with icing sugar and vanilla bean seeds and fill. Stick on a piped dark chocolate handle. Eat the whole thing.

s.note: Whipped ricotta crackers with crushed mixed berries
s.how: Crush 100g raspberries, 100g blackberries and 100g blueberries with a spoon of sugar. Spread 16 seeded crackers with 200g whipped ricotta and top with the berries. Taste them and decide what a snozzberry is.

m.note: Beef and barley stew stretched with bread
m.how: Brown 800g diced beef shin. Soften 2 onions, 3 carrots and 400g potatoes, add 100g pearl barley and 1.2L stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours until thick. Serve with bread to stretch it further.

w.note: Layered cherry, white and dark ganache truffles
w.how: Wrap 12 maraschino cherries in white ganache made from 150g white chocolate and 50ml cream, and chill. Wrap again in dark ganache from 150g dark chocolate and 75ml cream, and chill. Roll in cocoa and coloured sugar. Bite to see the layers.

d.note: Raspberry lemon soda with sorbet fizzing to the rim
d.how: Blitz 150g raspberries and strain. Mix with the juice of 2 lemons and 2 tbsp sugar syrup. Divide between four tall glasses, top with very cold soda water and drop in a scoop of lemon sorbet so it fizzes up. Don't burp.

s.note: Spicy devilled eggs on silver trays
s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes and halve. Whip the yolks with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon and a dash of hot sauce. Pipe back and finish with smoked paprika and chives. Lay them on silver trays.

s.note: Golden hush puppies with honey butter
s.how: Mix 150g cornmeal, 75g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 200ml buttermilk, 1 egg and a grated onion. Spoon into 175C oil and fry until golden. Beat 60g soft butter with 2 tbsp honey to serve.

m.note: Buttermilk fried chicken on waffles with hot sauce butter
m.how: Brine 800g chicken thighs in buttermilk, dredge in flour and fry at 165C until 74C. Whisk 250g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 eggs, 400ml buttermilk and 60g butter and cook waffles. Serve with maple syrup and butter melted with hot sauce.

w.n: Club Sugar Ray lemon chess pie
w.note: Buttery lemon chess pie with a crackly top
w.how: Whisk 4 eggs, 300g sugar, 110g melted butter, 2 tbsp cornmeal, 100ml lemon juice, lemon zest and 60ml milk. Pour into a 23cm blind-baked shortcrust case and bake at 170C for 40 minutes until just set. Cool completely.

d.note: Champagne cocktails with a bitters-soaked sugar cube
d.how: Drop a sugar cube soaked in a few dashes of aromatic bitters into each of four flutes. Top slowly with chilled sparkling wine and twist a strip of lemon peel over each.

s.note: Golden cheese-filled arepas from the griddle
s.how: Mix 250g arepa flour with 350ml warm water, salt and 30g butter into a soft dough. Shape 8 discs, fill with 150g grated mozzarella and seal. Cook on a griddle for 5 minutes a side until golden and crisp.

s.note: Puffy golden Colombian cheese bread rolls, best eaten warm
s.how: Mix 150g tapioca starch, 50g arepa flour, 250g crumbled feta, 1 egg and 1 tbsp sugar into a soft dough. Roll into 12 balls and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until puffed and golden. Eat warm.

m.note: Shredded beef with rice, black beans, plantain and a fried egg
m.how: Braise 1.2kg beef chuck with a tin of tomatoes, 2 onions and 2 tsp cumin for 3 hours, then shred. Cook 300g rice and warm 2 tins black beans. Fry slices of 2 green plantains and 4 eggs. Serve it all on one plate.

w.note: Round golden cheese fritters, Colombian style
w.how: Mix 250g crumbled feta, 60g cornflour, 60g tapioca starch, 1 egg and 2 tbsp sugar into a soft dough. Roll into 16 balls and fry at 160C for 6 minutes until golden and round. Drain and serve warm.

d.note: Frothy hot chocolate with cheese melting in the mug
d.how: Heat 1L milk and whisk in 150g dark chocolate and a pinch of cinnamon until frothy. Pour into four mugs and drop a cube of mozzarella into each so it goes soft and stringy, then fish it out with a spoon.

s.note: Pink beetroot hummus wraps sliced into spirals
s.how: Blitz a roasted beetroot with a drained tin of chickpeas, tahini, lemon and garlic until pink. Spread on 4 flour tortillas, fill with 300g shredded roast chicken, rocket and 100g feta. Roll tight and slice into spirals. On Wednesdays we wear pink.

s.note: Candy cane bundles and peppermint bark shards
s.how: Tie candy canes in bundles of four with ribbon. Spread 200g melted dark chocolate thin and set, then cover with 200g white chocolate with a drop of peppermint and crushed candy cane. Set and break into shards.

m.note: Spiced beef tacos in hard shells with all the toppings
m.how: Brown 600g beef mince hard with an onion, a garlic clove, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tbsp tomato paste. Loosen with 150ml stock. Spoon into 12 warm hard shells with cheddar, lettuce, tomato and sour cream.

w.note: Raspberry pink buttercream cupcakes with sprinkles
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 at 175C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar and a spoon of strained raspberry purée until pale pink. Pipe and add pink sprinkles.

d.note: Raspberry pink lemonade over ice, worn on Wednesdays
d.how: Blend the juice of 5 lemons with 150g sugar dissolved in 150ml hot water and a handful of raspberries. Strain, top with 1L cold water and pour over ice. So fetch.

s.note: Triple-decker turkey club sandwiches cut into quarters
s.how: Grill 8 rashers of bacon. Toast 12 slices white bread. Layer 300g roast turkey, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo across three slices each. Pin with toothpicks and cut into quarters.

s.note: Hot spinach cheese dip baked in a cob loaf
s.how: Hollow a cob loaf and tear the inside into pieces. Wilt 250g spinach, squeeze and mix with 250g cream cheese, 150g sour cream, 50g parmesan and a crushed garlic clove. Fill the cob and bake at 180C for 25 minutes with the bread pieces around it.

m.note: Thick-cut prime rib with horseradish cream and baked potato
m.how: Season a 2kg beef rib roast overnight. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C and rest 20 minutes. Bake 4 potatoes. Mix 2 tbsp horseradish into 200g sour cream. Carve thick and serve with the potatoes and chives.

w.note: Hot fudge sundae with nuts and a cherry
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream for hot fudge. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four tall glasses, pour over the fudge and top with whipped cream, chopped peanuts and a cherry. Keep it well away from the pool.

d.note: Half iced tea, half lemonade, over plenty of ice
d.how: Brew 4 black tea bags in 500ml boiling water and cool. Make lemonade from the juice of 3 lemons, 80g sugar and 400ml cold water. Mix together and pour over plenty of ice with a lemon wheel.

s.note: Little brie and ham quiches baked just until set
s.how: Line a 24-hole mini muffin tin with rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust and blind-bake. Fill with 100g diced brie and 80g chopped ham. Whisk 2 eggs with 150ml cream and chives, pour in and bake at 170C for 15 minutes.

s.note: Buttermilk biscuits under peppery sausage gravy
s.how: Rub 100g butter into 300g flour with 3 tsp baking powder and stir in 250ml buttermilk. Cut rounds and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Brown 300g sausage mince, stir in 2 tbsp flour and 400ml milk and simmer with lots of pepper. Pour over the split biscuits.

m.note: Creamy chicken and vegetable pie under puff pastry
m.how: Brown 800g diced chicken thighs, add a diced onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks with thyme. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, 250ml stock and 200ml cream and simmer until thick, then add 150g peas. Cover with puff pastry, egg wash and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.

w.note: Biscuit crust with salted caramel under bittersweet ganache
w.how: Press 200g crushed biscuits with 80g melted butter into a pie tin. Melt 250g caramels with 3 tbsp cream and pour in. Pour over 200g dark chocolate melted with 150ml cream and set. Drizzle more caramel and flaky salt on top.

d.note: Drip coffee refilled before you ask, cream on the side
d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water in a drip machine. Pour into thick mugs and refill before anyone asks. Put a jug of 200ml pouring cream on the side.

s.note: Potato and onion pastry parcels, New York style.
s.how: Mash 750g boiled potatoes with 1 onion fried soft in 30g butter, salt and pepper. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 12 squares, put a spoon of filling on each, fold into parcels, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

s.note: Rosemary roasted nuts and warm orange olives
s.how: Toss 300g mixed nuts with 30g melted butter, chopped rosemary and salt and roast at 170C for 12 minutes. Warm 250g olives in olive oil with strips of orange peel. Serve both in bowls.

m.note: Chicken simmered in dark onion gravy over rice with greens
m.how: Flour and brown 1kg chicken thighs. Make a dark roux in the pan with 40g butter and 3 tbsp flour, add 2 sliced onions and 500ml stock. Simmer the chicken in the gravy for 40 minutes. Serve over 300g rice with kale braised with garlic.

w.note: Rich baked cheesecake, cooled slowly and chilled overnight
w.how: Mix 250g crushed biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a tin. Beat 750g cream cheese with 200g sugar, 3 eggs and 150g sour cream. Bake in a water bath at 150C for an hour, cool in the oven and chill overnight.

d.note: Bourbon whisky sours with a cherry
d.how: For each drink, shake 45ml bourbon, 25ml lemon juice and 15ml sugar syrup with ice. Strain over fresh ice and top with a cherry. Makes four. Right on.

s.note: Salmon avocado sushi rolls with soy and ginger
s.how: Cook 300g sushi rice and season with vinegar and sugar. Spread over 4 nori sheets, fill with 200g salmon and avocado and roll tight with a mat. Slice with a wet knife. Serve with soy and pickled ginger. Smile and wave, boys.

s.note: Black and white striped cheesecake brownies
s.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate with 120g butter, whisk in 200g sugar and 2 eggs and fold in 80g flour. Beat 200g cream cheese with 50g sugar and 1 egg. Spread the brownie in a tin and swirl the cheesecake through in stripes. Bake at 170C for 30 minutes.

m.note: Rib eye with garlic parsley butter and shoestring fries
m.how: Dry-brine 4 rib eyes overnight. Sear in a smoking cast iron pan, flipping every minute, and pull at 54C. Rest 8 minutes and top with 60g butter mashed with garlic and parsley. Fry 1kg potatoes cut into shoestrings.

w.note: Charred pineapple with rum caramel and coconut ice cream
w.how: Cut a pineapple into thick wedges and grill until charred. Melt 60g butter with 80g brown sugar and 2 tbsp dark rum until glossy and pour over. Serve straight away with scoops of coconut ice cream.

d.note: Mango passionfruit punch with lemonade and lime
d.how: Mix 500ml mango nectar with the pulp of 3 passionfruit. Pour over plenty of ice in four glasses and top with lemonade. Add a lime wedge to each.

s.note: Puffed banana fritters rolled in cinnamon sugar
s.how: Whisk 150g flour with 200ml sparkling water and a pinch of sugar. Dip thick slices of 4 bananas and fry at 180C until puffed and golden. Roll in 80g sugar mixed with cinnamon while hot.

s.note: Corn chips with beans, cheese, salsa and sour cream
s.how: Spread 300g corn chips on a tray, spoon over 400g refried beans warmed with 1 tsp cumin and cover with 200g grated cheese. Bake at 200C for 10 minutes and top with 200g salsa, 150g sour cream and jalapeños.

m.note: Juniper venison with redcurrant sauce and parsnip mash
m.how: Rub 800g venison backstrap with crushed juniper, pepper and thyme. Sear to rare and rest. Add 150ml red wine and 2 tbsp redcurrant jelly to the pan and reduce. Mash 600g parsnips and 400g potatoes with butter.

w.note: Soft creamy fudge made with maple syrup
w.how: Boil 250ml maple syrup, 200g brown sugar, 150ml cream and 40g butter to 115C, stirring gently. Cool 10 minutes, then beat until thick and losing its gloss. Spread in a lined 15cm tin, cool and cut into squares.

d.note: Warm spiced apple cider with cinnamon and orange.
d.how: Warm 1L cloudy apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves and 3 strips orange peel over low heat for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into 4 mugs and serve hot.

s.note: Frozen grapes with olives, feta and pita, Roman style
s.how: Freeze 500g grapes for 2 hours. Pile on a big platter with 200g olives, 200g feta drizzled with oil and 4 warm pita breads cut into wedges. Eat lying down like a Roman.

s.note: Sticky barbecue honey glazed wings, roadhouse style, plenty of napkins
s.how: Dry 1kg chicken wings overnight and toss with garlic powder and salt. Bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Toss in 100ml barbecue sauce warmed with 2 tbsp honey.

m.note: Saucy beef sloppy joes piled on toasted buns
m.how: Brown 800g beef mince with an onion and a green capsicum. Add 200ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp mustard and simmer 20 minutes until thick. Pile onto 4 toasted soft buns.

w.note: Brightly iced cupcakes, safe to throw but please don't
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 at 175C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar, tint bright colours and swirl on.

d.note: Fruit punch with vodka for the adults
d.how: Pour 500ml pineapple juice and 500ml orange juice into a big bowl with ice and sliced oranges. Top with 750ml lemonade. Add 150ml vodka for the adults' bowl only.

s.note: Cheddar, Red Leicester and Wensleydale cut into diamonds
s.how: Cut 150g aged cheddar, 150g Red Leicester and 150g Wensleydale into sharp little diamond shapes. Arrange on a board with crackers and pickled onions. Don't swallow any of the diamonds.

s.note: Sticky honey mustard chipolatas on toothpicks
s.how: Grill 500g chipolatas until browned. Toss in a hot pan with 2 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard until sticky. Spear on toothpicks and serve hot. Do you like dags?

m.note: The full English fry-up with black pudding
m.how: Grill 8 rashers bacon and 4 pork sausages. Fry 4 eggs, 4 slices black pudding and 200g mushrooms. Warm a tin of baked beans and grill 2 halved tomatoes. Serve with buttered toast.

w.note: Biscuit base, caramel and banana under cream
w.how: Press 250g crushed biscuits mixed with 120g melted butter into a pie dish and chill. Spread with 380g tinned caramel, layer 3 sliced bananas, top with 300ml whipped cream and grated chocolate.

d.note: Cellar-cool English ale with salted peanuts
d.how: Leave four 500ml bottles of English ale out of the fridge for an hour so they're cool, not cold. Pour into pint glasses and put a bowl of 150g salted peanuts on the bar.

s.note: Salami, sharp cheddar, pickle spears and crackers from the deli counter
s.how: Fold 150g salami onto a board. Cut 200g sharp cheddar into slabs and 4 dill pickles into spears. Add a sleeve of crackers and serve like a spread grabbed straight from the deli counter.

s.note: Crisp-bottomed pork and chive dumplings with black vinegar dip
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with a chopped bunch of garlic chives, 1 tbsp grated ginger and 1 tsp sesame oil. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers and pleat. Fry until crisp underneath, add water and steam under a lid for 4 minutes. Serve with black vinegar.

m.note: Crisp battered pork in a bright pineapple sweet and sour sauce
m.how: Toss 700g diced pork shoulder in egg and 100g cornflour and fry at 180C until crisp. Simmer chunks of half a pineapple and a red capsicum with 80ml vinegar, 80g sugar and 80ml tomato sauce, then thicken. Toss the pork through and serve with 300g jasmine rice.

w.note: Almond milk jelly cubes with lychees and mandarins
w.how: Soak 4 gelatine leaves. Warm 500ml milk with 60g sugar, stir in the gelatine and 1 tsp almond extract. Set in a tray for 3 hours and cut into cubes. Serve in bowls with a tin of lychees and mandarin segments in their syrup.

d.note: Jasmine tea poured into small cups and topped up all night
d.how: Heat 1L water to just off the boil. Steep 4 tsp jasmine tea for 3 minutes, then pour into small cups. Keep the pot going and top cups up all night.

s.note: Bacon, mushrooms, tomato and marmalade toast, after the first breakfast
s.how: Grill 8 rashers of bacon and fry 250g mushrooms in butter. Grill 2 halved tomatoes. Toast 8 slices white bread and butter with marmalade. Serve on a big platter mid-morning. What about elevenses?

s.note: Stuffed field mushrooms with garlic, thyme and gruyère
s.how: Remove the stems from 4 large field mushrooms. Mix 50g breadcrumbs with 2 crushed garlic cloves, thyme, 80g grated gruyère and 30g melted butter. Pile into the caps and roast at 200C for 15 minutes until bubbling.

m.note: Beef and ale pie with mash and peas
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, add 2 onions, thyme and 375ml dark ale and braise 2.5 hours. Thicken, pour into a dish, top with puff pastry and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with 1kg potatoes mashed with butter and 300g peas.

w.note: Buttery caraway seed cake sliced with butter
w.how: Beat 175g butter with 175g sugar, add 3 eggs, then fold in 225g self-raising flour, 2 tsp caraway seeds and 3 tbsp milk. Bake in a loaf tin at 170C for 50 minutes. Slice thick and spread with butter.

d.note: Ale in pint glasses, apple juice for the small folk
d.how: Leave four 500ml bottles of English ale out of the fridge for an hour to reach cellar temperature. Pour into proper pint glasses. Pour cloudy apple juice into half pints for anyone smaller. It comes in pints?

s.note: Buttery lemon sardines on sourdough with radish
s.how: Mash 2 drained tins of sardines with 30g soft butter, lemon juice and chopped parsley. Spread on 8 slices toasted sourdough and top with thinly sliced radish and black pepper.

s.note: Cheese sliders stacked high like they fell from the sky
s.how: Smash 12 small patties from 500g beef mince on a hot griddle and melt American cheese on top. Put into slider buns with pickles, onion and burger sauce. Stack them high on a platter.

m.note: Giant meatballs on a twisting mountain of spaghetti
m.how: Mix 400g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 2 slices soaked bread, 40g parmesan and parsley. Roll into 8 big balls and brown. Simmer 45 minutes in 2 tins tomatoes with basil. Pile over 500g spaghetti.

w.note: A snowy mountain of three ice creams with hot fudge
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream. Scoop vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream into a big mountain on a platter. Cover with sprinkles, stick in wafer biscuits and pour over the hot fudge.

d.note: Layered fruit syrups topped with lemonade so the colours run
d.how: Make three syrups: blitzed raspberries with sugar, orange juice with sugar, and lime juice with sugar. Spoon a layer of each into four tall glasses and top slowly with lemonade so the colours run together.

s.note: Salmon and tuna nigiri with wasabi and pickled ginger
s.how: Cook 300g sushi rice and season with rice vinegar, sugar and salt. Shape into small fingers. Top with slices of 150g salmon and 150g tuna and a dab of wasabi. Serve on a board with pickled ginger.

s.note: Charred miso butter corn with shichimi and spring onion
s.how: Grill 4 corn cobs until charred all over. Mix 50g soft butter with 1 tbsp white miso and brush over. Sprinkle with shichimi togarashi and sliced spring onion.

m.note: Glazed chicken and spring onion skewers with rice
m.how: Simmer 80ml soy, 80ml mirin, 60ml sake and 2 tbsp sugar until syrupy for tare. Thread 1kg diced chicken thighs onto skewers, some with spring onion pieces. Grill over high heat, brushing with tare. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.

w.note: Homemade green tea ice cream, smooth and grassy, scooped into bowls
w.how: Whisk 2 tbsp matcha into 300ml warm milk and 300ml cream. Whisk 5 yolks with 120g sugar, pour over and cook to 82C. Strain, chill overnight and churn, or freeze and stir every 30 minutes.

d.note: Warm junmai sake poured into small cups
d.how: Pour 400ml junmai sake into a flask and warm it in a pot of hot water to about 45C. Pour into small cups and sip slowly. Never pour your own.

s.note: Crisp crumbed beef ragout balls with grainy mustard
s.how: Braise 500g beef chuck with an onion and thyme until it falls apart, then shred. Cook 50g butter with 50g flour, add 300ml of the stock and the beef and chill overnight. Roll into balls, crumb in egg and panko and fry at 180C. Serve with grainy mustard.

s.note: Bresaola, burrata, figs and grissini with good olive oil
s.how: Lay 100g bresaola on a board with 2 burrata, 4 halved figs, a packet of breadsticks and a bowl of olives. Drizzle with good olive oil and a squeeze of lemon.

m.note: Golden saffron risotto with butter and parmesan
m.how: Soften an onion in 30g butter, add 350g carnaroli and toast. Add 125ml white wine, then 1.2L hot stock ladle by ladle for 18 minutes, with a pinch of saffron steeped in. Finish with 40g butter and 60g parmesan.

w.note: Coffee-soaked sponge fingers with mascarpone and cocoa
w.how: Whisk 3 egg yolks with 80g sugar until pale, fold in 500g mascarpone and 200ml whipped cream. Dip 24 sponge fingers in 300ml cooled strong coffee and layer with the cream in a dish. Chill 4 hours and dust with cocoa.

d.note: Orange aperitivo spritz with prosecco and soda
d.how: For each drink, fill a big wine glass with ice. Add 60ml orange bitter aperitivo, 90ml prosecco and a splash of soda water. Add an orange slice. Makes four.

s.note: Smoky buttered peanuts and pickled onions on the bar
s.how: Toss 300g peanuts with 20g melted butter, 1 tsp smoked paprika and flaky salt. Roast at 170C for 12 minutes. Serve on the bar with a bowl of pickled onions.

s.note: Thin rare roast beef sliders with barbecue mayo
s.how: Roast a 600g beef topside at 200C until 52C, rest and slice paper thin. Mix 3 tbsp barbecue sauce with 3 tbsp mayo. Pile the beef into 12 slider buns with the sauce and a slice of American cheese.

m.note: Ziti in tomato sausage sauce with ricotta and mozzarella
m.how: Brown 400g Italian sausage meat, add 700g passata and simmer 15 minutes. Toss with 500g cooked ziti or penne and dollops of 250g ricotta, top with 200g mozzarella and parmesan and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.note: Sponge filled with pastry cream under dark ganache
w.how: Whisk 4 eggs and 150g sugar until thick and fold in 150g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 20 minutes. Cook 400ml milk, 3 yolks, 80g sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour until thick and cool. Fill and pour over 150g chocolate melted with 100ml cream.

d.note: Cold lager or stout left to settle in pint glasses
d.how: Chill four pint glasses. Pour 500ml lager or stout into each, slowly, and let the stout settle before topping up. Raise a glass to Lowell.

s.note: Roast drumsticks, bursting tomatoes, grapes and crusty bread
s.how: Rub 8 chicken drumsticks with butter, thyme and salt and roast at 200C for 40 minutes. Lay on a long board with 250g cherry tomatoes, red grapes and torn crusty bread. Eat slowly.

s.note: Sugared strawberries with vanilla whipped cream
s.how: Halve 500g ripe strawberries and toss with 2 tbsp sugar and a squeeze of lemon. Rest 20 minutes. Whip 300ml cream with vanilla and serve together. Do you remember the taste of strawberries?

m.note: Roast sirloin with honey roots, potatoes and red wine gravy
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg sirloin at 200C to 52C and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes. Toss 3 carrots and 3 parsnips with honey and roast for 35 minutes. Reduce 200ml red wine with the pan juices for gravy.

w.note: Light fruit and almond cake with apricot jam and white icing
w.how: Beat 175g butter and 175g brown sugar, add 3 eggs, then fold in 225g self-raising flour, 300g mixed dried fruit and 50g almonds. Bake at 160C for 90 minutes. Split, fill with apricot jam and cover in 300g white icing with small flowers.

d.note: Cellar-cool ale and a toast to absent friends
d.how: Leave four 500ml bottles of English ale out of the fridge for an hour. Pour into pint glasses and raise a toast to absent friends.

s.note: Butter, oil and ricotta, then actual bread
s.how: Set out a bowl of 125g cultured butter, a dish of olive oil and 150g whipped ricotta, each with a few salt flakes. Then, because you're not on that island, warm a sourdough loaf and serve it with them.

s.note: Raw sliced scallops with lime and finger lime on a cold plate
s.how: Slice 300g very fresh scallops thin and lay on chilled plates. Dress with the juice of a lime, the pearls of 2 finger limes, a few drops of olive oil and sea salt. Serve straight away.

m.note: A perfect double cheeseburger with crinkle fries, packed to go
m.how: Smash 8 thin patties from 800g chuck mince on a smoking griddle and add American cheese. Stack two per soft toasted bun with white onion and pickles. Fry 1kg potatoes crinkle-cut, twice. Wrap one to take home.

w.note: Chocolate tart under a torched marshmallow meringue
w.how: Press 250g crushed biscuits with 100g melted butter into a tart tin. Pour in 200g dark chocolate melted with 200ml cream and set. Whisk 3 whites with 150g sugar over hot water, beat stiff, spread on top and torch until blistered.

d.note: A chilled white and a light red in tasting glasses
d.how: Chill a 750ml bottle of white wine and slightly chill a 750ml pinot noir. Pour small amounts into tasting glasses, swapping course by course. Don't ask for the cheeseburger until the end.

s.note: Salted edamame with rice crackers and wasabi peas
s.how: Steam 400g edamame for 4 minutes and toss with flaky salt and a little sesame oil. Serve in small bowls with rice crackers and 100g wasabi peas.

s.note: Double-fried Japanese chicken with mayo and lemon
s.how: Marinate 700g chicken thigh pieces for an hour in 2 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp sake, grated ginger and garlic. Coat in 100g potato starch and fry at 160C, rest, then fry again at 190C until crisp. Serve with mayo and lemon.

m.note: Table-side hotpot of thin beef, tofu and vegetables
m.how: Soak a piece of kombu in 2L water for 30 minutes and bring to a simmer at the table. Swish 600g thin sliced beef, 300g tofu, a quarter wombok, 100g enoki and spring onion through the broth. Dip in ponzu. Finish with rice.

w.note: No-churn matcha soft serve in cones
w.how: Whisk 2 tbsp matcha into a 395g tin of condensed milk. Whip 400ml cream to soft peaks and fold through. Freeze 6 hours, then scoop soft into 4 waffle cones.

d.note: Japanese whisky highball stirred once with lemon
d.how: For each drink, pack a tall glass with ice. Add 45ml Japanese whisky and top with very cold soda water. Stir once and add a twist of lemon. Sip it slowly, jet-lagged, at the hotel bar.

s.note: Prosciutto figs, orange olives and cheddar shards on toothpicks
s.how: Wrap 6 halved figs in 100g prosciutto. Warm 200g olives with orange peel and a pinch of fennel seeds. Break 150g aged cheddar into shards. Put everything on toothpicks so no one gets greasy fingers on the cards.

s.note: Butter lettuce with shaved fennel, orange and hazelnuts
s.how: Toast 60g hazelnuts at 170C for 8 minutes and chop. Shave a fennel bulb paper thin and segment 2 oranges. Toss with butter lettuce leaves and dress at the last second with Dijon, white wine vinegar and olive oil.

m.note: Charred garlic rosemary lamb chops with capsicum and yoghurt
m.how: Marinate 1.2kg lamb shoulder chops overnight in 4 garlic cloves, rosemary, lemon and olive oil. Grill hot until charred and pink inside. Roast 3 red capsicums and slice. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with a crushed garlic clove.

w.note: Molten chocolate fondants turned out at the table
w.how: Melt 125g dark chocolate with 125g butter. Whisk 2 eggs and 2 yolks with 60g sugar until pale, combine and fold in 30g flour. Bake in 4 buttered, cocoa-dusted moulds at 220C for 9 minutes. Turn out so the centres run.

d.note: Gin, vodka and white vermouth, shaken very cold
d.how: For each drink, shake 60ml gin, 20ml vodka and 10ml white vermouth hard with ice until very cold. Strain into a deep chilled coupe and add a long strip of lemon peel. Makes four.

s.note: Bacon-wrapped mini franks with beans, salsa and mustard
s.how: Wrap 16 cocktail franks in half rashers of bacon, 8 rashers in total, and griddle until crisp. Tuck into 16 mini rolls with warm pinto beans, diced tomato and onion, mustard and jalapeño salsa.

s.note: Crisp potato skins with bacon, cheddar and sour cream.
s.how: Bake 6 medium potatoes at 200C for 50 minutes. Halve, scoop out most of the flesh and brush the skins with 30g melted butter. Fill with 150g fried diced bacon and 150g grated cheddar, bake 10 minutes more, then top with sour cream and chives.

m.note: Chicken and cheese enchiladas baked in red chilli sauce.
m.how: Simmer 400g shredded cooked chicken in 500ml red enchilada sauce for 5 minutes. Fill 8 warmed corn tortillas with the chicken and 150g grated cheddar, roll and lay in a baking dish. Pour over 250ml more sauce, top with 100g cheddar and bake at 190C for 20 minutes. Scatter with coriander.

w.note: Hot fudge sundaes with peanuts and a cherry
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate into 100ml cream for hot fudge. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four tall glasses, pour over the fudge and pipe whipped cream high. Top with chopped peanuts and a cherry.

d.note: Cranberry lemonade punch, red enough to make anyone nervous
d.how: Pour 500ml cranberry juice and 750ml lemonade into a big jug with ice and sliced orange. Stir gently and pour carefully into glasses, nowhere near anyone's borrowed white suede outfit.

s.note: Green apple slices with salted caramel dip and cheddar
s.how: Slice 3 green apples and toss in lime juice. Melt 200g caramels with 3 tbsp cream and a pinch of flaky salt. Serve the apples with the warm dip and shards of 150g sharp cheddar.

s.note: Twice-fried plantain coins brushed with gold
s.how: Peel 3 green plantains and slice into thick coins. Fry at 160C for 3 minutes, smash flat, then fry at 190C until golden and crisp. Salt and brush the top ones with edible gold lustre.
