d.how: Bury eight 355ml longnecks of American lager in a tub of ice and water for 30 minutes. Hand them out with a lime wedge for anyone who wants one. Pain don't hurt.

s.note: Seared beef crostini and smoked salmon blinis on black trays
s.how: Sear a 300g eye fillet to rare, rest and slice thin. Toast baguette slices and top with the beef and horseradish cream. Top 12 blinis with crème fraîche, 100g smoked salmon and chives. Serve on black trays.

s.note: Sticky char siu pork belly cubes with pickled cucumber
s.how: Cut 800g pork belly into cubes and toss with 3 tbsp hoisin, 2 tbsp honey and 1 tsp five spice. Roast at 200C for 40 minutes, glazing twice. Quick-pickle a sliced cucumber in rice vinegar. Serve on toothpicks.

m.note: Salmon on crushed potatoes with lemon caper butter and rocket
m.how: Roast 4 salmon fillets skin side down at 220C for 8 minutes. Crush 800g boiled potatoes with butter. Melt 60g butter with lemon juice and 1 tbsp capers and spoon over. Serve with a peppery rocket salad.

w.note: Crisp pastry with smooth sharp lemon cream
w.how: Blind bake a 23cm sweet shortcrust case at 180C for 20 minutes. Whisk 4 eggs, 150g sugar, 150ml lemon juice, lemon zest and 150ml cream, pour in and bake at 150C for 30 minutes until just set. Chill and dust with icing sugar.

d.note: Neat single malt with a jug of water
d.how: Pour 30ml single malt Scotch neat into each of four tumblers. Put a jug of water on the side. Some men just want to watch the world burn, the rest want a quiet drink.

s.note: Golden crab cakes with lemon wedges
s.how: Fold 400g crab meat with 2 tbsp mayo, 1 egg, 1 tsp Dijon and 50g breadcrumbs. Shape into 8 cakes and chill 30 minutes. Pan-fry in butter until golden and serve with lemon.

s.note: Smoky eggplant dip, hummus and pickles with flatbread
s.how: Char an eggplant whole over a flame until collapsed, then mash with tahini, garlic and lemon. Blitz a tin of chickpeas with tahini for hummus. Serve with pickled turnips and warm flatbreads, sumac dusted over.

m.note: Thick split pea and ham soup with crusty bread
m.how: Simmer 500g split peas with a smoked ham hock, an onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks in 2L water for 2 hours. Pick the ham back in and season. Serve with crusty bread. Eat it, don't throw it.

w.note: Dark devil's food layer cake with fudge frosting
w.how: Whisk 60g cocoa into 250ml hot coffee. Beat 150g butter with 300g sugar and 3 eggs, then add the cocoa, 150ml buttermilk and 250g flour with 1 tsp bicarb. Bake in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Cover with 200g chocolate melted with cream.

d.note: Lemon mint sparkling water from little bottles
d.how: Fill four small glass bottles with chilled sparkling water, lemon slices and a few mint leaves. Pour into glasses, and sprinkle a little around the room for luck.

s.note: Golden cheese quesadilla wedges with fresh salsa
s.how: Fill 8 flour tortillas with 150g cheddar and 150g Monterey Jack, fold and cook in a dry pan until golden and melted. Cut into wedges. Dice 2 tomatoes with red onion and coriander for salsa.

s.note: Snacks set out in a muffin tin for everyone to grab
s.how: Slice 2 apples and toss in lemon. Cube 150g mild cheddar. Fill the cups of a muffin tin with apple, cheese, butter crackers and little piles of sultanas so everyone grabs their own.

m.note: Spaghetti and meatballs for the last night at home
m.how: Mix 300g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 40g parmesan and parsley. Roll into balls and brown. Simmer 40 minutes in 2 tins tomatoes. Toss with 500g spaghetti and more parmesan, and save a plate for the toys.

w.note: Shortcakes filled with strawberries and cream
w.how: Rub 80g butter into 250g self-raising flour, stir in 150ml milk and pat out. Cut 4 rounds and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Toss 400g sliced strawberries with 2 tbsp sugar. Split the shortcakes and fill with 300ml whipped cream and the berries.

d.note: Pink frothy strawberry milk blended with honey and ice
d.how: Blend 250g strawberries with 1L cold milk, 2 tbsp honey and a few ice cubes until pink and frothy. Pour into four glasses. Smells like strawberries.

s.note: Steamed chicken momos with spicy tomato sesame achar
s.how: Mix 400g chicken mince with 2 spring onions, 1 tbsp grated ginger and a pinch of cumin. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers and steam 10 minutes. Blitz 3 roasted tomatoes with a chilli and 2 tbsp toasted sesame for achar.

s.note: Golden pesto parmesan puff pastry pinwheels that spiral forever
s.how: Spread 2 sheets puff pastry with 3 tbsp basil pesto and 50g grated parmesan. Roll up, slice into spirals and brush with egg. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes until golden.

m.note: Turmeric red lentil dal with cumin ghee, rice and spinach
m.how: Simmer 300g red lentils with 1 tsp turmeric, 3 garlic cloves and ginger in 1L water for 25 minutes. Fry 1 tsp cumin seeds in 2 tbsp ghee and pour over. Serve with 300g basmati rice and spinach wilted with garlic.

w.note: Glazed cinnamon scrolls so good you'll want to repeat the loop
w.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 250ml warm milk and 50g butter and prove an hour. Roll out, spread with 60g butter, 80g brown sugar and cinnamon. Roll, cut 12 and bake at 190C for 22 minutes. Glaze with 150g icing sugar and milk. Dormammu, I've come to bargain.

d.note: Spiced masala chai strained into cups
d.how: Simmer 4 black tea bags in 500ml water with sliced ginger, 4 crushed cardamom pods and a cinnamon stick for 5 minutes. Add 500ml milk and raw sugar, bring back to a simmer and strain into cups.

s.note: Salami with bread, butter and pickled onions, paid for
s.how: Slice 150g salami thin and fan it out with a crusty loaf, cold butter and a jar of pickled onions. Bought and paid for this time, with a little left over.

s.note: Bread fried golden in beef dripping with salt and pepper
s.how: Heat 100g beef dripping in a heavy pan. Fry 8 thick slices white bread slowly until golden and crisp on both sides. Drain and sprinkle with flaky salt and cracked pepper. Serve hot.

m.note: Beef and barley stew stretched with bread
m.how: Brown 800g diced beef shin. Add 2 onions, 3 carrots, 400g potatoes, 100g pearl barley and 1.2L stock with thyme. Simmer 3 hours until thick. Serve with bread to make it go further.

w.note: Cinnamon sultana bread pudding, puffed and golden
w.how: Tear 8 slices day-old bread into a buttered dish and scatter with 80g sultanas. Whisk 3 eggs, 500ml milk, 60g brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon and pour over. Soak 20 minutes and bake at 170C for 40 minutes.

d.note: Cold milk, or warm honey cinnamon milk
d.how: Pour 1L cold full cream milk into small glasses. On a cold night, warm it gently with 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of cinnamon until steaming.

s.note: Double-fried gochujang honey chicken wings with sesame
s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings in 100g potato starch and fry at 160C for 8 minutes, rest, then at 190C until crisp. Simmer 2 tbsp gochujang, 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp soy and garlic until glossy. Toss and top with sesame.

s.note: Deep purple beetroot yoghurt dip with flatbread
s.how: Roast 2 beetroots until tender, peel and grate. Mix with 300g Greek yoghurt, a crushed garlic clove, lemon juice and dill. Serve deep purple with warm flatbreads.

m.note: Smoky red jollof rice under grilled chicken thighs
m.how: Blitz a tin of tomatoes, a red capsicum, an onion and half a scotch bonnet, then fry in oil until deep red. Stir in 400g rice, 700ml stock and thyme, cover and bake at 170C for 40 minutes. Grill 800g chicken thighs and lay on top.

w.note: Caramelised plantain with honey, chilli and coconut ice cream
w.how: Slice 3 ripe plantains on the diagonal and fry in 40g butter until caramelised. Drizzle with honey and a pinch of chilli flakes. Serve with scoops of coconut ice cream.

d.note: Ruby hibiscus ginger cooler over ice with lime
d.how: Steep 20g dried hibiscus and a sliced knob of ginger in 1L boiling water with 100g sugar for 10 minutes. Strain, chill and pour over ice with lime wedges.

s.note: Warm dill potatoes with pickled herring and sour cream
s.how: Boil 600g new potatoes with dill until tender. Serve warm with 250g pickled herring, a bowl of sour cream with chives and thinly sliced red onion.

s.note: A ring of crudités and edible flowers with dill dip
s.how: Arrange radishes, cucumber batons and baby carrots in a ring on a platter, tucking edible flowers between them like a crown. Mix 200g sour cream with dill and salt for the dip in the middle.

m.note: Home-cured salmon with sweet mustard dill sauce and rye
m.how: Cover a 600g salmon fillet with 50g salt, 50g sugar, chopped dill and white pepper. Weight and cure in the fridge for 48 hours. Slice thin. Mix 2 tbsp Dijon, 1 tbsp sugar, vinegar and oil with dill for sauce. Serve with rye bread.

w.note: Three-layer sponge with custard, cream and strawberries
w.how: Whisk 4 eggs with 150g sugar until thick and fold in 150g flour. Bake at 175C for 25 minutes and split into three. Brush each layer with milk and fill with 250ml custard, 300ml whipped cream and sliced strawberries. Top with whole berries.

d.note: Elderflower sparkling water with edible flowers
d.how: Add 40ml elderflower cordial to each of four glasses of ice. Top with chilled sparkling water and a squeeze of lemon. Float a few edible flowers on top.

s.note: Charred corn with lime mayo, feta and chilli
s.how: Grill 4 corn cobs until charred. Brush with 4 tbsp mayo mixed with lime juice. Roll in 100g crumbled feta, dust with chilli powder and coriander, and scatter a few orange nasturtium petals on top.

s.note: Pork and red chilli tamales steamed in corn husks, Abuelita style.
s.how: Simmer 500g pork shoulder until tender, shred and mix with 4 tbsp red chilli sauce. Beat 300g masa harina with 100g lard, 1 tsp baking powder and 400ml warm stock to a soft dough. Spread on 16 soaked corn husks, add pork, fold and steam 60 minutes. Serve with salsa.

m.note: Red chilli chicken enchiladas with crema and onion
m.how: Soak 4 dried chillies, blitz with a garlic clove and 300ml stock and simmer. Poach and shred 600g chicken thighs. Dip 8 corn tortillas in sauce, roll with chicken and 100g cheese, cover with sauce and 100g more cheese. Bake at 190C for 20 minutes.

w.note: Orange-scented sugared buns with dough bones on top
w.how: Mix 450g flour, 7g yeast, 80g sugar, orange zest, 3 eggs, 80g soft butter and 100ml warm water and prove 2 hours. Shape 6 rounds with dough bones on top, prove again and bake at 180C for 30 minutes. Brush with 40g butter and roll in sugar.

d.note: Thick chocolate masa drink with cinnamon
d.how: Whisk 50g masa harina into 250ml water until smooth. Heat 1L milk with 100g dark chocolate, a cinnamon stick and 60g brown sugar, then whisk in the masa. Simmer, stirring, until thick and silky. Pour into mugs.

s.note: Tomato lentil soup in mugs with grilled cheese fingers for dunking
s.how: Soften an onion and 2 garlic cloves with 1 tsp cumin. Add 2 tins crushed tomatoes, 150g red lentils and 800ml water and simmer 25 minutes, then blend smooth. Serve in mugs with grilled cheese fingers made from 4 slices bread and 100g cheddar.

s.note: Crisp Filipino pork spring rolls with sweet chilli
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with 1 grated carrot, 1 onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 egg and 1 tbsp soy. Roll thin logs in 20 spring roll wrappers and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Serve with sweet chilli sauce.

m.note: Spaghetti and meatballs with garlic bread and parmesan
m.how: Roll 600g beef mince with breadcrumbs, egg and parmesan into balls and brown. Simmer 40 minutes in 2 tins tomatoes with garlic. Toss with 500g spaghetti. Split a baguette, spread with garlic butter and bake 12 minutes.

w.note: Custard-filled doughnuts rolled in caster sugar
w.how: Mix 350g flour, 7g yeast, 40g butter, 1 egg, 2 tbsp sugar and 180ml warm water and rest an hour. Cut rounds, prove 30 minutes and fry at 175C until golden. Pipe in 300ml thick custard and roll in 100g caster sugar.

d.note: Silky flat whites with strong espresso
d.how: Brew 4 strong espressos with 72g ground coffee. Steam 600ml milk until silky with fine bubbles. Pour over the coffee in four cups. Drink it while the world forgets who you are.

s.note: Crisp-bottomed pork dumplings with vinegar and chilli oil
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with 2 cups shredded wombok, 1 tbsp grated ginger and 2 spring onions. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers, pleat and fry until crisp underneath. Add water, cover and steam 4 minutes. Serve with black vinegar and chilli oil.

s.note: Beef and pork pelmeni in butter with sour cream and dill.
s.how: Mix 200g beef mince, 200g pork mince and 1 grated onion with salt and pepper. Fill 32 dumpling wrappers, fold into little hats and pinch closed. Boil until they float plus 3 minutes, toss in 30g butter and serve with 150g sour cream and chopped dill.

m.note: Rich butter chicken style curry with basmati and naan
m.how: Soften an onion with ginger and garlic, add 2 tsp garam masala and a tin of tomatoes. Add 1kg diced chicken thighs and simmer 25 minutes. Stir in 200ml cream and a pinch of kasoori methi. Serve with 300g basmati and 4 naan.

w.note: Crisp meringue clouds with cream and passionfruit
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites with 180g caster sugar to stiff glossy peaks. Pipe into clouds and bake at 100C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Serve with 300ml whipped cream and the pulp of 4 passionfruit.

d.note: Fresh orange juice topped with sparkling water
d.how: Squeeze 8 oranges into a jug and chill. Fill 4 glasses with ice, half fill with juice and top with sparkling water. Serve straight away while it is still ice cold.

s.note: Bright tropical fruit skewers with lime honey chilli
s.how: Cut a quarter watermelon, 2 kiwifruit, a quarter pineapple and a dragonfruit into chunks and thread onto skewers. Drizzle with lime juice, honey and a pinch of chilli. Arrange in a rainbow.

s.note: Sesame sausage rolls with tomato sauce
s.how: Mix 500g pork sausage mince with a grated onion and carrot and herbs. Roll in 2 sheets puff pastry, egg wash, sprinkle with sesame and cut into 16. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve warm with plenty of tomato sauce for dipping.

m.note: Slow-roasted lemon garlic lamb shoulder with mint yoghurt
m.how: Rub a 1.8kg lamb shoulder with 4 garlic cloves, rosemary and lemon. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with chopped mint to serve.

w.note: Chocolate cornflake biscuits with icing and a walnut
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 100g sugar, add 180g flour, 2 tbsp cocoa and 50g cornflakes. Bake 16 mounds at 180C for 14 minutes. Ice with 150g icing sugar mixed with 1 tbsp cocoa and water, and top each with half a walnut.

d.note: A big jug of lager topped up all night
d.how: Chill 3L of lager and keep a big jug of it on the table with ice packs around it. Top every mug up the moment it gets low, all night long. Another!

s.note: PB and jam, and ham and cheese, packed for the bike ride
s.how: Make peanut butter and jam sandwiches and ham, cheddar and butter sandwiches, using 8 slices white bread, 100g ham and 100g cheddar. Cut in half, wrap in paper and pack in a backpack for the quarry.

s.note: Roasted cherry tomatoes on whipped ricotta and toast
s.how: Roast 500g cherry tomatoes on the vine at 200C for 10 minutes with olive oil and thyme. Spread 250g whipped ricotta over toasted sourdough and top with the tomatoes. You'll float too.

m.note: Buttered toasted rolls of lemony lobster
m.how: Chop 400g cooked lobster or prawn meat and fold with 3 tbsp mayo, lemon juice, a diced celery stick and chives. Butter and toast the cut sides of 4 hot dog buns and pile the filling in.

w.note: Red candy-coated cake pops tied with string
w.how: Crumble a 500g vanilla cake into 100g cream cheese beaten with 50g icing sugar. Roll into 16 balls, push in lollipop sticks and chill. Dip in 300g melted red candy melts and tie a bit of string to each like a balloon.

d.note: Fresh summer lemonade with ice and lemon slices
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Mix with the juice of 5 lemons and 1L cold water in a big jug. Add ice and lemon slices and pour into four glasses after the bike ride.

s.note: Steamed pork and chive dumplings with soy vinegar dip
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with a chopped bunch of garlic chives and 1 tbsp grated ginger. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers, pleat and steam 8 minutes. Serve with soy and Chinkiang vinegar, and pour the tea carefully.

s.note: Wok-tossed garlic chilli edamame with flaky salt
s.how: Steam 500g edamame for 4 minutes. Toss in a hot wok with 2 sliced garlic cloves, chilli flakes and a splash of soy. Finish with plenty of flaky salt and serve in a big bowl.

m.note: Silky ginger congee with a smiling egg and bacon face
m.how: Simmer 200g jasmine rice in 2L chicken stock with sliced ginger for 90 minutes, stirring often, until silky. Fry 4 eggs and 8 rashers bacon. Top each bowl with an egg and bacon smile, spring onion and soy.

w.note: Golden lotus seed mooncakes pressed in moulds
w.how: Mix 100g golden syrup, 30ml oil and a little alkaline water, then 150g flour, and rest 2 hours. Wrap thin portions around 8 balls of lotus seed paste and press into moulds. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes, egg wash and bake 10 more.

d.note: Jasmine tea refilled through the meal
d.how: Heat 1L water to just off the boil. Steep 4 tsp jasmine tea for 3 minutes, then pour into small cups. Keep the pot going and refill through the meal.

s.note: Creamy chicken congee with fried shallots
s.how: Simmer 150g jasmine rice in 1.5L chicken stock with ginger for 90 minutes until creamy. Poach and shred a chicken breast. Top bowls with the chicken, spring onion, soy and fried shallots.

s.note: Sticky hoisin honey pork in steamed bao
s.how: Roast 600g pork scotch fillet brushed with 4 tbsp hoisin and 2 tbsp honey at 200C for 35 minutes until sticky, then slice. Steam 12 bao buns and fill with pork, sliced cucumber and spring onion.

m.note: Steamed whole snapper with ginger, spring onion and sizzling oil
m.how: Score a 1.2kg whole snapper and steam over sliced ginger and spring onion for 12 minutes. Top with fresh spring onion, pour over 3 tbsp soy, then 4 tbsp smoking hot oil. Serve with 300g jasmine rice and bok choy.

w.note: Mango pudding topped with mango slices like scales
w.how: Blitz 2 mangoes with 60g sugar. Soak 4 gelatine sheets, dissolve in a little warm purée and stir through with 375ml evaporated milk. Set in glasses for 4 hours and top with thin mango slices laid like scales.

d.note: Brown sugar milk tea over chewy tapioca pearls
d.how: Cook 150g tapioca pearls as the packet says and soak in syrup made from 100g brown sugar and 100ml water. Brew 4 black tea bags in 500ml water and mix with 500ml milk. Pour over the pearls and ice.

s.note: Blistered flatbreads with homemade dukkah and labneh
s.how: Toast and pound 50g hazelnuts, 2 tbsp sesame seeds, 1 tsp cumin and a pinch of cinnamon with salt. Brush 4 flatbreads with oil and bake at 220C until blistered. Sprinkle with the dukkah and serve with 250g labneh.

s.note: Stuffed dates with honey and orange, figs and apricots
s.how: Split 12 medjool dates, fill with goat's cheese and a walnut, and drizzle with honey and orange zest. Arrange on a board with 100g dried apricots and 100g dried figs.

m.note: Saffron apricot lamb tagine over herbed couscous
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced lamb shoulder. Soften 2 onions with 2 tbsp ras el hanout and a pinch of saffron. Add 500ml water, 150g dried apricots and a tin of chickpeas and cook covered for 3 hours. Serve over 300g couscous with herbs.

w.note: Thick cinnamon spirals with cardamom icing
w.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 250ml warm milk and 50g butter and prove an hour. Roll out, spread with 60g butter, 80g brown sugar and cinnamon. Roll, cut thick spirals and bake at 190C for 22 minutes. Glaze with icing sugar and cardamom.

d.note: Orange blossom water poured carefully, nothing wasted
d.how: Fill a jug with chilled water, a few drops of orange blossom water, sliced orange, mint and ice. Pour carefully into small glasses so not a drop is wasted.

s.note: Shredded chilli beef tacos with onion and lime
s.how: Braise 800g beef chuck with 3 soaked dried chillies, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin for 3 hours until it shreds. Serve in 16 warm corn tortillas with white onion, coriander and lime.

s.note: Fresh corn and chilli fritters with sour cream
s.how: Cut the kernels off 3 corn cobs. Whisk 120g flour, 2 eggs and 125ml milk, then fold in the corn, 2 spring onions and a chopped chilli. Fry spoonfuls until golden and serve with sour cream.

m.note: Pork chops with apple onion gravy and mash
m.how: Season 4 pork chops and pan-fry 4 minutes a side. Fry 1 sliced onion and 1 sliced apple in the pan, add 300ml chicken stock and 1 tsp mustard and reduce. Serve with 800g potatoes mashed with butter and 300g steamed green beans.

w.note: Lattice peach pie with vanilla ice cream
w.how: Toss 6 sliced peaches with 100g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 2 tbsp cornflour. Line a dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes. Serve with ice cream.

d.note: Neat bourbon, one ice cube if the day was long
d.how: Pour 60ml bourbon neat into each of four heavy glasses. Add a single ice cube to any glass where the day was long. Drink it slowly on the porch.

s.note: Crisp cheesy potato rounds with smiles pressed in
s.how: Mash 600g boiled potatoes with 80g grated cheddar, 2 tbsp flour and 20g butter. Roll out 1cm thick and cut rounds. Press in two eyes and a wide smile with a straw and spoon. Bake at 220C for 15 minutes until crisp.

s.note: Crunchy bite-size fried chicken with honey mustard
s.how: Soak 600g diced chicken thigh in 250ml buttermilk for 1 hour. Toss in 150g flour seasoned with paprika, garlic powder and salt and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Serve with 4 tbsp honey mixed with 3 tbsp Dijon.

m.note: Lemon dill butter salmon with crushed potatoes and beans
m.how: Roast 4 salmon fillets skin side down at 220C for 8 minutes. Melt 60g butter with lemon juice and dill and spoon over. Crush 800g boiled potatoes with butter. Steam 300g green beans.

w.note: Pale yellow cookies with a wide, unsettling red smile
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Cut rounds and bake at 180C for 8 minutes. Ice pale yellow with 300g icing sugar and pipe a wide red smile on each. A little unsettling.

d.note: Calming chamomile tea with lemon and honey
d.how: Steep 4 chamomile tea bags in 1L boiling water for 5 minutes. Pour into mugs with a slice of lemon and a spoon of honey. Breathe out.

s.note: Puffed spinach, feta and ricotta pastries
s.how: Wilt 250g spinach, squeeze dry and mix with 150g feta, 150g ricotta, a crushed garlic clove and nutmeg. Spoon onto 2 sheets puff pastry cut into squares, fold, egg wash and bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Pull the lever.

s.note: Quinoa with corn, black beans and a lime cumin dressing
s.how: Cook 200g quinoa and cool. Toss with 200g corn kernels, a drained tin of black beans, 2 diced tomatoes, red onion and coriander. Dress with lime juice, olive oil and 1 tsp cumin.

m.note: Grilled cheddar onion burgers with chips
m.how: Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 patties and grill hot. Melt cheddar on top and serve on toasted buns with grilled onion and pickles. Fry 1kg potato chips twice. Special for two, or four.

w.note: Chocolate fudge birthday cake with candles
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 200g butter, whisk in 4 eggs and 200g sugar and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 175C for 35 minutes. Frost with 300g icing sugar beaten with 40g cocoa and 80g butter, then add candles.

d.note: Purple corn drink spiced with cinnamon and clove
d.how: Simmer 250g purple corn with the peel of a pineapple, a cinnamon stick and 4 cloves in 2L water for 45 minutes. Strain, sweeten and chill. Serve with lime juice and diced apple.

s.note: Cheddar, ham, pickles and crusty bread on a pub board
s.how: Lay out 250g aged cheddar, 150g sliced ham, pickled onions, tomato chutney and a sliced green apple on a board. Add thick slices of crusty bread and a dish of butter.

s.note: Crisp ham croquetas with a creamy middle
s.how: Melt 60g butter, stir in 80g flour and whisk in 500ml milk until very thick. Add 200g chopped ham and chill overnight. Shape into logs, crumb in 2 eggs and 150g panko and fry until golden.

m.note: Butter-basted rib eye with peppercorn cream and crisp potatoes
m.how: Roast 1kg potatoes at 220C for 45 minutes. Sear 4 rib eyes hard, baste with 40g butter and rest 5 minutes. Crush 1 tbsp peppercorns into the pan, add 250ml cream and reduce. Pour over.

w.note: Dark and white fudge squares set out like a chess board
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with half a tin of condensed milk and 20g butter and set in a lined tray. Repeat with 200g white chocolate and the rest of the milk in another tray. Cut into squares and arrange like a chess board.

d.note: Stirred gin martini with an olive
d.how: For each drink, stir 60ml gin and 10ml dry vermouth over ice for 30 seconds. Strain into a chilled glass and add a green olive. Makes four.

s.note: Charred miso garlic chicken skewers with sesame sauce
s.how: Marinate 600g diced chicken thighs in 2 tbsp white miso and 2 crushed garlic cloves for an hour. Thread onto skewers and grill until charred. Mix soy, sesame oil and spring onion for dipping. No grubs, promise.

s.note: Crisp pork gyoza with soy vinegar and chilli oil
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with 2 cups shredded wombok, salted and squeezed. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers and pleat. Fry until crisp underneath, add water and steam 4 minutes. Serve with soy, black vinegar and chilli oil.

m.note: Rib eye with mash, beans and red wine jus, dinner for two
m.how: Sear 2 rib eyes hard, rest and slice. Mash 1kg potatoes with butter. Steam 300g green beans. Reduce 150ml red wine with 250ml stock into a jus. Plate it like a proper dinner and pour the jus over.

w.note: Vanilla panna cotta under crushed meringue snow
w.how: Soak 3 gelatine sheets. Warm 400ml cream, 200ml milk, 80g sugar and a split vanilla bean, then stir in the gelatine. Set in glasses overnight. Crush 2 meringue nests over the top like falling snow.

d.note: Scotch neat or over one big cube
d.how: Pour 45ml Scotch whisky into each of four heavy tumblers, neat or over one large cube with a splash of water. Sip it slowly in an empty casino.

s.note: Kid-sized ham cheese sandwiches, apples, strawberries and juice
s.how: Make little ham and cheddar sandwiches from 8 slices white bread, 100g ham and 100g cheddar. Slice 2 apples and hull 250g strawberries. Lay it all on a picnic rug with juice boxes of apple juice.

s.note: Spiced beef hard shell tacos laid out for anyone
s.how: Brown 500g beef mince with 1 tsp cumin and taco spices. Fill 12 hard taco shells with the beef, shredded lettuce, 100g grated cheddar and diced tomato. Lay them out for whoever wanders in.

m.note: Double smashed cheeseburgers with crinkle fries
m.how: Smash 8 thin patties from 800g chuck mince on a smoking griddle and add American cheese. Stack two per soft toasted bun with pickles, onion, tomato sauce and mustard. Fry 1kg crinkle-cut potatoes twice.

w.note: Chocolate fudge layer cake piped with 3000
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 200g butter, whisk in 4 eggs and 200g sugar and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes. Layer with fudge frosting of 300g icing sugar, cocoa and butter. Pipe 3000 on top in red.

d.note: Juice boxes for the kids, cold lager for the grown-ups
d.how: Fill an esky with ice. Bury 4 juice boxes of apple juice for the kids and six 375ml bottles of lager for the grown-ups. Hand them out by the lake.

s.note: Stacked marshmallow men with chocolate faces
s.how: Stack 2 big marshmallows on each of 12 bamboo skewers. Pipe eyes and a smile on each with 50g melted dark chocolate. Toast half of them with a blowtorch for the full effect.

s.note: Cornmeal-fried okra rounds with hot sauce
s.how: Slice 500g okra into 1cm rounds, toss in 150ml buttermilk, then in 150g cornmeal mixed with 50g flour, salt and pepper. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes until crisp and serve with hot sauce.

m.note: Smashed diner cheeseburgers with crinkle fries
m.how: Smash 8 thin patties from 800g chuck mince on a smoking griddle and add American cheese. Stack two per soft bun with pickles, onion and burger sauce of mayo and relish. Fry 1kg crinkle-cut potatoes twice.

w.note: Chocolate pie under a tall torched marshmallow meringue
w.how: Press 250g crushed biscuits with 100g melted butter into a pie tin. Pour in 200g dark chocolate melted with 200ml cream and set. Whisk 3 whites with 150g sugar over hot water, beat stiff, pile tall and torch until blistered.

d.note: Thick vanilla diner shakes with cream and a cherry
d.how: For each shake, blend 3 scoops vanilla ice cream with 150ml cold milk and a drop of vanilla until thick. Pour into tall glasses and top with whipped cream and a cherry.

s.note: Sesame-trail lavash crackers with whipped feta dip.
s.how: Brush 2 sheets lavash with olive oil and sprinkle 1 tbsp each black and white sesame seeds in winding trails. Bake at 180C for 8 minutes until crisp and snap into shards. Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and a little oil for dipping.

s.note: Crisp rolled chicken and cheese taquitos.
s.how: Mix 300g shredded cooked chicken with 100g grated cheddar and 2 tbsp salsa. Roll a spoonful tightly in each of 12 warmed small corn tortillas, brush with oil and bake seam-side down at 220C for 15 minutes until crisp. Serve with sour cream.

m.note: Toasted chicken, rice and bean burritos
m.how: Grill 600g chicken thighs and slice. Cook 200g rice. Fill 4 large flour tortillas with chicken, rice, a tin of black beans, 100g cheddar, salsa and sour cream. Roll tight and toast in a dry pan.

w.note: Three-scoop sundaes with hot fudge and a cherry
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream. Scoop vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream into four bowls. Pour over the fudge and add whipped cream, sprinkles and a cherry.

d.note: Mint lemonade in shot glasses, everything shrunk
d.how: Dissolve 120g sugar in 120ml hot water and cool. Mix with the juice of 4 lemons, crushed mint and 750ml cold water. Pour into shot glasses on a tray so everything looks shrunk.

s.note: Shaved steak and onions under provolone in mini rolls
s.how: Freeze a 400g rib eye for 30 minutes and shave thin. Sear with a sliced onion in oil. Lay 6 slices provolone over to melt, then pile onto 12 toasted slider buns.

s.note: Crisp potato gems with garlic salt and parmesan
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen potato gems at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp. Toss straight away with 1 tsp garlic salt and 40g grated parmesan and serve with tomato sauce.

m.note: Chicken and saffron yellow rice in one pot
m.how: Brown 1kg chicken thighs, then soften 1 onion and 1 red capsicum. Add 300g rice, a pinch of saffron, 1 tsp paprika and 750ml stock and nestle in the chicken. Cover and bake at 180C for 35 minutes, then stir through 100g peas and olives.

w.note: Chunky rocky road with marshmallows, almonds and biscuits
w.how: Melt 400g dark chocolate. Stir through 150g marshmallows, 100g roasted almonds, 100g broken plain sweet biscuits and 30g coconut. Press into a lined tin, chill until set and cut into chunks.

d.note: Rich spiced eggnog with nutmeg, brandy on the side
d.how: Whisk 4 egg yolks with 100g sugar. Heat 600ml milk, 200ml cream, a cinnamon stick and nutmeg until steaming, then whisk slowly into the yolks and cook gently until it coats a spoon. Chill, then serve with grated nutmeg and 120ml brandy on the side.

s.note: Rosemary brown sugar nuts and pretzels, bagged for the trip
s.how: Toss 150g almonds, 150g cashews and 100g pretzels with oil, chopped rosemary, 2 tbsp brown sugar and flaky salt. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes and cool. Bag them up for the trip that never happens.

s.note: Mini beef pies with tomato sauce on top
s.how: Cook 500g beef mince with an onion and 250ml stock until thick and cool. Line patty tins with 2 sheets shortcrust, fill, top with 2 sheets puff and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Squirt tomato sauce on top.

m.note: Orange mustard glazed ham with potato salad and beans
m.how: Score a 3kg leg ham and glaze with 150g brown sugar, 2 tbsp Dijon and the juice of 2 oranges. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes, basting often. Serve with potato salad of 1kg potatoes and 300g green beans.

w.note: Sherry trifle with jelly, custard, cream and berries
w.how: Cut a sponge cake into chunks in a bowl and drizzle with 60ml sweet sherry. Pour over a packet of raspberry jelly and set. Layer with 500ml custard and 300ml whipped cream and top with raspberries. Chill overnight.

d.note: Cranberry orange punch with ginger ale
d.how: Mix 500ml cranberry juice and 500ml orange juice in a big bowl. Top with 1L ginger ale and add sliced oranges and a handful of frozen cranberries.

s.note: Hot party pies and sausage rolls with tomato sauce
s.how: Heat 12 frozen party pies as the packet says. Roll 400g sausage mince in 2 sheets puff pastry, egg wash, cut into 16 and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with tomato sauce in a squeeze bottle.

s.note: Warm damper with butter and golden syrup
s.how: Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour and salt. Mix in 300ml milk with a knife until just combined. Shape, score and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Serve warm with butter and golden syrup.

m.note: Roast topside with pumpkin, potatoes, peas and tin gravy
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg topside at 200C to 52C and rest. Roast 800g potatoes and 600g pumpkin. Cook 300g peas. Stir 2 tbsp flour into the roasting tin, add 400ml stock and simmer into gravy.

w.note: Chocolate coconut lamingtons on a rack
w.how: Bake a butter sponge from 125g butter, 150g sugar, 2 eggs and 200g self-raising flour and cut into cubes. Dip in icing of 300g icing sugar, 30g cocoa and milk and roll in 200g desiccated coconut. Set on a rack.

d.note: Strong coffee over condensed milk and ice, Saigon style.
d.how: Brew 500ml very strong coffee from 60g dark ground coffee. Put 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk in each of 4 glasses, pour over the hot coffee and stir. Fill with ice and serve straight away.

s.note: Garlic broccolini tray pizza, actually good
s.how: Press 500g pizza dough into an oiled tray. Brush with garlic oil, top with 200g mozzarella and a bunch of broccolini cut small. Bake at 240C for 15 minutes until crisp at the edges. Finish with parmesan and chilli flakes.

s.note: Cheese balls in five colours, one for each feeling
s.how: Beat 250g cream cheese with 150g grated cheddar. Roll into small balls and coat in five colours: paprika, chopped parsley, sesame, crushed pistachio and black sesame. Chill until firm.

m.note: Crackling lemon rosemary chicken thighs on potatoes
m.how: Rub 1kg chicken thighs with lemon zest, 3 garlic cloves and rosemary. Roast at 220C for 35 minutes on a tray of 800g halved potatoes until the skin crackles. Steam 300g green beans and toss with butter.

w.note: Cupcakes iced in five feeling colours
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 at 175C for 18 minutes. Split buttercream from 150g butter and 300g icing sugar into five bowls, tint yellow, blue, red, purple and green.

d.note: Pink vanilla strawberry milkshake topped with fairy floss
d.how: Blend 1L vanilla ice cream with 500ml cold milk and 250g strawberries until thick. Pour into 4 glasses and top each with a tuft of pink fairy floss just before serving so it starts to melt into the shake.

s.note: Mini almond croissants dusted with icing sugar
s.how: Beat 60g butter, 60g sugar, 60g almond meal and an egg. Split 4 day-old croissants, fill with almond cream, top with flaked almonds and bake at 180C for 15 minutes. Dust with icing sugar.

s.note: Warm olives, rosemary almonds and parmesan crisps
s.how: Warm 250g olives in oil with orange peel and fennel seeds. Roast 150g almonds at 170C with rosemary and salt. Bake small rounds of 100g grated parmesan at 190C for 6 minutes. Serve in little bowls.

m.note: Tarragon butter roast chicken with pommes purée
m.how: Push 60g butter mixed with tarragon under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken and roast at 220C then 180C for 70 minutes. Rest and carve. Mash 1kg potatoes with 100g butter until silky. Serve with leaves in Dijon vinaigrette.

w.note: Dark chocolate tart with flaky salt and gold stars
w.how: Blind-bake a tart tin lined with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust at 180C. Pour in 250g dark chocolate melted into 250ml cream and set 3 hours. Finish with flaky salt and a scatter of edible gold stars.

d.note: Bourbon old fashioned stirred over a big cube
d.how: For each drink, stir 60ml bourbon with a sugar cube and 2 dashes aromatic bitters over ice for 30 seconds. Strain over a big cube and twist orange peel over the top. Makes four.

s.note: Smoked salmon on rye and spicy orange olives on black slate
s.how: Cut 4 slices rye into small squares and spread with creme fraiche. Top each with a fold of smoked salmon. Warm the olives in a pan with strips of orange peel and a pinch of chilli flakes for 3 minutes, then serve both on a dark board.

s.note: Salty pretzels shaped into question marks with mustard for dipping
s.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast, a pinch of sugar and 300ml warm water into a dough and rest an hour. Roll into ropes and shape into question marks. Dip in boiling water with 2 tbsp bicarb soda, sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes.

m.note: Dark beef and stout stew over buttery mash on a wet night
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Add 2 sliced onions and soften, then pour in 375ml stout and enough water to cover. Add thyme, cover and simmer gently for 3 hours until tender. Boil 1kg potatoes, mash with plenty of butter and serve the stew on top.

w.note: Rich dark chocolate pots topped with cream and crushed honeycomb
w.how: Heat 300ml cream until steaming and pour over 200g chopped dark chocolate. Whisk 3 yolks with 50g sugar and stir through until glossy. Pour into 4 small glasses and chill for 4 hours. Top with whipped cream and a scatter of crushed honeycomb just before serving.

d.note: Vodka, coffee liqueur and espresso, shaken frothy
d.how: Shake 45ml vodka, 20ml coffee liqueur and 30ml cooled espresso hard with ice. Strain into 4 chilled coupes and top each with 3 coffee beans.

s.note: Roasted almonds and cashews tossed with orange zest, sugar and salt
s.how: Roast 200g almonds and 200g cashews at 180C for 10 minutes. Toss while hot with the zest of one orange, a tablespoon of sugar and a good pinch of sea salt flakes. Cool on the tray, then serve in a bowl beside some orange-flavoured mints.

s.note: Mini cheeseburgers held together with a toothpick, ready for a call
s.how: Shape 500g beef mince into 8 small patties and season well. Fry for 2 minutes a side, adding a slice of cheddar to each at the end. Split 8 slider buns, add tomato sauce and pickles, then stack the patties in and push a toothpick through each one.

m.note: Beef, vegetables and creamy mushroom sauce under rows of potato gems
m.how: Brown 500g beef mince with a diced onion. Add 200g sliced mushrooms and cook down, then stir in a cup each of corn and green beans and 300ml cream. Spread in a baking dish, cover with neat rows of potato gems and bake at 200C for 35 minutes until golden.

w.note: Bright blue jelly cups topped with lemon sorbet and cream
w.how: Make up 2 packets of blue jelly to the packet directions and pour into 4 clear cups. Chill for 3 hours until set. Just before serving, top each with a scoop of lemon sorbet and a little whipped cream, then add a straw and a spoon.

d.note: Fresh orange juice in a big jug with mango and fizz
d.how: Juice 8 oranges into a big jug over plenty of ice. Stir in 250ml mango nectar, then top up with 500ml cold soda water just before serving so it keeps some fizz. Add a few orange slices to the jug and pour into tall glasses.

s.note: Grilled lemon and oregano lamb in warm pita with garlic yoghurt
s.how: Cut 600g lamb shoulder into strips and marinate in lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano and olive oil for an hour. Grill on high until charred. Wrap small pieces in torn warm pita with sliced tomato, onion and a spoon of garlic yoghurt, then pin with toothpicks.

s.note: Slow-cooked French onion dip with thick ridged potato chips
s.how: Slice 3 onions thinly and cook in butter over low heat for 40 minutes until deep golden. Cool, then fold through 300ml sour cream and 125g softened cream cheese with chopped chives and salt. Chill for an hour and serve with a big bowl of ridged potato chips.

m.note: Crumbed chicken with ham, Napoli and melted mozzarella, chips and salad
m.how: Halve 2 chicken breasts and crumb them in flour, egg and panko. Shallow fry until golden and cooked through. Top with sliced ham, a spoon of crushed tomato simmered with garlic, and grated mozzarella. Grill until bubbling and serve with hot chips and a green salad.

w.note: Thick custard between puff pastry layers with passionfruit icing
w.how: Bake 2 puff pastry sheets flat between trays at 200C until crisp. Whisk 750ml milk, 3 eggs, 150g sugar and 80g cornflour over heat until very thick. Spread between the sheets in a lined tin. Ice with icing mixed with passionfruit pulp, chill overnight and cut.

d.note: Cold Australian lager in pot glasses with a bowl of chips
d.how: Chill the lager and the pot glasses in the fridge for at least an hour. Pour each one slowly down the side of the tilted glass, straightening up at the end for a small head. Set a bowl of chips on the bench for everyone to share.

s.note: Blueberry muffins with crumble tops, fresh from the Muffin Man
s.how: Mix 300g flour, 150g sugar and 2 tsp baking powder. Add 250ml buttermilk, 100g melted butter and an egg and stir only until just combined. Fold in 200g blueberries, spoon into a lined muffin tin, scatter with crumble and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

s.note: Shiny red toffee apple wedges set on paper, a little suspicious
s.how: Cut 4 apples into thick wedges and pat dry. Boil 300g sugar, 100ml water, a spoon of golden syrup and red colouring to 150C. Dip each wedge quickly and set on oiled baking paper. Leave to harden for 10 minutes and serve the same day.

m.n: Far Far Away royal roast pork
m.note: Roast pork with crackling, apple sauce and potatoes
m.how: Score a 2kg pork shoulder, rub with salt and roast at 230C for 30 minutes, then 170C for 2 hours. Roast 1kg potatoes for the last hour. Serve with 200g apple sauce.

w.note: One huge gingerbread man plus little ones with gumdrop buttons
w.how: Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 120ml golden syrup together. Stir in 375g flour, 2 tsp ginger and a pinch of cinnamon. Chill for an hour, roll out and cut one huge gingerbread man and lots of small ones. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes, then ice with gumdrop buttons.

d.note: Sparkling blue lemonade with a swirl of edible glitter
d.how: Pour cold lemonade into small glass bottles or tall glasses. Add a splash of blue raspberry cordial to each and stir gently. Drop in a small pinch of edible glitter and give it one more swirl so it shimmers as it settles. Serve straight away.

s.note: Bacon-wrapped prunes stuffed with blue cheese.
s.how: Stuff 24 pitted prunes with a small piece of blue cheese, 100g in total. Wrap each in half a rasher of streaky bacon, using 12 rashers, and secure with a toothpick. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes until the bacon is crisp.

s.note: Twisted parmesan pastry straws cut thin like cell bars
s.how: Brush a sheet of puff pastry with beaten egg and cover with grated parmesan and a pinch of paprika. Cut into thin strips like cell bars, twist each a few times and lay on a lined tray. Bake at 200C for 12 minutes until puffed and golden.

m.note: Buttery deep dish pizza with sausage and chunky tomato sauce
m.how: Press pizza dough mixed with melted butter into a deep greased tin. Layer sliced mozzarella first, then crumbled Italian sausage, then crushed tomatoes simmered with garlic. Finish with grated parmesan and bake at 220C for 35 minutes. Rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

w.note: Sparkling wine jelly with raspberries, set so the bubbles stay trapped
w.how: Soak 5 gelatine leaves in cold water. Warm 150ml water with 100g sugar, then squeeze the gelatine and stir in to dissolve. Cool slightly, then gently stir in 500ml cold sparkling wine. Pour into coupes over a few raspberries and chill for 4 hours.

d.note: Gin, lemon and sugar shaken hard and topped with soda
d.how: For each drink, shake 45ml gin, 25ml lemon juice and 15ml sugar syrup hard with ice. Strain into a tall glass over fresh ice and top with cold soda water. Make the syrup ahead by dissolving equal parts sugar and hot water, then cooling.

s.note: Buttery caramel popcorn served in red and white striped cones
s.how: Pop 100g popping corn in a large lidded pot. Melt 50g butter with 50g brown sugar until bubbling and toss through the popcorn with a pinch of sea salt flakes. Spread out to cool for 5 minutes, then pour into red and white striped paper cones.

s.note: Soft pretzels shaped as question marks
s.how: Roll 500g pizza dough into 8 ropes and shape each into a question mark with a dot. Dip in 1L water simmering with 3 tbsp bicarb soda for 20 seconds, sprinkle with salt flakes and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Serve with mustard.

m.note: Sticky sweet chilli chicken noodles served in takeaway boxes
m.how: Stir-fry 500g sliced chicken thighs in a hot wok until browned. Add a sliced red capsicum and cook for 2 minutes. Toss through 400g cooked egg noodles with 4 tbsp sweet chilli sauce and 2 tbsp soy sauce until sticky, then pack into takeaway boxes.

w.note: Swirled fried batter dusted in icing sugar with strawberries
w.how: Whisk 200g flour, 2 eggs, 250ml milk and a spoon of sugar into a smooth batter. Pipe in looping swirls into 180C oil and fry until golden on both sides. Drain on paper, dust thickly with icing sugar and serve warm with sliced strawberries.

d.note: Lime cordial and lemonade with vanilla ice cream floating on top
d.how: Pour a splash of lime cordial into each tall glass and top up with cold lemonade. Gently add a scoop of vanilla ice cream so it floats and fizzes up green. Serve straight away with a long spoon and a straw before the foam spills over.

s.note: Carrot and cucumber sticks standing in cups over a herby ranch dip
s.how: Mix 200ml sour cream, 100ml mayonnaise, a crushed garlic clove and chopped dill and chives into a ranch dip. Spoon some into the bottom of small cups. Stand baby carrots and cucumber sticks upright in each cup so everyone gets their own serve.

s.note: Cheese balls rolled in paprika and corn chip crumbs like basketballs
s.how: Mix 200g grated cheddar, 250g cream cheese and 2 sliced spring onions. Roll into small balls and coat in smoked paprika mixed with crushed corn chips so they look like basketballs. Mark the lines with a chive or skewer and serve chilled with water crackers.

m.note: Beef and pork meatballs in tomato sauce, piled into long rolls
m.how: Mix 250g beef mince and 250g pork mince with salt, roll into balls and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Simmer in crushed tomatoes for 15 minutes. Pile into long rolls, cover with mozzarella and grill until bubbly, then finish with torn basil.

w.note: Chocolate pudding cups with biscuit dirt and gummy worms crawling out
w.how: Whisk 750ml milk, 3 tbsp cornflour and 80g sugar over heat until thick, then stir in 100g dark chocolate until smooth. Pour into cups and chill for 2 hours. Top with crushed chocolate biscuits and push in gummy worms so they look like they are crawling out.

d.note: Ice-cold water bottles with a splash of orange juice for a boost
d.how: Fill 4 sports bottles with ice and cold water. Add a good splash of orange juice to each and drop in a couple of orange slices. Shake them up and hand them out to the players who need a little something extra before the second half.

s.note: Braised beef pies with a puff lid and tomato sauce on top
s.how: Braise 800g diced beef chuck in stock and Worcestershire for 2.5 hours until tender, then thicken and cool. Line pie tins with shortcrust, fill with the beef and top with a puff pastry lid. Bake at 200C for 30 minutes and serve with tomato sauce.

s.note: Simple damper baked on the coals with butter and golden syrup
s.how: Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour until crumbly. Mix in 300ml milk with a knife until it just comes together. Shape into a round, score the top and bake at 200C for 30 minutes, or wrap around green sticks over coals. Serve with butter and golden syrup.

m.note: Thick beef snags with fried onions folded into white bread
m.how: Cook 8 thick beef sausages slowly over low coals or a barbecue, turning often until browned and cooked through. Fry 2 sliced onions in butter on the hotplate until soft and golden. Fold each sausage into a slice of white bread with onions and tomato sauce.

w.note: Puffed scone dumplings simmered in buttery golden syrup with cream
w.how: Rub 30g butter into 250g self-raising flour, then mix in 150ml milk to a soft dough. Simmer 375ml water, 2 tbsp golden syrup, 30g butter and 100g brown sugar in a wide pan. Drop in spoonfuls of dough, cover and cook for 20 minutes until puffed. Serve with cream.

d.note: Bush tea boiled in a billy and poured into tin mugs
d.how: Bring water to the boil in a billy or a large pot. Throw in a handful of loose leaf tea, take it off the heat and leave it for a minute. Swing or tap the billy to settle the leaves, then pour into tin mugs with milk and sugar to taste.

s.note: Rough fruity rock cakes, golden outside and still tender inside
s.how: Rub 125g butter into 250g self-raising flour with 75g sugar and a teaspoon of mixed spice. Stir in 150g mixed dried fruit, then bind with an egg and a splash of milk. Drop in rough piles on a tray and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until golden.

s.note: Golden pastry half moons filled with roast pumpkin, feta and sage
s.how: Roast 600g diced pumpkin at 200C until soft, then mash with 100g crumbled feta, chopped sage and a grating of nutmeg. Cut 3 sheets of shortcrust into rounds, fill and fold into half moons. Crimp the edges, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

m.note: Honey mustard drumsticks with roast potatoes, Yorkshire puddings and peas
m.how: Glaze 8 chicken drumsticks with honey and wholegrain mustard and roast at 200C for 40 minutes alongside 1kg potato chunks. Whisk flour, egg and milk into a batter and bake in hot oiled muffin tins for 20 minutes. Serve with buttered peas and gravy.

w.note: Golden syrup and lemon tart with a spoon of clotted cream
w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case. Warm 400g golden syrup with 100g fresh white breadcrumbs, the zest and juice of a lemon, and pour into the case. Bake at 180C for 30 minutes until just set. Cool slightly and serve each slice with a spoon of clotted cream.

d.note: Chilled pumpkin juice blended with apple, honey and cinnamon
d.how: Roast 300g pumpkin until soft and cool it completely. Blend with 1L cloudy apple juice, a spoon of honey and a pinch of cinnamon until smooth. Strain through a sieve into a jug, chill well and pour into goblets for the Great Hall table.

s.note: Chilli and pineapple pork in small corn tortillas with coriander
s.how: Soak dried chillies and blend with orange juice and pineapple to a marinade. Coat 800g pork shoulder and roast at 160C for 3 hours. Slice and crisp in a hot pan. Serve in warm corn tortillas with diced pineapple, onion and coriander.

s.note: Rough smashed guacamole with lime and jalapeno and warm corn chips
s.how: Halve 3 ripe avocados and smash roughly with a fork. Stir in the juice of 2 limes, a finely diced white onion, a chopped jalapeno and a handful of coriander. Season well with salt and serve straight away with warm corn chips for scooping.

m.note: Marinated skirt steak seared hot with rice and black beans
m.how: Marinate 800g skirt steak for 2 hours in lime juice, garlic, ground cumin and a little orange juice. Sear over very high heat for 3 minutes a side, rest and slice thin against the grain. Serve with long grain rice, warmed black beans and charred spring onions.

w.note: Chewy golden coconut sweets baked with condensed milk
w.how: Mix 250g desiccated coconut, 395g condensed milk, 2 egg yolks and 1 tsp vanilla. Spoon 20 small mounds onto a lined tray and bake at 170C for 18 minutes until golden on the edges. Cool on the tray until firm.

d.note: Ice-cold Mexican lager with lime wedges and a pinch of salt
d.how: Bury the bottles in a tub of ice for at least an hour before serving. Cut 2 limes into wedges. Open each bottle, push a wedge of lime into the neck and add a pinch of salt around the rim. Drink it cold, straight from the bottle.

s.note: Dark buttery popcorn with black salt and chilli flakes
s.how: Heat a splash of oil in a large lidded pot and pop 100g popping corn, shaking often. Toss with 50g melted butter, a good pinch of black salt and a small pinch of chilli flakes. Serve in dark bowls by candlelight, the room lit only by the flicker.

s.note: Golden ham and cheese toasties cut into soldiers for dipping
s.how: Butter 8 slices of thick white bread on the outside. Fill 4 sandwiches with sliced cheddar and ham. Cook in a pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melting. Cut each into long soldiers and serve hot.

m.note: Glazed beef meatloaf with mash and gravy, diner style
m.how: Mix 800g beef mince with a grated onion, a cup of breadcrumbs, an egg and salt. Press into a loaf tin and spread with tomato sauce mixed with brown sugar. Bake at 180C for an hour. Serve thick slices with buttery mash and gravy made from beef stock.

w.note: Blackberries under a hot oat crumble
w.how: Toss 750g blackberries with 80g sugar in a dish. Rub 100g butter into 120g flour, 80g oats and 100g brown sugar and scatter over. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes and serve with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: Strong black coffee, or a mug of hot chocolate for Sarah
d.how: Brew a pot of strong black coffee from freshly ground beans. For the hot chocolate, heat 500ml milk until steaming and whisk in 100g chopped dark chocolate until smooth and frothy. Pour both into chunky mugs and listen to the rain on the roof.

s.note: Sticky honey barbecue wings with a ranch dip and celery
s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings with salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Warm 4 tbsp honey with 125ml barbecue sauce and toss the wings through. Mix sour cream with mayonnaise and herbs for a ranch dip, and serve with celery sticks.

s.note: Peanut butter balls half-dipped in dark chocolate.
s.how: Beat 250g smooth peanut butter with 60g soft butter and 2 cups icing sugar until it holds together. Roll into 24 balls and chill for 30 minutes. Dip each in 200g melted dark chocolate, leaving a round of peanut butter showing on top, then chill until set.

m.note: Spiced beef chilli over spaghetti with cheddar
m.how: Brown 600g beef mince with an onion, add 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tbsp chilli powder, 2 tbsp cocoa and 400g tomatoes and simmer 40 minutes. Serve over 400g spaghetti with 200g grated cheddar and diced onion.

w.note: Chocolate cookies shaped like footballs with white icing laces
w.how: Cream 125g butter with 150g brown sugar, beat in an egg, then mix in 250g flour and 40g cocoa. Shape into small footballs and flatten slightly. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes and cool. Pipe white icing laces across the top with icing sugar and a little water.

d.note: Orange and lemon drink with a pinch of salt in big jugs
d.how: Mix 500ml orange juice with the juice of 2 lemons and a small pinch of salt in a big jug. Top up with 1L cold water and plenty of ice. Stir well and pour into paper cups for the players coming off the field at halftime.

s.note: Crisp potato and pea samosas with a sweet tamarind chutney
s.how: Boil 600g potatoes, then crush with 150g peas, cumin, chilli and garam masala. Make a firm dough of flour, oil and water, roll into rounds, cut in half and fold into cones. Fill, seal and fry at 175C until blistered and golden. Serve with tamarind chutney.

s.note: Smoked salmon on rye with lemon creme fraiche, capers and dill
s.how: Butter 4 slices of rye bread and cut into small pieces. Whip 200ml creme fraiche with the zest of a lemon. Top each piece with a fold of smoked salmon, a spoon of the cream, a few capers and a sprig of dill. Finish with cracked black pepper.

m.note: Golden split pea dal tempered with ghee, cumin and garlic
m.how: Simmer 300g yellow split peas with a teaspoon of turmeric in plenty of water for 45 minutes until soft. In a small pan, heat 2 tbsp ghee and fry cumin seeds, sliced garlic and a dried chilli until fragrant, then pour over the dal. Serve with basmati rice.

w.note: Crisp saffron jalebi spirals soaked in warm cardamom syrup
w.how: Mix 200g flour, 100g yoghurt, a pinch of saffron and water into a thick batter and rest overnight. Boil 300g sugar with 200ml water, cardamom and saffron for 5 minutes. Pipe spirals into 170C oil, fry until crisp and soak in the warm syrup for a minute.

d.note: Spiced black tea simmered with milk and poured into small cups
d.how: Bring 500ml water to the boil with a few crushed cardamom pods, sliced ginger, a cinnamon stick and a clove. Add 4 tea bags and simmer for 2 minutes. Pour in 500ml milk and sugar to taste, simmer for 5 minutes more, then strain into small cups.

s.note: A big pan of sausages, bacon, eggs and buttered toast
s.how: Fry 8 pork sausages until browned, then push aside and add 8 rashers of bacon and halved tomatoes. Crack in 8 eggs and fry until the whites set. Toast and butter thick slices of white bread, then load up the plates and pass them down the table.

s.note: Dark treacle toffee scored and broken into rough shards once set
s.how: Line a small tray with baking paper. Boil 200g brown sugar, 100g butter, 2 tbsp black treacle and 2 tbsp golden syrup to 140C, stirring gently. Pour into the tray, score into squares as it cools and break apart once fully set. Store in an airtight tin.

m.note: Lamb mince pie under buttery golden mash, made for a big family
m.how: Brown 800g lamb mince, then add a diced onion and 2 grated carrots. Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste and a splash of Worcestershire and simmer for 40 minutes. Spread in a dish, top with buttery mash from 1kg potatoes and bake at 200C until golden.

w.note: Green apple jelly that fizzes with popping candy on top
w.how: Juice 4 green apples with a squeeze of lemon and warm with 80g sugar. Soak 4 gelatine leaves, squeeze and stir in to dissolve. Pour into small glasses and chill for 4 hours. Just before serving, sprinkle popping candy on top so it crackles and fizzes.

d.note: Cream soda stirred with warm butterscotch and topped with whipped cream
d.how: Cook 100g brown sugar with 50g butter until bubbling, then stir in a splash of cream and a pinch of salt to make butterscotch. Spoon a little into each glass, pour in cold cream soda and stir. Top with lightly whipped cream and serve in tall mugs.

s.note: Grilled garlic bread with tomato and basil
s.how: Slice a ciabatta, brush with oil and grill until charred. Rub with a cut garlic clove. Dice 500g ripe tomatoes and mix with basil, 3 tbsp olive oil and salt, then pile on top.

s.note: Beer-battered fish in tortillas with cabbage, lime crema and salsa
s.how: Whisk flour with cold lager to a light batter. Dip 500g flathead strips and fry at 180C until crisp. Mix sour cream with lime juice for a crema. Fill warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, the fish, a spoon of crema and some fresh salsa.

m.note: Lemon and oregano chicken thighs with brown rice and broccoli
m.how: Marinate 800g chicken thighs in lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano and olive oil for an hour. Grill over high heat until charred and cooked through. Serve with steamed brown rice, broccoli florets and an extra squeeze of lemon. Fuel for a training camp.

w.note: Coffee-soaked biscuits layered with mascarpone cream and cocoa
w.how: Whisk 3 yolks with 80g sugar until pale, then fold in 250g mascarpone and 200ml whipped cream. Dip savoiardi biscuits briefly in cooled strong coffee and layer with the cream in a dish. Repeat, finish with cream, chill overnight and dust with cocoa.

d.note: Fresh lemonade in a big jug with bruised mint and ice
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Squeeze 6 lemons into a big jug and add the syrup with 1.5L cold water. Bruise a handful of mint leaves and drop them in with plenty of ice. Stir well and pour into tall glasses.

s.note: Cheese cubes and grapes on toothpicks, piled on a dark board
s.how: Cut 150g each of cheddar, gouda and brie into small cubes. Thread onto toothpicks with red and green grapes, alternating colours. Pile them high on a dark wooden board so they glitter like gems freshly dug from the mine, and serve at room temperature.

s.note: Honey and rosemary roasted nut clusters broken into rough pieces
s.how: Toss 100g each of walnuts, hazelnuts and almonds with 3 tbsp honey, a spoon of chopped rosemary and a pinch of salt. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 15 minutes, stirring once. Cool completely, then break into clusters for little hands.

m.note: Creamy chicken, leek and potato soup with crusty bread
m.how: Soften 2 sliced leeks in butter, then add 500g diced chicken thighs, 600g diced potatoes, thyme and 1.5L water with salt. Simmer for 30 minutes until the potatoes break down. Stir in 150ml cream and serve in big bowls with torn crusty bread.

w.note: Sweet gooseberry pie with a pastry lid and a jug of cream
w.how: Cook 500g gooseberries with 150g sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour until thick, then cool. Line a pie dish with shortcrust, fill and cover with a pastry lid. Cut a few slits, brush with milk and bake at 190C for 45 minutes. Serve warm with cream.

d.note: Sparkling apple juice with red apple slices and cinnamon
d.how: Thinly slice 2 red apples and drop a few slices into each glass with a cinnamon stick. Pour over well-chilled sparkling apple juice so the apples float up. Serve straight away, one shiny red apple left on the table, of course.

s.note: Golden parmesan crisps shaped like coins with fig jam and brie
s.how: Mix 150g grated parmesan with chopped thyme. Spoon small rounds onto a lined tray and flatten into coins. Bake at 190C for 6 minutes until golden and lacy, then cool on the tray. Serve stacked like coins with fig jam and a wedge of brie.

s.note: Blinis with creme fraiche, salmon roe and chives on silver trays
s.how: Warm 16 blinis in a low oven for 5 minutes. Top each with a small spoon of creme fraiche, a little salmon roe and a few snipped chives. Add a tiny squeeze of lemon and lay them out in neat rows on silver trays like a proper mansion party.

m.note: Smashed cheeseburgers with special sauce, fries and all the trimmings
m.how: Roll 600g beef mince into 4 balls and smash flat on a very hot pan. Season, flip after 2 minutes and add American cheese. Mix mayonnaise with chopped pickles for special sauce. Build on toasted buns with onion and pickles and serve with oven fries.

w.note: Vanilla sundae with salted caramel, honeycomb and a chocolate coin
w.how: Melt 150g sugar to amber, then whisk in 150ml cream and a pinch of salt for caramel sauce. Scoop vanilla ice cream into tall glasses, pour over the caramel and scatter with crushed honeycomb. Top each sundae with a gold chocolate coin.

d.note: Thick vanilla malted milkshakes in tall glasses with straws
d.how: Blend 4 big scoops of vanilla ice cream with 500ml cold milk and 4 tbsp malted milk powder until thick and smooth. Pour into tall chilled glasses, add a straw to each and serve straight away while still frothy on top.

s.note: Salmon blinis, prawn cocktails and prosciutto asparagus for the marquee
s.how: Top blinis with creme fraiche and smoked salmon. Toss 300g cooked prawns in mayonnaise mixed with tomato sauce and spoon into shot glasses. Blanch asparagus spears for a minute, wrap in prosciutto and arrange everything on platters like a race day marquee.

s.note: Double-fried thick chips tossed in chicken salt with gravy for dipping
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips, rinse and dry well. Fry at 140C for 6 minutes until soft, then drain and rest. Fry again at 190C until golden and crisp. Toss in chicken salt and serve with a cup of hot gravy for dipping.

m.note: Grilled rosemary lamb chops with mash, peas and pan gravy
m.how: Rub 8 lamb loin chops with rosemary, garlic and salt. Grill hot for 3 minutes a side and rest. Boil 800g potatoes and mash with butter. Cook peas, then make gravy in the pan with the juices and 250ml beef stock. Serve it all on big plates.

w.note: Thick custard vanilla slice with passionfruit icing, cut with a hot knife
w.how: Bake 2 puff pastry sheets flat between trays until crisp. Whisk 750ml milk, 3 eggs, 150g sugar and 80g cornflour over heat until very thick. Pour between the sheets in a lined tin and set overnight. Top with passionfruit icing and cut with a hot knife.

d.note: Cold Australian lager in pots with salted peanuts alongside
d.how: Chill the lager and the pot glasses in the fridge for at least an hour. Pour each one slowly down the side of the tilted glass, finishing upright for a small head. Tip a bag of salted peanuts into a bowl and set it on the bar.

s.note: Golden damper baked in a round with butter and golden syrup
s.how: Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour until crumbly. Mix in 300ml milk with a knife until it just comes together. Shape into a round, score a cross on top and bake at 200C for 30 minutes until hollow when tapped. Serve with butter and golden syrup.

s.note: Thin corned beef on buttered bread with hot mustard and pickles
s.how: Simmer a 1.5kg corned silverside with an onion and a spoon of peppercorns for 3 hours, then cool in the liquid. Slice thinly and pile onto buttered white bread with a smear of hot mustard and a spoon of mustard pickles. Cut into triangles.

m.note: Camp oven beef cooked low and slow with potatoes and carrots
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in a camp oven or heavy pot. Add a sliced onion, 3 carrots, 600g potatoes in chunks and 750ml beef stock with thyme and pepper. Cover and cook over coals or at 160C for 3 hours until the beef falls apart.

w.note: Pavlova with a hint of wattleseed, topped with cream, mango and passionfruit
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Fold in a teaspoon of cornflour and a teaspoon of ground wattleseed. Bake at 120C for 90 minutes and cool in the oven. Top with whipped cream, mango and passionfruit.

d.note: Billy tea with a gum leaf, poured into tin mugs with milk
d.how: Bring water to the boil in a billy or large pot. Throw in a handful of loose leaf tea and a gum leaf if you have one, then take it off the heat. Leave a minute, tap the side to settle the leaves and pour into tin mugs with milk and sugar.

s.note: Hot cheese, bacon and onion dip baked in a cob loaf.
s.how: Hollow out 1 cob loaf, keeping the lid. Mix 250g cream cheese, 300ml sour cream, 150g diced fried bacon, 150g grated cheddar and 1 packet French onion soup mix. Fill the loaf, wrap in foil and bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Tear the hollowed bread into chunks for dipping.

s.note: Crisp hot sauce wings with blue cheese dip and celery
s.how: Leave 1kg chicken wings uncovered in the fridge overnight to dry. Bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Melt 50g butter with 100ml hot sauce and toss the wings through. Mash blue cheese into sour cream for the dip and serve with celery sticks.

m.note: Thin pepperoni and mushroom pizza left in the box on the bench
m.how: Stretch pizza dough thin on a floured tray. Spread with pizza sauce, then scatter grated mozzarella, pepperoni and sliced mushrooms. Bake on a hot steel or tray at the highest oven heat for 7 to 10 minutes. Slice and leave in a box on the bench.

w.note: Chocolate tray cake with fudge frosting and lots of sprinkles
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 300g sugar, then 3 eggs. Fold in 300g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 250ml milk. Bake in a lined tray at 175C for 30 minutes and cool. Spread with fudge frosting of butter, icing sugar and cocoa, then cover with sprinkles.

d.note: Bourbon and cola over ice with lemon
d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice. Add 45ml bourbon to each, top with 200ml cola and squeeze in a lemon wedge. Serve straight away while it is still ice cold.

s.note: Little toasts of salami, provolone and pickled capsicum on a wooden board
s.how: Slice a baguette thinly, brush with olive oil and toast at 200C for 6 minutes until crisp. Top each toast with a fold of salami, a small slice of provolone and a strip of pickled capsicum. Lay them out in rows on a wooden board like tools on a bench.

s.note: Crisp cheddar crackers cut into little goldfish shapes
s.how: Rub 100g butter into 150g flour, then mix in 150g grated cheddar and a pinch of smoked paprika. Add a splash of cold water to bring it together and chill for 30 minutes. Roll thin, cut into fish shapes and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until crisp.

m.note: Parmesan meatballs simmered in slow tomato and basil sauce over spaghetti
m.how: Mix 600g beef mince with grated parmesan, chopped parsley, salt and an egg, roll into balls and brown well. Add 2 cans crushed tomatoes, crushed garlic and torn basil and simmer for 40 minutes. Serve over 500g spaghetti with extra parmesan grated on top.

w.note: Vanilla custard tart crowned with glazed blueberries and icing sugar
w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case until golden and cool completely. Fill with 500ml thick vanilla custard and pile 250g blueberries on top. Warm 2 tbsp apricot jam with a splash of water and brush over the berries to glaze. Dust with icing sugar and chill.

d.note: Fresh honey lemonade with mint, served cold in small glasses
d.how: Squeeze 6 lemons into a jug. Stir 4 tbsp honey into a little hot water until dissolved, then add to the jug with 1.5L cold water. Bruise a handful of mint and drop it in with plenty of ice. Pour into small glasses and serve cold.

s.note: Thick slices of warm banana bread spread with butter
s.how: Mash 3 ripe bananas with 150g brown sugar, 100g melted butter, 2 eggs and a teaspoon of cinnamon. Fold in 250g self-raising flour until just combined. Pour into a lined loaf tin and bake at 175C for 55 minutes. Cool a little, then slice thick and butter.

s.note: Mango, pineapple, papaya and passionfruit with lime and torn mint
s.how: Peel and cube 2 mangoes, half a pineapple and half a papaya and tip into a big bowl. Scoop over the pulp of 3 passionfruit. Squeeze over the juice of 2 limes and toss gently with torn mint leaves. Chill for 20 minutes before serving.

m.note: Seafood simmered in tomato, white wine and garlic broth with sourdough
m.how: Soften sliced fennel and garlic in olive oil, then add a can of crushed tomatoes and 250ml white wine and simmer for 20 minutes. Add 400g chunks of white fish, 300g green prawns and 500g mussels, cover and cook 6 minutes until the mussels open. Serve with toasted sourdough.

w.note: Creamy coconut rice pudding topped with toasted coconut and mango
w.how: Simmer 150g arborio rice in 800ml coconut milk with 80g sugar and a teaspoon of vanilla paste for 30 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy. Chill for 2 hours. Spoon into bowls and top with toasted shredded coconut and slices of fresh mango.

d.note: Thick banana and mango smoothie blended with yoghurt and honey
d.how: Peel 2 bananas and a mango and drop into a blender. Add 300g Greek yoghurt, 2 tbsp honey and a big handful of ice. Blend until thick and smooth, adding a splash of water if it is too thick, then pour into tall glasses with straws.

s.note: Crisp chilli tortilla chips with a smoky charred tomato salsa
s.how: Cut 12 corn tortillas into wedges and fry at 180C until crisp, then toss in salt and chilli powder. Char 4 tomatoes and half an onion in a dry pan until blackened. Chop together with lime juice and salt for a smoky salsa and serve with the chips.

s.note: Golden potato coins roasted crisp with a garlic aioli
s.how: Slice 800g small potatoes into thick coins and toss in olive oil and salt. Spread on a tray and roast at 220C for 30 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp. Stir a crushed garlic clove into mayonnaise for aioli and serve the coins in a pile beside it.

m.note: Borlotti beans slow simmered with smoked ham hock and rosemary
m.how: Soak 400g dried borlotti beans overnight and drain. Soften a diced onion and garlic, then add the beans, a smoked ham hock, a can of crushed tomatoes, rosemary and water to cover. Simmer for 2 hours until thick, shred the ham back in and serve with Italian bread.

w.note: Chocolate mousse under biscuit soil with a gold coin buried inside
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate and cool slightly. Whisk 3 egg whites to soft peaks and whip 300ml cream. Fold the yolks into the chocolate, then fold in the cream and whites. Spoon into cups with a chocolate coin buried in each, chill and top with crushed chocolate biscuits.

d.note: Neat rye whisky in small glasses with a jug of water
d.how: Set out small heavy glasses on the table with a jug of cold water. Pour 45ml rye whisky into each glass. Add a few drops of water to open it up if you like, and sip it slowly while the long standoff plays out on screen.

s.note: Spinach and feta filo triangles baked golden and flaky
s.how: Wilt 500g spinach, squeeze dry and chop. Mix with 200g crumbled feta, 200g ricotta, chopped dill, spring onion and an egg. Cut buttered filo into strips, spoon filling at one end and fold into triangles. Brush with butter and bake at 190C for 25 minutes.

s.note: Tzatziki and taramasalata with warm pita and olives
s.how: Grate a Lebanese cucumber, squeeze out the water and mix into 500g Greek yoghurt with crushed garlic, chopped dill and salt. Spoon into a bowl beside a tub of taramasalata. Warm pita bread in the oven, cut into wedges and serve with a bowl of olives.

m.note: Slow roasted lemon and oregano lamb shoulder with lemon potatoes
m.how: Rub a 2kg lamb shoulder with lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano, olive oil and salt. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it falls apart. Add 1kg potato wedges to the pan for the last 90 minutes so they soak up the juices, then uncover to brown.

w.note: Golden honey puffs soaked in cinnamon syrup with walnuts
w.how: Mix 250g flour, 7g yeast and 300ml warm water into a sticky batter and rest an hour until bubbly. Drop spoonfuls into 175C oil and fry until puffed and golden. Toss in warm honey syrup with cinnamon and scatter with chopped walnuts. Eat while warm.

d.note: Thick foamy coffee boiled in a small pot and served in small cups
d.how: For each cup, put a heaped teaspoon of very finely ground coffee, sugar to taste and a small cup of cold water into a small pot. Heat slowly, stirring once, until it foams up to the rim. Pour into small cups and let the grounds settle before sipping.

s.note: Puff pastry croissants with chocolate or ham and gruyère inside
s.how: Cut 2 puff pastry sheets into long triangles. Lay a stick of dark chocolate or a strip of ham and gruyere at the wide end and roll up towards the point. Curve into crescents, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until puffed and golden.

s.note: Spiced lamb and beef meatballs on toothpicks with garlic yoghurt
s.how: Mix 250g lamb mince and 250g beef mince with crushed garlic, a teaspoon of cumin, chopped parsley and salt. Roll into small balls and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Spear each upright on a toothpick like a little top and serve with yoghurt mixed with garlic.

m.note: Sticky glazed salmon packed with sushi rice, ginger and cucumber salad
m.how: Simmer soy sauce, mirin and a little sugar until syrupy. Grill 4 salmon fillets, brushing with the glaze until sticky. Cook 2 cups sushi rice. Pack boxes with rice, salmon, pickled ginger, thinly sliced cucumber dressed in rice vinegar, and a halved soft-boiled egg.

w.n: Dream within a dream layer cake
w.note: Thin vanilla sponges layered with chocolate mousse and coffee cream
w.how: Whisk 4 eggs with 150g sugar until thick, fold in 150g self-raising flour and bake 3 thin sponges at 175C for 15 minutes. Make a chocolate mousse with melted dark chocolate and whipped cream, and a coffee cream with cream and cold espresso. Layer, chill for 4 hours and slice to show every level.

d.note: Fresh espresso shaken with vodka and coffee liqueur, three beans on top
d.how: Brew strong espresso and let it cool slightly. For each drink, shake 30ml espresso, 45ml vodka and 15ml coffee liqueur very hard with ice until frothy. Strain into a chilled glass and float three coffee beans on the foam. Serve straight away.

s.note: Garlic butter mushrooms stuffed with breadcrumbs and parmesan
s.how: Remove the stalks from 500g button mushrooms. Mix softened butter with crushed garlic, breadcrumbs, grated parmesan and chopped parsley. Press a spoonful into each mushroom cap and bake at 200C for 12 minutes until golden and bubbling. Serve warm on a platter.

s.note: Grapes, brie, fresh figs and honey piled on a big platter
s.how: Wash bunches of red and green grapes and pile them on a big platter. Add a whole wedge of brie at room temperature and halve 6 fresh figs around it. Set a little pot of honey in the middle so everyone can drizzle it over the cheese and figs.

m.note: Eggplant and spiced lamb under golden béchamel
m.how: Slice 2 eggplants and fry or grill until golden. Brown 600g lamb mince with an onion, cinnamon and 400g tomatoes and simmer 20 minutes. Layer in a dish, top with a béchamel of 60g butter, 60g flour, 600ml milk and an egg and bake at 180C for 40 minutes.

w.note: Little meringue kisses dusted with edible glitter and served with berries
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 170g caster sugar a spoon at a time until thick and glossy. Pipe small kisses onto lined trays and bake at 100C for an hour. Cool in the oven, dust with edible glitter and serve with fresh raspberries.

d.note: Sparkling grape juice or red wine in goblets with frozen grapes
d.how: Freeze a bunch of red grapes on a tray for 2 hours. Drop a few frozen grapes into each goblet in place of ice. Pour sparkling grape juice for the kids and red wine for the adults, so the grapes chill each glass without watering it down.

s.note: Crumbed chicken balls shaped like footballs with honey mustard dip
s.how: Cut 600g chicken thighs into chunks and press into small oval shapes. Coat in flour, beaten egg and panko breadcrumbs. Shallow fry until golden and cooked through. Mix honey with Dijon mustard for a dipping sauce and serve the footballs piled on a platter.

s.note: Sticky honey, soy and chilli wings scattered with sesame
s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings with salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Warm 3 tbsp honey with 3 tbsp soy sauce and a sliced red chilli until sticky. Toss the wings through the glaze and scatter with toasted sesame seeds before serving.

m.note: Hot red chicken curry with coconut milk, capsicum and Thai basil
m.how: Fry 2 tbsp red curry paste in a little oil until fragrant. Add 600g sliced chicken thighs and brown, then pour in 400ml coconut milk and simmer 15 minutes. Add a sliced red capsicum for the last 5 minutes, stir through Thai basil and serve with jasmine rice.

w.note: Red jelly and mango trifle with custard and gold sprinkles
