s.how: Cut 1 iceberg lettuce into 4 wedges. Mash 80g blue cheese into 150g sour cream with lemon and pepper. Fry 4 rashers bacon until crisp and crumble. Spoon the dressing over the wedges and scatter with bacon and 1 diced tomato.

m.note: Creamy fish and prawn pie under buttery mash.
m.how: Poach 600g white fish in 500ml milk for 5 minutes and flake. Make a sauce with 40g butter, 3 tbsp flour and the poaching milk, add 200g peeled prawns and chopped parsley, and pour into a dish with the fish. Top with 1kg potatoes mashed with 40g butter and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.note: White and pink coconut ice, set in layers.
w.how: Mix 250g desiccated coconut, 395g condensed milk and 250g icing sugar into a stiff paste. Press half into a lined 20cm tin, tint the rest pink with a drop of colouring and press on top. Chill 2 hours until firm and cut into squares.

d.note: Pink strawberry and vanilla milkshakes with whipped cream on top
d.how: Blend 1L vanilla ice cream, 250g strawberries and 400ml milk until thick and pink. Pour into 4 glasses and top with whipped cream. Serve straight away while it is still ice cold.

s.note: Chicken laksa in small cups, Darwin market style.
s.how: Fry 3 tbsp laksa paste for 2 minutes, add 400ml coconut milk and 500ml water and simmer. Add 300g sliced chicken thighs and cook 8 minutes, then 100g tofu puffs. Divide 200g cooked rice noodles into 8 cups, ladle over the laksa and top with bean sprouts.

s.note: Fresh mango salsa with corn chips.
s.how: Dice 2 ripe mangoes and mix with half a finely diced red onion, 1 chopped red chilli, a handful of coriander and the juice of 2 limes. Season with salt and serve with 230g corn chips.

m.note: Crisp-skin barramundi with green mango salad.
m.how: Score 4 barramundi fillets (about 180g each) and season. Grill skin down over high heat for 5 minutes, flip for 2. Toss 1 shredded green mango with mint, 1 sliced chilli, the juice of 2 limes and 1 tbsp fish sauce and pile on top.

w.note: Pavlova piled with cream, mango and passionfruit.
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy, then fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp vinegar. Shape a round and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 2 sliced mangoes and 3 passionfruit.

d.note: Lime cordial, fresh lime and soda over ice.
d.how: Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 30ml lime cordial and the juice of half a lime to each, then top with 200ml soda water and stir.

s.note: Salami, kabana, pickles, rye and soft cheese.
s.how: Slice 150g salami and 150g kabana and lay them out on a big board. Add 6 dill pickles cut into spears, 200g cream cheese in a bowl and a sliced dark rye loaf, the way Magda would set out a New Year's Eve spread.

s.note: Egg and cress finger sandwiches, crusts off.
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and mash with 4 tbsp mayonnaise, salt and pepper. Spread over 4 slices white bread, scatter with cress and top with 4 more slices. Trim the crusts and cut into fingers.

m.note: Chicken braised in paprika and capsicum with sour cream, over noodles.
m.how: Brown 1kg chicken thighs, then soften 2 onions and 1 red capsicum in the pan. Stir in 2 tbsp sweet paprika, add 375ml chicken stock and the chicken, and simmer 30 minutes. Stir 200g sour cream through off the heat and serve over 400g buttered egg noodles.

w.note: Lemon poppy seed loaf with lemon icing.
w.how: Beat 180g butter with 180g sugar, add 3 eggs and the zest of 2 lemons, then fold in 220g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp poppy seeds and 80ml milk. Bake in a loaf tin at 170C for 50 minutes. Ice with 150g icing sugar mixed with lemon juice.

d.note: A proper pot of tea in china cups.
d.how: Warm a teapot, add 4 tsp black tea and 1L just-boiled water and brew 4 minutes. Pour into china cups with milk and sugar on the side, the way the Goodes tearoom served it.

s.note: Dates and toasted almonds with honey and sea salt.
s.how: Toast 150g almonds in a dry pan for 4 minutes. Pile on a plate with 16 medjool dates, drizzle with 2 tbsp honey and finish with a pinch of sea salt flakes.

s.note: Olives, pecorino and figs with bread and oil.
s.how: Lay out 200g mixed olives, 200g pecorino cut into shards and 6 halved figs on a board. Slice 1 crusty loaf and pour 4 tbsp olive oil into a dish for dipping.

m.note: Honey, garlic and thyme roast chicken with carrots.
m.how: Rub a 1.8kg whole chicken with oil, salt, crushed garlic and thyme and stuff with a halved lemon. Roast at 200C on a bed of 6 carrots for 60 minutes, then brush with 3 tbsp honey and roast 15 minutes more until sticky. Rest 10 minutes and carve.

w.note: Baked ricotta and honey cheesecake, the way ancient Romans made it.
w.how: Beat 500g ricotta with 3 eggs, 4 tbsp honey and the zest of 1 lemon until smooth. Pour into a lined 20cm tin and bake at 170C for 40 minutes until just set. Cool and drizzle with 2 tbsp more honey.

d.note: Warm spiced red grape juice with orange.
d.how: Heat 1L red grape juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, 4 cloves and 3 strips orange peel for 10 minutes without boiling. Serve warm in cups, or chill it and pour over ice.

s.note: Crumbly green pistachio shortbread rounds dusted with icing sugar.
s.how: Blitz 100g pistachios fine. Beat 150g butter with 60g icing sugar, then mix in 180g flour and the pistachios. Roll into a log, chill 30 minutes, slice into 20 rounds and bake at 160C for 15 minutes. Dust with icing sugar.

s.note: Small gruyère and chive custard tarts.
s.how: Line a 12-hole tray with rounds cut from 2 sheets shortcrust pastry. Whisk 3 eggs with 200ml cream, 80g grated gruyère and snipped chives, pour into the cases and bake at 180C for 18 minutes until puffed and golden.

m.note: Butter, lemon and tarragon roast chicken with beans and potatoes.
m.how: Push 60g butter mixed with chopped tarragon and lemon zest under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes with 800g potatoes in chunks around it. Steam 300g green beans and toss in the pan juices.

w.note: Custard tarts topped with glazed ruby raspberries.
w.how: Bake 8 small tart cases cut from 2 sheets sweet shortcrust at 180C for 12 minutes. Make custard from 3 tbsp custard powder, 2 tbsp sugar and 500ml milk, cool and fill the cases. Top with 250g raspberries brushed with warm raspberry jam.

d.note: Muddled mint and lime topped with soda.
d.how: Muddle a handful of mint leaves with the juice of 3 limes and 3 tbsp sugar in a jug. Add ice and top with 1L soda water, stir and pour into 4 glasses with a mint sprig each.

s.n: Divorced women's group dip and crackers
s.note: Caramelised onion dip with crackers and celery.
s.how: Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in butter for 30 minutes until deep golden and cool. Stir into 300g sour cream with salt and pepper and chill 1 hour. Serve with 1 box crackers and 4 celery sticks cut into batons.

s.note: Grilled corn with mayo, crumbly cheese, chilli and lime.
s.how: Grill 4 corn cobs for 10 minutes, turning, until charred in spots. Brush each with mayonnaise (4 tbsp total), roll in 80g crumbled feta and dust with chilli powder. Squeeze over lime to serve.

m.note: Citrus-marinated grilled skirt steak with tortillas and salsa.
m.how: Marinate 800g skirt steak for 2 hours in the juice of 2 limes and 1 orange, 3 crushed garlic cloves, oil and salt. Grill hot for 3 minutes a side, rest and slice thin across the grain. Serve with 8 warm flour tortillas and 250g salsa.

w.note: Vanilla wedding cupcakes topped with swirls of white buttercream.
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 125g sugar, add 2 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla, then fold in 150g self-raising flour and 60ml milk. Bake in 12 cases at 175C for 18 minutes. Beat 125g butter with 250g icing sugar and pipe on top.

d.note: Prickly pear syrup, lime and soda over ice
d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice. Add 30ml prickly pear syrup and the juice of half a lime to each and top with 200ml soda water.

s.note: Crisp fried wings in a sweet and spicy glaze
s.how: Toss 1.2kg chicken wings in 150g flour seasoned with paprika, garlic powder and salt. Fry at 175C for 10 minutes until golden and cooked through. Simmer 100ml honey, 3 tbsp sriracha and 2 tbsp soy until glossy and toss the wings through.

s.note: Crumbed fish bites with lemon and tartare
s.how: Cut 500g white fish into bite-size pieces. Roll in 50g flour, 2 beaten eggs, then 100g panko and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Serve with lemon wedges and 150g tartare sauce.

m.note: Seared strip steaks with garlic butter, fries and creamed spinach
m.how: Season 4 sirloin steaks and sear in a very hot pan for 3 minutes a side, then baste with 50g butter and 2 crushed garlic cloves. Rest 5 minutes. Serve with 1kg oven fries and 400g spinach wilted with 100ml cream.

w.note: Warm dark chocolate fondue with fruit and marshmallows for dipping
w.how: Melt 250g dark chocolate with 200ml cream and a pinch of salt over low heat, stirring until smooth. Pour into a warm bowl and serve with 250g strawberries, 150g marshmallows and a cut-up sponge cake for dipping.

d.note: Blended Scotch poured over a big ice block
d.how: Freeze a tray of large ice cubes the day before. Put one big cube in each of 4 heavy tumblers and pour 45ml blended Scotch over each. Cola for anyone not drinking.

s.note: Warm soft pretzels with salt, mustard and cheese dip
s.how: Roll 500g pizza dough into 8 ropes and twist into pretzels. Dip each in 1L water simmering with 3 tbsp bicarb soda for 20 seconds, sprinkle with salt flakes and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Brush with 30g melted butter and serve with mustard and 200g cheese sauce.

s.note: Hot chilli garlic prawns served over crushed ice with lime
s.how: Toss 600g peeled green prawns with 3 tbsp olive oil, 3 garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli and salt. Grill on high for 2 minutes a side. Pile over a platter of crushed ice and serve with lime wedges.

m.note: Crumbed chicken topped with tomato, ham and melted cheese
m.how: Halve 2 large chicken breasts into thin fillets. Crumb in flour, 2 eggs and 150g breadcrumbs and pan-fry until golden. Top with 200g passata, 4 slices ham and 150g grated mozzarella and bake at 200C for 12 minutes. Serve with chips and salad.

w.note: Ice cream balls coated in white chocolate and coconut
w.how: Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream into 8 balls and freeze for 1 hour. Melt 200g white chocolate with 2 tbsp coconut oil, dip each ball and roll straight away in 100g desiccated coconut. Freeze until serving.

d.note: Thick real-chocolate hot chocolate topped with whipped cream
d.how: Heat 1L full cream milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate and 2 tbsp sugar until smooth and thick. Pour into 4 mugs and top with whipped cream.

s.note: Hot dogs topped with dry spiced beef coney sauce and onion
s.how: Brown 300g beef mince until very fine and dry, then add 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika and 60ml water and cook 10 minutes. Grill 8 frankfurts and put in 8 hot dog buns with mustard, the coney sauce and diced onion.

s.note: Buttery salted popcorn with parmesan in big boxes
s.how: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a large pot, add 120g popcorn kernels, cover and shake until popping stops. Toss with 50g melted butter, salt flakes and 30g finely grated parmesan.

m.note: Sticky barbecue pork ribs with corn and coleslaw
m.how: Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with salt, pepper and smoked paprika, wrap in foil and bake at 160C for 2 hours. Unwrap, brush with 250ml barbecue sauce and grill until sticky. Serve with 4 buttered corn cobs and 1 bag coleslaw mixed with mayonnaise.

w.note: Orange sponge layered with vanilla cream
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and the zest of 2 oranges, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 60ml orange juice. Bake in two 20cm tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Fill and top with 300ml cream whipped with vanilla.

d.note: Ice-cold lager in plastic cups, lemonade for kids
d.how: Chill 8 cans of lager in an esky full of ice for an hour. Pour into plastic cups and serve straight away, with cold lemonade for anyone not drinking.

s.note: Mini bagels with cream cheese, smoked salmon and capers
s.how: Split and toast 12 mini bagels. Spread each half with 250g cream cheese between them and top with 200g smoked salmon, thin red onion and capers.

s.note: Crisp onion and spinach fritters with mint yoghurt
s.how: Mix 150g chickpea flour, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chilli, salt and 180ml water into a batter. Stir in 2 sliced onions and 100g chopped spinach. Fry spoonfuls at 180C for 4 minutes and serve with 200g yoghurt mixed with mint.

m.note: Sweet and sour pork with egg fried rice
m.how: Coat 600g diced pork in cornflour and fry until crisp. Fry 1 capsicum and 1 onion, add 200ml pineapple juice, 3 tbsp tomato sauce, 2 tbsp vinegar and 2 tbsp sugar, then toss the pork through. Serve with 300g rice fried with 2 eggs and peas.

w.note: Dense fudgy chocolate brownies in neat squares
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 180g butter. Whisk in 300g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour and 30g cocoa. Bake in a lined 20cm tin at 170C for 28 minutes and cool before cutting.

d.note: Cold lager after shift with peanuts
d.how: Chill 8 bottles of lager. Pour into schooner glasses and serve with a bowl of salted peanuts. Soda water and lime for anyone driving. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Cold navel orange wedges for halftime
s.how: Cut 6 navel oranges into wedges, keeping the skin on. Pile into a bowl of ice and serve straight away at halftime. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Nuts, seeds, dried fruit and dark chocolate chunks
s.how: Toss 200g mixed nuts, 100g pumpkin seeds, 100g dried cranberries, 100g dried apricots and 100g dark chocolate chunks in a big bowl. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Grilled sausages in bread with fried onions
m.how: Grill 12 beef sausages until browned and cooked through. Fry 3 sliced onions in butter until soft and golden. Serve each sausage in a slice of white bread with onions, tomato sauce and mustard.

w.note: Crunchy twice-baked almond biscotti for dunking
w.how: Mix 250g plain flour, 200g sugar, 1 tsp baking powder, 3 eggs and 150g whole almonds into a dough. Shape 2 logs and bake at 180C for 25 minutes. Cool 10 minutes, slice thinly and bake 10 minutes more until crisp.

d.note: Strong plunger coffee with milk and sugar
d.how: Add 60g coarse ground coffee to a plunger, pour over 1L water just off the boil and steep 4 minutes. Press and pour into 4 big mugs with milk and sugar to taste.

s.note: Mini beef sliders with cheese and pickles
s.how: Shape 500g beef mince into 12 small patties and season. Cook on a hot pan for 2 minutes a side, adding half a cheese slice each at the end. Put in 12 slider buns with pickles and sauce.

s.note: Crisp raw vegetables standing in jars with herb dip
s.how: Cut 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks, 1 cucumber and 1 red capsicum into sticks and stand them in jars. Blitz 200g sour cream with parsley, chives and a squeeze of lemon for the dip.

m.note: Chipotle chicken tacos with avocado and lime
m.how: Toss 800g chicken thigh with 2 tbsp chipotle in adobo, garlic and lime, grill and slice. Serve in 12 small tortillas with 2 sliced avocados, shredded lettuce, coriander and lime wedges.

w.note: No-bake strawberry cheesecake in little cups, bright pink with a biscuit base
w.how: Crush 150g biscuits with 60g melted butter into 6 glasses. Beat 250g cream cheese, 80g icing sugar and 150g mashed strawberries, fold in 200ml whipped cream and spoon on top. Chill 2 hours and top with a strawberry.

d.note: Vodka, orange liqueur, cranberry and lime, shaken
d.how: Shake 40ml vodka, 15ml orange liqueur, 30ml cranberry juice and 10ml lime juice with ice for each glass. Strain into 4 chilled glasses. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Ham and cheese toasties cut into precise triangles
s.how: Butter the outsides of 8 slices of bread and fill 4 sandwiches with 150g ham and 150g grated cheddar. Cook in a pan over medium heat for exactly 3 minutes a side and cut into neat triangles.

s.note: Soft warm butter cookies, straight from the oven
s.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g brown sugar and 50g caster sugar, add 1 egg and vanilla, then 200g plain flour and 1 tsp baking powder. Roll into 16 balls and bake at 180C for 11 minutes until just golden.

m.note: Chicken and leek pie under golden puff pastry
m.how: Cook 800g diced chicken thigh with 2 sliced leeks in 30g butter. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, 300ml chicken stock and 100ml cream and simmer 10 minutes. Spoon into a dish, top with puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.note: Warm chocolate chip cookies with cold milk
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g brown sugar, add 1 egg, then 200g plain flour, 1 tsp bicarb soda and 150g chocolate chips. Bake 16 spoonfuls at 180C for 11 minutes. Serve warm with cold milk.

d.note: Ice-cold full cream milk in tall glasses
d.how: Chill 1L full cream milk until very cold. Pour into 4 tall glasses and serve with the cookies. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Hot dogs with crispy onions, sweet mustard and remoulade
s.how: Grill 8 frankfurts. Put in 8 hot dog buns with diced raw onion, 60g crispy fried onions, sweet mustard and 100g remoulade or tartare. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Smoked trout on crispbread with crème fraîche and dill
s.how: Spread 16 rye crispbreads with 150g crème fraîche. Top with 250g flaked smoked trout, thin pickled cucumber and dill. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Slow-roasted lamb with caramelised potatoes and peas
m.how: Rub a 2kg lamb shoulder with salt, pepper and thyme and roast at 160C for 3 hours. Boil 800g small potatoes, then toss in 60g sugar melted to caramel with 30g butter. Serve with 300g peas and gravy from the pan.

w.note: Thick strained yoghurt with honey and berries
w.how: Spoon 600g thick Greek or Icelandic yoghurt into 4 bowls. Top with 300g mixed berries and drizzle with honey. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.note: Sparkling wine with elderflower and soda
d.how: Pour 20ml elderflower cordial into each of 4 flutes and top with chilled sparkling wine. Elderflower and soda water for the kids. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: A neat platter of carrot, cucumber and capsicum sticks with hummus, the responsible stepdad
s.how: Cut 2 carrots, 1 cucumber and 1 red capsicum into sticks and arrange on a platter around 250g hummus. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Loaded corn chips with beef, cheese and sour cream
s.how: Brown 400g beef mince with taco seasoning. Spread 300g corn chips on a tray, top with the beef and 200g grated cheese and bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Finish with salsa and 150g sour cream.

m.note: Big beef burgers with cheese and salad
m.how: Shape 800g beef mince into 4 patties. Grill 4 minutes a side, adding cheese at the end. Build in 4 toasted buns with lettuce, tomato, onion and sauce.

w.note: Vanilla cupcakes with pink buttercream and sprinkles, for the night of the dance
w.how: Beat 125g butter and 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, then 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes. Top with 150g butter beaten with 300g icing sugar and a drop of pink colouring.

d.note: Homemade lemonade with mint over ice, as smooth as the station Brad runs
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Mix with the juice of 6 lemons and 1L cold water, add mint and serve over ice.

s.note: Crispy hot wings from the corner, tossed in a buttery hot sauce with ranch
s.how: Bake 1.2kg chicken wings tossed with 2 tsp baking powder and salt at 220C for 45 minutes. Toss in 100ml hot sauce melted with 50g butter and serve with 150ml ranch.

s.note: Smoked salmon blinis with crème fraîche
s.how: Top 16 small blinis with 150g crème fraîche, 150g smoked salmon and snipped chives. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Barbecue chicken with mac and cheese and greens
m.how: Bake 1kg chicken thighs at 200C for 25 minutes, brush with 200ml barbecue sauce and bake 10 more. Make mac and cheese from 300g macaroni, 30g butter, 2 tbsp flour, 500ml milk and 200g cheddar. Serve with 400g sautéed silverbeet.

w.note: Chocolate pudding cups with crushed biscuits
w.how: Whisk 600ml milk, 80g sugar, 30g cocoa and 3 tbsp cornflour over heat until thick. Pour into 4 cups, chill 2 hours and top with crushed chocolate biscuits.

d.note: Green apple, cucumber, celery and ginger juice
d.how: Juice or blend 3 green apples, 1 cucumber, 3 celery sticks and a knob of ginger with 300ml water. Strain and serve over ice. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Cheese, salami, crackers and pickles on a board
s.how: Arrange 200g cheddar, 150g brie, 150g salami, 200g crackers, 150g olives and pickles on a large board. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.n: Back at Austin's chips and dip
s.note: Potato chips with homemade French onion dip
s.how: Slowly cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter for 25 minutes until deep golden, cool and chop. Mix with 250g sour cream, salt and pepper. Serve with 200g thick-cut potato chips.

m.note: Grilled rump with roast potatoes and salad
m.how: Season 4 rump steaks and grill 4 minutes a side. Roast 1kg potatoes in oil at 210C for 40 minutes. Serve with salad leaves dressed with oil and lemon.

w.note: Soft-centred meringue clouds with cream and berries
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, add 220g sugar until glossy and spoon 8 clouds onto a tray. Bake at 120C for 1 hour and cool in the oven. Serve with 300ml whipped cream and berries.

d.note: Cold pale ale in the backyard
d.how: Chill 8 bottles of pale ale and serve in pint glasses. Lemon squash for anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Battered fried cheese curds with ranch
s.how: Cut 400g haloumi into 2cm cubes. Dip in a batter of 150g flour, 1 egg and 200ml cold beer and fry at 185C for 1 minute. Serve with 150ml ranch dressing.

s.note: Soft pretzel bites with beer cheese sauce
s.how: Cut 500g pizza dough into bites, dip in water simmering with 3 tbsp bicarb soda for 15 seconds, salt and bake at 220C for 10 minutes. Melt 200g cheddar into 150ml lager thickened with 1 tbsp cornflour for the dip.

m.note: Beer-simmered bratwurst in rolls with sauerkraut
m.how: Simmer 8 bratwurst with 2 sliced onions in 500ml lager for 15 minutes. Grill until browned. Serve in 8 long rolls with the onions, 300g sauerkraut and mustard.

w.note: Vanilla sundaes with chocolate sauce, nuts and cherries
w.how: Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream into 4 bowls. Pour over warm chocolate topping, scatter with 50g chopped peanuts and top with a cherry. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.note: Ice-cold lager in plastic cups for the stands, and lemonade for the kids
d.how: Chill 8 cans of lager and pour into plastic cups. Cold lemonade for anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Sharp aged cheddar with apple slices and crackers
s.how: Slice 300g aged cheddar and 3 crisp apples. Arrange with 200g crackers on a board. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Thick salted fries with tomato sauce
s.how: Bake 1kg thick frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp. Toss with salt and serve with tomato sauce. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Beef burgers with cheddar and bacon
m.how: Shape 800g beef mince into 4 patties and grill 4 minutes a side, adding cheddar at the end. Fry 4 rashers bacon. Build in 4 buns with lettuce, tomato, bacon and sauce.

w.note: Fluffy pancakes with plenty of maple syrup
w.how: Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs and 400ml milk into a batter. Cook ladles in a buttered pan for 2 minutes a side. Stack and pour over 250ml maple syrup.

d.note: Big cold glasses of cola over ice, poured by the litre
d.how: Fill 4 large glasses with ice and pour 300ml cold cola into each. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Big soft pretzels with butter and mustard
s.how: Roll 500g pizza dough into 4 long ropes and twist into pretzels. Dip in 1L water simmering with 3 tbsp bicarb soda, salt and bake at 220C for 15 minutes. Serve with butter and hot mustard.

s.note: Bavarian cheese spread with paprika and onion
s.how: Mash 200g ripe brie with 50g soft butter, 1 tsp paprika, half a finely diced onion and a splash of beer. Serve with sliced rye bread and radishes.

m.note: Golden pork schnitzel with potato salad
m.how: Pound 4 pork steaks thin. Crumb in flour, 2 eggs and 150g breadcrumbs and pan-fry in butter and oil for 3 minutes a side. Serve with 500g potato salad and lemon wedges.

w.note: Flaky apple and sultana strudel with cream
w.how: Toss 4 sliced apples with 60g sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 60g sultanas. Roll in 2 sheets puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Dust with icing sugar and serve with cream.

d.note: Cold German lager in big steins
d.how: Chill 8 bottles of German lager and pour into steins. Mix apple juice with soda water for anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Warm bean dip with melted cheese and corn chips
s.how: Spread 400g refried beans in a dish, top with 150g grated cheese and bake at 200C for 12 minutes. Top with salsa and 150g sour cream and serve with 300g corn chips.

s.note: Grilled hot dogs with mustard and onion
s.how: Grill 8 frankfurts and put in 8 hot dog buns with mustard, tomato sauce and diced onion. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Classic beef burgers with cheese and pickles
m.how: Shape 800g beef mince into 4 patties and grill 4 minutes a side with cheese. Build in 4 buns with pickles, onion and sauce. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: Fifteen chewy choc chip cookies in a row
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g brown sugar, add 1 egg, then 200g plain flour, 1 tsp bicarb soda and 150g chocolate chips. Bake 15 spoonfuls at 180C for 11 minutes.

d.note: Iced tea with honey and lemon
d.how: Brew 4 black tea bags in 1L hot water for 4 minutes, stir in 4 tbsp honey and cool. Serve over ice with lemon. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Soft salty boiled peanuts in the shell
s.how: Simmer 500g raw peanuts in the shell in 3L water with 80g salt for 3 hours until soft. Drain and serve warm. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Shoestring fries under melted cheddar sauce and spring onion
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour and 250ml milk until thick, then 150g grated cheddar. Pour over the fries and scatter with sliced spring onion.

m.note: Buttermilk fried chicken with mash and gravy
m.how: Soak 1.2kg chicken pieces in 300ml buttermilk overnight. Dredge in 200g flour with paprika and salt and fry at 165C for 14 minutes. Serve with 800g mashed potatoes and gravy.

w.note: Spiced sweet potato custard in a short pastry case, a Southern family dessert
w.how: Mash 500g cooked sweet potato with 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml evaporated milk, cinnamon and nutmeg. Pour into a blind-baked 23cm pastry case and bake at 175C for 45 minutes.

d.note: Strong sweet black tea over ice
d.how: Brew 6 black tea bags in 1L boiling water for 5 minutes, stir in 120g sugar and cool. Serve over ice with lemon. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Roasted mixed vegetables tossed with herbs, a better use for the vegetables Gene keeps
s.how: Toss 2 zucchini, 1 capsicum, 2 carrots and 1 red onion, chopped, with 3 tbsp oil and dried herbs. Roast at 210C for 30 minutes until golden.

s.note: Toasted marshmallows and chocolate between biscuits
s.how: Toast 16 marshmallows until golden. Sandwich each with a square of milk chocolate between 2 plain biscuits. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Saucy beef mince in soft buns
m.how: Brown 500g beef mince with 1 onion and 1 capsicum, add 200ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and 1 tbsp brown sugar and simmer 15 minutes. Spoon into 6 soft buns.

w.n: Last day bug juice ice blocks
w.note: Frozen fruit punch ice blocks, the camp drink frozen solid for a hot summer
w.how: Mix 500ml tropical juice with 300ml lemonade and freeze in ice block moulds for 5 hours. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.note: Red fruit cordial mixed with water and plenty of ice, the classic camp drink
d.how: Mix 200ml red fruit cordial with 1.2L cold water in a big jug and serve over ice. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Roast drumsticks to eat with your hands
s.how: Rub 12 chicken drumsticks with oil, salt, garlic and rosemary and roast at 200C for 40 minutes until golden. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Popcorn, pretzels and lollies in paper bags
s.how: Pop 100g popcorn kernels and toss with butter and salt. Mix with 150g pretzels and 200g mixed lollies and portion into paper bags. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Cheeseburgers with fries, the outing that finally wins Ronnie over
m.how: Shape 800g beef mince into 4 patties, grill and top with cheese. Build in 4 buns with pickles and sauce and serve with 1kg oven fries.

w.note: Little honey and spice cakes fit for a king of the realm
w.how: Melt 125g butter with 150g honey, mix in 2 eggs, 200g self-raising flour and 1 tsp mixed spice. Bake in 12 muffin holes at 175C for 18 minutes.

d.note: Fizzy citrus lemonade with ginger, the closest thing to a Minotaur without the crash
d.how: Mix the juice of 4 lemons and 2 limes with 4 tbsp sugar and a knob of grated ginger. Strain and top with 1L soda water over ice.

s.note: Crispy fish tacos with slaw and lime
s.how: Cut 500g white fish into strips, dip in a batter of 120g flour and 180ml cold beer and fry at 180C. Serve in 12 small tortillas with shredded cabbage, lime and chipotle mayo.

s.note: Corn chips with cheese, beans and jalapeños
s.how: Spread 300g corn chips on a tray, top with a tin of black beans and 200g grated cheese and bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Add jalapeños and salsa.

m.note: Roast beef and chicken avocado sandwiches
m.how: Spread 8 slices of bread with horseradish cream and fill with 250g roast beef and rocket. Fill 8 more with 250g shredded chicken, avocado and mayo. Cut into quarters.

w.note: Vanilla cupcakes with white buttercream for the big day
w.how: Beat 125g butter and 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes and top with 150g butter beaten with 300g icing sugar.

d.note: Cold lager at the gig, with ginger beer for the drivers
d.how: Chill 8 bottles of lager and serve with ginger beer for anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Pineapple, chilli and lime salsa with corn chips
s.how: Dice half a pineapple and mix with half a red onion, 1 chopped chilli, coriander and the juice of 2 limes. Serve with 230g corn chips.

s.note: Cheese puffs, pretzels and chocolate peanuts tipped into a big bowl, a couch snack
s.how: Tip 150g cheese puffs, 150g pretzels and 200g chocolate-coated peanuts into a big bowl. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Teriyaki chicken with charred pineapple and rice
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in 100ml teriyaki sauce for 30 minutes and grill. Grill 8 pineapple slices until charred. Serve over 300g steamed rice. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: Buttery cake over caramel and pineapple rings
w.how: Melt 60g butter with 100g brown sugar in a 23cm tin and lay over 8 pineapple rings. Beat 125g butter and 125g sugar, add 2 eggs, then 175g self-raising flour. Spread over and bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Turn out warm.

d.note: Pineapple juice, lime and soda over ice
d.how: Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice. Add 200ml pineapple juice and a squeeze of lime to each and top with soda water. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Corn chips with melted cheese and beans
s.how: Spread 300g corn chips on a tray, add a tin of refried beans and 200g grated cheese and bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Top with salsa.

s.note: Dill pickles beside vanilla ice cream
s.how: Slice 1 jar dill pickles into spears and serve on a plate beside 4 scoops of vanilla ice cream. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Green chicken curry with jasmine rice
m.how: Fry 3 tbsp green curry paste, add 400ml coconut milk and 800g sliced chicken thigh and simmer 15 minutes. Add 1 sliced capsicum, beans and basil. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.

w.note: Vanilla cupcakes with pastel buttercream for a baby shower
w.how: Beat 125g butter and 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes and ice with 150g butter beaten with 300g icing sugar and a drop of colouring.

d.note: Sparkling grape juice with lime and mint
d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 150ml grape juice and a squeeze of lime to each and top with soda water and mint. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Creamy egg salad on soft white bread
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and mash with 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp mustard, salt and pepper. Spread over 4 slices of bread, top with 4 more and cut into triangles.

s.note: Chips, salsa and peanuts for poker night
s.how: Tip 200g corn chips into a bowl with 1 jar salsa beside it and a bowl of 200g salted peanuts. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Roast chicken with vegetables, the family dinner at Trish's
m.how: Rub a 1.8kg chicken with butter, salt and lemon and roast at 200C for 1 hour 15 minutes. Roast 800g potatoes and 3 carrots alongside.

w.note: Rich chocolate truffles rolled in cocoa
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate into 120ml hot cream and chill until firm. Roll into 20 balls and dust in 30g cocoa. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.note: Ice-cold milk in a tall glass
d.how: Pour 1L cold full cream milk into 4 tall glasses. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.

s.note: Swiss cheese fondue with bread cubes
s.how: Rub a pot with garlic, heat 300ml white wine, then stir in 400g grated gruyère and emmental tossed in 1 tbsp cornflour until smooth. Serve with cubes of crusty bread.

s.note: Pizza dough rolls with pepperoni and cheese
s.how: Roll 500g pizza dough flat, spread with pizza sauce and top with 100g pepperoni and 150g mozzarella. Roll up, slice and bake at 200C for 18 minutes.

m.note: Beef and bean chilli with sour cream
m.how: Brown 800g beef mince with an onion and 2 tbsp chilli powder. Add 400g tomatoes and 2 tins kidney beans and simmer 40 minutes. Serve with sour cream and cheese.

w.note: Fudgy brownies dusted with icing sugar
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 180g butter, whisk in 300g sugar and 3 eggs, fold in 100g flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 170C for 28 minutes and dust with icing sugar.

d.note: A sharp citrus and ginger fizz, the closest thing to the energy drink that
d.how: Mix the juice of 3 lemons and 2 oranges with 3 tbsp sugar and grated ginger. Top with 1L soda water over ice. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Crinkle-cut fries with gravy for dipping
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen crinkle-cut chips at 220C for 25 minutes. Make 300ml gravy from powder and serve on the side for dipping. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Battered fried pickle spears with ranch
s.how: Pat dry 12 pickle spears, dip in a batter of 120g flour and 150ml cold beer and fry at 180C until golden. Serve with 150ml ranch.

m.note: Tiny beef patties steamed on onions with cheese
m.how: Press 600g beef mince thin across a lined tray and cut into 16 squares. Spread 2 finely diced onions in a hot pan with a splash of water, lay the patties on top, cover and steam 3 minutes. Add cheese and serve in 16 small soft buns with pickles.

w.note: Thick vanilla milkshakes, the only thing to finish a night like that
w.how: Blend 1L vanilla ice cream with 500ml cold milk until thick. Pour into 4 glasses. Serve it at the halfway point of the film. Leave it out for anyone who wants seconds.

d.note: Cold cola over ice with a wedge of lime
d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice, pour in cold cola and add a lime wedge. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Crisp vegetable spring rolls with sweet chilli
s.how: Fry 16 frozen vegetable spring rolls at 180C for 4 minutes until golden. Drain and serve with sweet chilli sauce. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Rainbow-coloured sweet popcorn, very out of this world
s.how: Pop 100g popcorn kernels. Melt 100g white chocolate, split into bowls with a drop of colouring each and drizzle over the popcorn. Set and break up.

m.note: Lemon chicken, beef and broccoli and fried rice
m.how: Crumb 600g chicken strips in cornflour and fry, then toss in 150ml lemon sauce. Stir-fry 400g sliced beef with 1 head broccoli, 3 tbsp oyster sauce and garlic. Fry 300g cooked rice with 2 eggs, peas and soy.

w.note: Crisp homemade fortune cookies with messages
w.how: Whisk 2 egg whites, 80g sugar, 50g melted butter, 60g flour and vanilla. Spread thin circles on a lined tray, bake at 180C for 6 minutes, then quickly fold each around a paper message.

d.note: Big cups of cold lemonade over ice
d.how: Fill 4 large cups with ice and pour in cold lemonade. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.

s.note: Fries smothered in beef chilli and cheese
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen chips. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 tbsp chilli powder and 200g tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes. Spoon over the chips and top with 100g cheese.

s.note: Fresh bread with butter and apple butter
s.how: Slice a fresh white loaf thickly. Serve with 100g soft butter and a jar of apple butter or apple sauce. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Chicken and egg noodles in broth over mash
m.how: Simmer 1kg chicken thighs in 1.5L stock for 30 minutes, shred and return. Add 300g thick egg noodles and cook 10 minutes. Serve over 800g mashed potatoes.

w.note: A sticky molasses pie with a crumb top, the classic Amish dessert
w.how: Rub 150g flour, 100g brown sugar and 60g butter into crumbs. Mix 150ml molasses, 1 egg, 1 tsp bicarb and 180ml hot water. Pour into a 23cm pastry case, top with crumbs and bake at 180C for 35 minutes.

d.note: Ice-cold full cream milk, straight from the farm
d.how: Pour 1L cold full cream milk into 4 glasses. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.

s.note: Cocktail franks wrapped in puff pastry, the snack at every rally
s.how: Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into strips and wrap 24 cocktail franks. Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Serve with sauce.

s.note: Crisp apple slices with peanut butter
s.how: Slice 4 red apples and serve with 200g peanut butter for dipping. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Salmon baked with lemon and dill
m.how: Lay 4 salmon fillets on foil with lemon slices, dill and butter, wrap and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Serve with 600g boiled potatoes.

w.note: Warm apple crumble with cream, a small-town fundraiser dessert
w.how: Toss 5 sliced apples with 60g sugar and cinnamon. Rub 100g butter into 120g flour, 60g oats and 100g brown sugar, scatter over and bake at 180C for 35 minutes.

d.note: Strong brewed coffee with milk, to get through the campaign
d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water in a plunger and serve with milk. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: School lunch box sandwiches, fruit and cheese
s.how: Make 4 ham and cheese sandwiches and cut into quarters. Pack with 4 cheese sticks, a cut apple and 4 small fruit cups. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Mini club sandwiches on toothpicks, the room service Billy grew up on
s.how: Toast 9 slices of bread and layer with 150g chicken, 4 rashers crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo. Cut into small squares with toothpicks. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Grilled hot dogs with all the toppings
m.how: Grill 8 frankfurts and put in 8 buns with mustard, sauce, onion and relish. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: Smooth chocolate pudding with whipped cream
w.how: Whisk 600ml milk, 80g sugar, 30g cocoa and 3 tbsp cornflour over heat until thick. Pour into 4 cups, chill 2 hours and top with cream.

d.note: Cold chocolate milk shaken up in a jar
d.how: Shake 1L cold milk with 6 tbsp drinking chocolate until mixed and pour into 4 glasses. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Golden cornmeal hush puppies with spring onion, fried crisp
s.how: Mix 200g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg, 250ml buttermilk and 2 spring onions. Fry spoonfuls at 180C for 3 minutes. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Prawns tossed in Cajun spice and butter, cooked hot and fast
s.how: Toss 600g peeled prawns with 2 tsp Cajun spice and cook in 50g butter with 2 garlic cloves for 3 minutes. Serve with lemon. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Chicken and smoked sausage gumbo over rice
m.how: Cook 80g flour in 80ml oil to a dark roux. Add onion, celery and capsicum, then 600g chicken thigh, 300g smoked sausage, 1.2L stock and Cajun spice and simmer 1 hour. Add 200g okra for 10 minutes and serve over 300g rice.

w.note: Creamy Louisiana pecan pralines, set on baking paper
w.how: Boil 200g brown sugar, 100g caster sugar, 120ml cream and 40g butter to 115C. Stir in 150g pecans and vanilla, beat until thick and spoon onto baking paper.

d.note: Ice-cold water with lemon and cucumber
d.how: Fill a big jug with ice, 1.5L cold water, lemon slices and cucumber ribbons. Serve in tall glasses. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Cheese, crackers and pickled onions on a plate, the snack plate at Grandma's
s.how: Arrange 250g cheddar, 200g crackers and a jar of pickled onions on a plate. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Pizza dough rolls with pepperoni and cheese
s.how: Roll 500g pizza dough, spread with sauce, top with 100g pepperoni and 150g mozzarella, roll up, slice and bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Glazed meatloaf with mash and peas
m.how: Mix 800g beef mince, 1 onion, 1 egg and 60g breadcrumbs, shape a loaf, glaze with 100ml tomato sauce and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Serve with 800g mashed potatoes and peas.

w.note: Little cinnamon tea cakes, the kind Grandma has with her afternoon tea
w.how: Beat 100g butter and 120g sugar, add 2 eggs, then 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Bake in 12 muffin holes at 180C for 18 minutes, brush with butter and roll in cinnamon sugar.

d.note: A pot of black tea with milk
d.how: Warm a teapot, add 4 tsp black tea and 1L boiling water and brew 4 minutes. Serve with milk and sugar. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Classic devilled eggs dusted with paprika, a sixties cocktail party must
s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, halve and mash the yolks with 4 tbsp mayonnaise and 1 tsp mustard. Pipe back in and dust with paprika.

s.note: Cheese and pineapple cubes on toothpicks stuck into half a rockmelon, very sixties
s.how: Cube 250g cheddar and half a pineapple and thread onto toothpicks. Stick them into half a rockmelon for a hedgehog. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.n: Dr. Evil's one million dollar steak
m.note: Steak with creamy mushroom brandy sauce
m.how: Sear 4 thin sirloin steaks for 2 minutes a side and rest. Fry 200g mushrooms and a shallot, add 40ml brandy, 1 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tsp Dijon and 150ml cream and reduce. Pour over the steaks with fries.

w.note: Layered sponge, custard, berries and cream
w.how: Layer 1 sponge cake spread with jam, 500ml custard, 250g raspberries and blueberries and 300ml whipped cream in a glass bowl. Chill 2 hours. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.note: Gin and dry vermouth with an olive
d.how: Stir 60ml gin and 10ml dry vermouth with ice and strain into 4 chilled glasses with an olive each. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Crisp spiced potato and pea samosas
s.how: Mix 400g mashed potato with 100g peas, 2 tsp curry powder and coriander. Fill 16 spring roll wrapper triangles and fry at 180C until golden.

s.note: Toasted rice crackers with sesame and honey
s.how: Spread 200g rice crackers on a tray, brush with honey, sprinkle with sesame and bake at 180C for 5 minutes. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Chilli lemon grilled chicken with flatbread
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in lemon, garlic, chilli and oil for 1 hour and grill. Serve with 4 flatbreads and a salad of 3 tomatoes, 1 red onion and coriander.

w.note: Little coconut and cardamom doughnuts dusted with sugar
w.how: Mix 300g self-raising flour, 60g sugar, 1 tsp cardamom and 250ml coconut milk into a dough. Cut into triangles and fry at 175C until golden. Dust with sugar.

d.note: Passionfruit, lime and soda over ice
d.how: Spoon the pulp of 6 passionfruit into a jug with the juice of 2 limes and 3 tbsp sugar. Top with 1L soda water and serve over ice.

s.note: Warm homemade cinnamon sugar doughnut holes, a tribute to the doughnut shop Wayne and
s.how: Mix 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 egg, 150ml milk and 30g melted butter into a soft dough. Roll into 24 balls and fry at 175C for 3 minutes. Toss in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon.

s.note: Grilled corn with butter, chilli and salt
s.how: Grill 4 corn cobs until charred, brush with 40g melted butter and sprinkle with chilli and salt. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: A big pepperoni pizza, the basement studio dinner
m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough onto a tray, spread with pizza sauce and top with 200g mozzarella and 100g pepperoni. Bake at 240C for 12 minutes.

w.note: Vanilla ice cream between chocolate cookies
w.how: Sandwich 1L vanilla ice cream between 16 soft chocolate cookies and freeze 30 minutes. Serve it at the halfway point of the film. Leave it out for anyone who wants seconds.

d.note: Cold lemonade in big plastic cups
d.how: Pour cold lemonade over ice in 4 big cups. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.

s.note: Potato and cheese pierogi with onions
s.how: Boil 20 frozen pierogi, drain and pan-fry in 40g butter with 2 sliced onions until golden. Serve with 150g sour cream. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Warm honey and butter roasted peanuts
s.how: Toss 400g raw peanuts with 3 tbsp honey, 20g melted butter and 1 tsp salt. Roast at 170C for 15 minutes, stirring twice, then cool on the tray so they crisp up.

m.note: Hot dogs with spicy brown mustard
m.how: Grill 8 frankfurts and serve in 8 buns with spicy brown mustard and diced onion. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: Lattice cherry pie with ice cream
w.how: Toss 800g pitted cherries with 120g sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour. Fill a 23cm pastry case, top with a lattice and bake at 190C for 45 minutes. Serve with ice cream.

d.n: A shot of rum for Jobu
d.note: Dark rum shots, one poured for Jobu
d.how: Pour 30ml dark rum into 4 small glasses, plus one for Jobu. Cola for anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Big platter of cut tropical fruit
s.how: Cut 1 pineapple, 2 mangoes, 1 rockmelon and 250g strawberries and arrange on a platter. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Chicken sliders with slaw and pickles for the tour bus
s.how: Crumb 600g chicken strips and fry until golden. Put in 12 slider buns with coleslaw and pickles. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Fish tacos with mango salsa, a laid-back LA reunion dinner
m.how: Grill 600g white fish with chilli and lime and flake. Serve in 12 tortillas with salsa of 1 mango, red onion and coriander. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: Round iced sugar cookies like records
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 100g icing sugar, add 1 egg yolk and 300g flour. Roll, cut 16 circles and bake at 170C for 12 minutes. Ice with grey icing and a small dot in the middle.

d.note: Sparkling water with cucumber, mint and lime
d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice, cucumber, mint and lime and top with sparkling water. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Jerky, nuts and cheese for the mission
s.how: Arrange 150g beef jerky, 200g mixed nuts and 200g cheddar on a board. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Celery sticks with blue cheese dip
s.how: Cut 1 bunch celery into sticks. Mix 100g blue cheese with 150g sour cream for the dip. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Grilled rib eye with onion rings
m.how: Season 4 rib eye steaks and grill 4 minutes a side. Serve with 500g frozen onion rings baked crisp. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: Rich chocolate pots that set fast in the fridge
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate into 300ml hot cream with 2 tbsp sugar. Pour into 4 cups and chill 2 hours. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.note: Cold lager straight from the bottle
d.how: Chill 8 bottles of lager and serve. Ginger beer for anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Ham and gruyère toasties with béchamel
s.how: Make a béchamel from 20g butter, 1 tbsp flour and 200ml milk. Fill 4 sandwiches with 150g ham and gruyère, top with béchamel and more cheese and grill.

s.note: Fried flatbread with garlic, sour cream and cheese
s.how: Divide 500g pizza dough into 4 and stretch thin. Fry at 180C until puffed and golden. Brush with garlic oil and top with 150g sour cream and 100g grated cheese.

m.note: Spaghetti with pecorino and black pepper
m.how: Cook 400g spaghetti. Toast 2 tsp cracked pepper, add a ladle of pasta water and the pasta, then toss with 120g grated pecorino until glossy.

w.note: A chocolate sheet cake for the office, cut into squares
w.how: Mix 300g self-raising flour, 300g sugar, 60g cocoa, 2 eggs, 250ml milk and 125g melted butter. Bake in a tray at 175C for 35 minutes and ice with chocolate icing.

d.note: Aperitivo spritz with orange, or orange soda for the kids
d.how: Fill 4 wine glasses with ice, add 60ml aperitivo, 90ml prosecco and a splash of soda and an orange slice. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Creamy New England clam chowder in little cups
s.how: Fry 3 rashers bacon and 1 onion, add 2 potatoes and 500ml fish stock and simmer. Add 400g clams and 200ml cream and cook 5 minutes.

s.note: Hot wings with ranch, the bar snack after the case
s.how: Bake 1.2kg wings tossed in baking powder and salt at 220C for 45 minutes. Toss in hot sauce and butter and serve with ranch. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Roast beef with potatoes and gravy
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg beef topside at 200C for 1 hour. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside. Make gravy from the pan juices with 300ml stock. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: Sponge with custard and chocolate glaze
w.how: Bake a 20cm sponge and split. Fill with 400ml thick custard and top with 100g chocolate melted with 80ml cream. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.note: Cold pint of lager for movie night, made for four
d.how: Pour 4 pints of cold lager. Cranberry juice for anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.

s.note: Loaded nachos with beef and cheese
s.how: Brown 400g beef mince with taco seasoning. Spread 300g corn chips, top with beef and 200g cheese, bake 10 minutes and finish with sour cream.

s.note: Soft jam-filled doughnuts rolled in sugar
s.how: Warm 8 jam doughnuts in a low oven for 3 minutes and roll in 100g caster sugar. Serve with 150g extra raspberry jam on the side for dunking.

m.note: Bacon cheeseburgers with fries, an after work feed
m.how: Grill 4 beef patties with cheese and serve in buns with bacon, lettuce and sauce, plus 1kg oven fries. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: Dark chocolate squares with sea salt
w.how: Break 200g dark chocolate into squares and sprinkle with sea salt flakes. Serve it at the halfway point of the film. Leave it out for anyone who wants seconds.

d.note: Cold lager in schooners for movie night, made for four
d.how: Pour 8 cold bottles of lager into schooners. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.

s.note: Golden crab cakes with lemon and tartare
s.how: Mix 400g crab meat, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 egg and 60g breadcrumbs. Shape 12 cakes and pan-fry 3 minutes a side. Serve with lemon and tartare.

s.note: Sticky barbecue wings for the frat house
s.how: Bake 1.2kg wings at 220C for 45 minutes and toss in 200ml barbecue sauce. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Grilled fish tacos with lime and salsa
m.how: Grill 600g white fish with chilli and lime, flake into 12 tortillas with cabbage, salsa and lime. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: Giant chocolate chip cookies for movie night, made for four
w.how: Beat 125g butter and 150g brown sugar, add 1 egg, 200g flour and 150g chocolate chips. Bake 8 big cookies at 180C for 13 minutes.

d.note: Tequila, lime and triple sec over ice
d.how: Shake 45ml tequila, 30ml lime and 15ml triple sec with ice for each glass and pour over ice. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Sausage rolls with tomato sauce for the party
s.how: Mix 500g sausage mince with 1 grated onion, roll in 2 sheets puff pastry, slice and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Cheese, crackers and grapes, a quiet night in for new parents
s.how: Arrange 150g brie, 150g cheddar, 200g crackers and a bunch of grapes on a board. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Grilled sausages and steak with salad
m.how: Grill 8 sausages and 4 steaks. Serve with a bag of salad and bread rolls. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: Vanilla sheet cake with sprinkles for movie night, made for four
w.how: Bake a vanilla sheet cake from 300g self-raising flour, 250g sugar, 3 eggs, 200ml milk and 150g butter at 175C for 35 minutes. Ice and add sprinkles.

d.note: Fruit punch with lemonade and orange slices
d.how: Mix 1L tropical juice with 1L lemonade and orange slices over ice. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.

s.note: Bruschetta with tomato and basil, the fancy party food before it all goes wrong
s.how: Toast slices of baguette, rub with garlic and top with 4 diced tomatoes, basil and olive oil. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Crackers, cheese and pretzels shared out
s.how: Portion 200g crackers, 150g cheddar and 150g pretzels into equal piles for everyone. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Spaghetti with tomato, garlic and chilli
m.how: Fry 3 garlic cloves and chilli in oil, add 800g tinned tomatoes and simmer 20 minutes. Toss with 400g spaghetti and parmesan. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: Homemade chocolate nougat and caramel bars
w.how: Melt 200g marshmallows with 40g butter, press into a tin, top with 380g tinned caramel and chill. Cover with 200g melted milk chocolate and cut into bars.

d.note: Cold water in a jug with lemon, every drop shared
d.how: Fill a jug with ice, water and lemon slices and share it out. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Huge bowl of mixed chips and puffs
s.how: Tip 200g corn chips, 150g pretzels and 150g cheese puffs into a huge bowl. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Seasoned fries with chicken salt for movie night, made for four
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes and toss with chicken salt. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Fresh salad bowl with grilled chicken
m.how: Grill 600g chicken breast and slice. Toss with salad leaves, 2 tomatoes, 1 cucumber and avocado and dress with oil and lemon. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: Blue-iced vanilla cupcakes for movie night, made for four
w.how: Bake 12 vanilla cupcakes and ice with buttercream tinted blue. Serve it at the halfway point of the film. Leave it out for anyone who wants seconds.

d.note: Homemade electrolyte drink with citrus and salt
d.how: Mix the juice of 3 oranges and 2 lemons with 3 tbsp honey, a pinch of salt and 1L cold water. Serve over ice. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Garlic knots with butter and parmesan
s.how: Cut 500g pizza dough into 12 strips, tie into knots and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Brush with garlic butter and parmesan. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Little cheese and tomato pinwheels, sweet and simple like Deeds's poems
s.how: Spread 2 sheets puff pastry with tomato paste and cheese, roll, slice and bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: A classic pepperoni and mushroom pizza, made by the man himself
m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough, spread with sauce and top with 200g mozzarella, 100g pepperoni and 100g mushrooms. Bake at 240C for 12 minutes. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: Baked New York cheesecake with a biscuit base
w.how: Press 200g crushed biscuits and 80g butter into a tin. Beat 750g cream cheese, 200g sugar and 3 eggs, pour over and bake at 160C for 55 minutes. Chill overnight.

d.note: Cold cola with ice for movie night, made for four
d.how: Pour cold cola over ice in 4 glasses. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.

s.note: Buttery popcorn for the birthday party
s.how: Pop 120g popcorn kernels and toss with 50g butter and salt. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table. Put it out before the opening credits so everyone can graze.

s.note: Crisp fries with gravy for movie night, made for four
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen chips and serve with 300ml gravy made from powder. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Bacon, eggs and sausages on toast
m.how: Fry 8 rashers bacon and 8 sausages, then 4 eggs. Serve on buttered toast. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: One giant pancake with butter and syrup
w.how: Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 eggs and 400ml milk. Pour half into a large buttered frying pan, cook until bubbles appear, flip with a plate and cook through. Repeat. Serve with butter and 200ml maple syrup.

d.note: Cold milk to wash down the pancake
d.how: Pour 1L cold full cream milk into 4 glasses. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.

s.note: Crumbed fish bites with lemon, from a day on the lake
s.how: Cut 500g white fish into bites, crumb and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Serve with lemon and tartare. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Toasted marshmallows and chocolate between biscuits
s.how: Toast 16 marshmallows on skewers until golden. Sandwich each with a square of milk chocolate between 2 plain biscuits and squash together. Serve while the chocolate is melting.

m.note: A huge rump steak to share with all the trimmings
m.how: Season a 1.5kg rump steak and grill 6 minutes a side, then rest 10 minutes. Slice and serve with 1kg roast potatoes, salad and bread.

w.note: Blueberry pie with ice cream for movie night, made for four
w.how: Toss 800g blueberries with 120g sugar and cornflour, fill a pastry case, top and bake at 190C for 45 minutes. Serve with ice cream. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.note: Cold beer on the dock for movie night, made for four
d.how: Chill 8 bottles of lager and serve. Lemonade for the kids. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.

s.note: Army crackers with cheese spread for movie night, made for four
s.how: Serve 200g crackers with 200g cheese spread. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table. Put it out before the opening credits so everyone can graze.

s.note: Cocktail franks with mustard and sauce
s.how: Simmer 24 cocktail franks in water for 5 minutes and drain. Serve on toothpicks with mustard and tomato sauce for dipping. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Meatloaf with mash and gravy, mess hall style
m.how: Mix 800g beef mince, onion, egg and breadcrumbs, bake at 180C for 1 hour and serve with mash and gravy. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: Chocolate cake with icing for movie night, made for four
w.how: Bake a chocolate cake from 300g self-raising flour, 300g sugar, 60g cocoa, 2 eggs, 250ml milk and 125g butter at 175C for 40 minutes. Ice and serve.

d.note: Strong black coffee for movie night, made for four
d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee in 1L water and serve black. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.

s.note: Prawns with bloody mary cocktail sauce
s.how: Mix 150ml tomato juice reduced to thick with horseradish, Worcestershire, celery salt and lemon. Serve with 500g cooked prawns. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Crumbed fish bites with lemon and tartare
s.how: Cut 500g white fish into bites, roll in flour, egg and 100g panko and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Serve with lemon and 150g tartare.

m.n: Steak sandwich and a steak sandwich
m.note: Steak sandwiches with fried onions and mustard
m.how: Pan-fry 4 thin rump steaks for 2 minutes a side. Fry 2 sliced onions. Serve on toasted bread with mustard and lettuce. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: Vanilla sundaes with hot fudge for movie night, made for four
w.how: Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream and pour over hot fudge sauce. Serve it at the halfway point of the film. Leave it out for anyone who wants seconds.

d.note: Vodka, tomato juice, lemon, Worcestershire and celery salt with a celery stick
d.how: Mix 45ml vodka, 150ml tomato juice, lemon, Worcestershire and celery salt for each glass over ice. Virgin for the kids. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Crumbed ham croquettes with a creamy centre
s.how: Make a thick béchamel with 60g butter, 80g flour and 500ml milk, stir in 200g ham and chill. Shape, crumb and fry at 180C. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Cheese fondue with bread, the Focker welcome
s.how: Heat 300ml white wine, stir in 400g gruyère tossed in cornflour until smooth. Serve with bread cubes. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Mojo roast pork with black beans and rice
m.how: Marinate 1.5kg pork shoulder in orange, lime, garlic and cumin and roast at 160C for 3 hours. Serve with black beans and 300g rice. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: Tangy key lime pie with a biscuit base and cream
w.how: Press 200g crushed biscuits and 80g butter into a dish. Whisk 395g condensed milk, 4 yolks and 120ml lime juice, pour in and bake at 160C for 15 minutes. Chill and top with cream.

d.note: White rum, lime, mint and soda
d.how: Muddle mint and lime with sugar, add 45ml white rum and ice, top with soda. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Thick-cut back bacon on soft buns with mustard
s.how: Fry 8 thick slices of back bacon until golden and serve in 8 soft buns with mustard. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Light twisted crullers with honey glaze
s.how: Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g flour, cool and beat in 3 eggs. Pipe rings onto baking paper and fry at 180C until golden. Dip in 150g icing sugar mixed with 2 tbsp honey and water.

m.note: Fries with cheese curds and gravy
m.how: Bake 1kg frozen chips, top with 250g cubed haloumi or curds and pour over 400ml hot gravy. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: Gooey maple and brown sugar tarts
w.how: Mix 100g brown sugar, 80ml maple syrup, 60g butter and 1 egg. Fill 12 small pastry cases and bake at 190C for 15 minutes. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.note: Cold Canadian lager by the stubby
d.how: Chill 8 stubbies of lager and serve. Ginger ale for anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.

s.note: Hot buttery wings with blue cheese dip
s.how: Toss 1.2kg chicken wings with 2 tsp baking powder and salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once. Toss in 100ml hot sauce melted with 50g butter. Serve with 100g blue cheese stirred into 150g sour cream.

s.note: Pretzels, peanuts and cheese crackers in a box
s.how: Tip 150g pretzels, 200g salted peanuts and 150g cheese crackers into a big box or bowl and toss together. Serve straight away on the coffee table before the film starts.

m.note: Beef patty melt on rye with Swiss cheese and onions
m.how: Slowly fry 3 sliced onions in 30g butter for 20 minutes. Shape 600g beef mince into 4 thin oval patties and cook 3 minutes a side. Layer each on buttered rye with Swiss cheese and onions and fry until golden and melted.

w.note: Vanilla sundaes with hot fudge, peanuts and cherries
w.how: Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream into 4 bowls. Pour over warm chocolate topping, scatter with 50g chopped peanuts and top each with a cherry. Serve straight away.

d.note: Ice-cold lager, lemonade for the kids
d.how: Chill 8 bottles of lager in an esky full of ice for an hour. Serve in the bottle with cold lemonade for anyone not drinking. Keep a second round ready for the back half.

s.note: Salted nuts, beef jerky and mints from the glovebox
s.how: Tip 200g salted mixed nuts and 100g beef jerky into a big bowl and toss together. Put a small bowl of 100g mints beside it and set both out before the opening credits.

s.note: Crisp fries with chicken salt and gravy
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once, and toss with chicken salt. Whisk gravy powder into 300ml boiling water until smooth and serve on the side for dipping.

m.note: Big pepperoni pizza eaten from the box
m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough onto a large oiled tray, spread with pizza sauce and top with 200g grated mozzarella and 100g sliced pepperoni. Bake at 240C for 12 minutes until the base is crisp.

w.note: Big homemade chocolate chip cookies like the Crock fortune
w.how: Beat 125g soft butter with 150g brown sugar, add 1 egg, then mix in 220g self-raising flour and 150g chocolate chips. Roll 12 balls, flatten slightly and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden at the edges.

d.note: Ice-cold milk in tall glasses for dunking
d.how: Chill 1L full cream milk until very cold and pour into 4 tall glasses. Serve with the cookies so everyone can dunk, and keep the rest of the bottle in the fridge for refills.

s.note: Liverwurst sandwiches with cold buttermilk at midnight
s.how: Butter 8 slices of white bread and fill with 150g sliced liverwurst and 100g sliced cheddar. Cut into fingers and serve with 4 small glasses of cold buttermilk, just like the late-night kitchen scene.

s.note: Warm cheddar choux puffs for the lodge
s.how: Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g plain flour until it forms a ball, then cool. Beat in 4 eggs one at a time and 120g grated cheddar. Pipe small balls and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

m.note: Roast turkey breast with sage stuffing and cranberry
m.how: Rub a 1.5kg turkey breast with butter and herbs and roast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Bake stuffing made from 150g breadcrumbs, a diced onion, chopped sage and melted butter. Serve with cranberry sauce and 1kg roast potatoes.

w.note: White coconut cake covered like fresh snow
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs, then 250g self-raising flour, 60g coconut and 150ml coconut milk. Bake in two tins at 175C for 28 minutes. Cover with 250g cream cheese beaten with 200g icing sugar and roll in the rest of the coconut.

d.note: Spiced eggnog with nutmeg and brandy on the side
d.how: Whisk 4 egg yolks with 100g sugar. Heat 600ml milk, 200ml cream and a cinnamon stick until steaming, whisk into the yolks and stir over low heat until it coats a spoon. Chill and serve with grated nutmeg and brandy on the side.

s.note: Heart-shaped cheese and tomato toasts grilled until bubbling, for the inn's Valentine's night on
s.how: Cut 8 slices of bread into hearts with a cutter or knife. Top each with a thin slice of tomato and 150g grated cheese shared between them, then grill for 4 minutes until bubbling and golden.

s.note: Grilled corn with butter and smoked paprika
s.how: Grill 4 corn cobs over high heat for 10 minutes, turning, until charred in spots. Brush with 40g melted butter, sprinkle with smoked paprika and salt and cut each cob in half to share.

m.note: Roast turkey with mash, gravy and green beans
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg turkey breast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes and rest. Boil 800g potatoes and mash with 40g butter. Make gravy from the pan juices and powder and steam 300g green beans.

w.note: Christmas pudding with warm brandy custard
w.how: Heat an 800g Christmas pudding as the pack directs. Warm 500ml custard gently in a saucepan, stir in 2 tbsp brandy and pour over thick slices of pudding at the table.

d.note: Warm spiced apple juice with cinnamon and cloves
d.how: Pour 1.2L apple juice into a saucepan with 2 cinnamon sticks, 4 cloves and the peel of an orange. Heat gently for 15 minutes without boiling and ladle into mugs.

s.note: Iced Christmas sugar cookies in stars and trees
s.how: Beat 200g butter and 100g icing sugar, add 1 egg yolk and 300g plain flour and chill. Roll out, cut stars and trees and bake at 170C for 12 minutes. Ice with 250g icing sugar tinted red and green.

s.note: Herby cheese ball rolled in walnuts with crackers
s.how: Mix 250g cream cheese with 100g grated cheddar and a handful of snipped chives. Shape into a ball, roll in 50g chopped walnuts and parsley and chill. Serve with 200g crackers.

m.note: Golden roast chicken with potatoes and carrots
m.how: Rub a whole chicken with 40g butter and thyme and roast at 200C for 1 hour 15 minutes. Add 800g halved potatoes and 3 carrots to the tray for the last 50 minutes and rest before carving.

w.note: Fudgy brownies topped with crushed candy canes
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 180g butter, beat in 300g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 170C for 28 minutes, cool and scatter with 4 crushed candy canes.

d.note: Rich hot chocolate with cream and candy canes
d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming, whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate and 2 tbsp sugar until smooth. Pour into 4 mugs, top with whipped cream and hang a candy cane on each.

s.note: Chicago-style hot dogs with all the toppings
s.how: Grill 8 frankfurts until blistered and tuck into 8 soft buns. Top each with mustard, relish, diced onion, tomato wedges and a dill pickle spear, and serve on a big platter.

s.note: Little gingerbread men with white icing
s.how: Melt 100g butter with 100g golden syrup and 80g brown sugar, then mix in 300g self-raising flour and 2 tsp ginger. Roll, cut out men and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Pipe on icing once cool.

m.note: Glazed ham with honey and mustard, the centrepiece for a family that finally sits
m.how: Score the skin of a 2kg half ham in diamonds. Brush with 100g honey mixed with 2 tbsp Dijon and 50g brown sugar and bake at 180C for 45 minutes, glazing every 15 minutes.

w.note: Choc chip cookies with a glass of cold milk
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 200g flour and 150g chocolate chips. Roll 16 balls and bake at 180C for 11 minutes. Serve with cold milk.

d.note: Hot chocolate with marshmallows on top
d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming and whisk in 150g chopped milk chocolate until smooth. Pour into 4 mugs and float a handful of marshmallows on top of each.

s.note: Snowman-shaped cheese ball with olive buttons
s.how: Mix 400g cream cheese with 150g grated mozzarella and shape into two balls stacked like a snowman. Press in olive buttons and eyes and a little carrot nose. Serve with 200g crackers.

s.note: Cold prawns on ice with cocktail sauce
s.how: Pile 500g cooked prawns on a platter of ice. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 2 tbsp tomato sauce and a squeeze of lemon for the cocktail sauce and serve with lemon wedges.

m.note: Smoked ham with a sticky honey glaze
m.how: Score a 2kg smoked ham and brush with a glaze of 100g honey, 50g brown sugar and 2 tbsp Dijon. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes, glazing every 15 minutes until sticky and dark.

w.note: Sponge, jelly, custard and cream in a big bowl
w.how: Make raspberry jelly and let it half set. Tear a sponge cake into a glass bowl, pour over the jelly and chill until firm. Top with 500ml custard and 300ml whipped cream.

d.note: Cranberry and orange punch with lemonade
d.how: Mix 1L cranberry juice and 500ml orange juice in a jug with orange slices. Top with 500ml lemonade just before serving and pour over plenty of ice.

s.note: Mini bagels with cream cheese and smoked salmon
s.how: Split and toast 8 mini bagels. Spread with 200g cream cheese, top with 150g smoked salmon, capers and thin red onion and serve on a board.

s.note: Hot buffalo wings with ranch for dipping
s.how: Bake 1.2kg chicken wings at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Melt 50g butter into 100ml hot sauce and toss the wings through. Serve with 150ml ranch and celery sticks.

m.note: Beef sliders with mac and cheese cups
m.how: Shape 500g beef mince into 12 small patties and cook with cheese slices. Serve in slider buns with pickles. Bake 250g macaroni in a cheese sauce of 200g tasty cheese and 400ml milk in muffin tins at 190C for 15 minutes.

w.note: Soft gingerbread cake with lemon icing
w.how: Melt 125g butter with 150g golden syrup and 100g brown sugar. Mix in 250g self-raising flour, 2 tsp ginger, 1 egg and 150ml milk. Bake at 170C for 40 minutes and ice with 150g icing sugar and lemon juice.

d.note: Warm spiced red wine with orange
d.how: Heat 750ml red wine with orange slices, 2 cinnamon sticks, 4 cloves and 3 tbsp sugar for 15 minutes without boiling. Ladle into mugs and have sparkling apple juice ready for anyone not drinking.

s.note: Golden sausage rolls with tomato sauce
s.how: Mix 500g sausage mince with 1 grated onion and roll in 2 sheets puff pastry. Brush with milk, cut into short lengths and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with tomato sauce.

s.note: Brie, cheddar, crackers and grapes on a board
s.how: Arrange 150g brie and 150g cheddar on a big board with 200g crackers and 500g grapes. Let the cheese come to room temperature for 30 minutes before the party starts.

m.note: Little beef sliders with cheese and pickles
m.how: Shape 500g beef mince into 12 small patties and season well. Cook on a hot grill for 2 minutes a side, add cheese to melt and serve in 12 slider buns with pickles and sauce.

w.note: Vanilla cupcakes with red and green buttercream
w.how: Beat 125g butter and 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar, tint half red and half green and pipe on.

d.note: Chilled eggnog with nutmeg and rum on the side
d.how: Whisk 4 egg yolks with 100g sugar. Pour in 800ml hot milk and stir over low heat until it coats a spoon. Chill well and serve with grated nutmeg and rum on the side.

s.note: Bright green spinach and herb dip
s.how: Thaw and squeeze 150g frozen spinach. Blitz with 250g cream cheese, a handful of parsley and lemon juice until smooth and green. Serve with 200g crackers.

s.note: Grilled cheese and spring onion toasts
s.how: Top 8 slices of bread with 150g grated cheese and thinly sliced spring onion. Grill for 4 minutes until bubbling and golden, then cut into triangles.

m.note: Roast beef with crisp roast potatoes
m.how: Season a 1.5kg beef topside and roast at 200C for 1 hour with 1kg potatoes around it. Rest for 15 minutes, make gravy with the pan juices and 300ml stock and carve at the table.

w.note: Christmas pudding with warm custard, the Who pudding the whole town sits down to
w.how: Heat an 800g Christmas pudding as the pack says. Warm 500ml custard in a saucepan and pour over thick slices at the table. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.note: Strong coffee with frothy milk, hot chocolate for the kids
d.how: Brew 1L strong coffee. Heat and froth 400ml milk and spoon on top of each mug. Make hot chocolate with the drinking chocolate for anyone who wants it instead.

s.note: Little sausage rolls for the Christmas ball
s.how: Mix 500g sausage mince with 1 grated onion and roll in 2 sheets puff pastry. Cut into small pieces, brush with milk and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

s.note: Roasted chestnuts with sea salt, the street snack sold on every London corner at
s.how: Cut a cross in the flat side of 500g chestnuts. Roast at 200C for 25 minutes until the skins curl back, wrap in a tea towel for 5 minutes and peel while warm.

m.note: Roast turkey with sage stuffing and apple sauce
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg turkey breast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Bake stuffing of 150g breadcrumbs, diced onion, chopped sage and melted butter. Serve with apple sauce and gravy.

w.note: Christmas pudding set alight with brandy
w.how: Heat an 800g Christmas pudding and turn it onto a plate. Warm 60ml brandy, pour over, light carefully and let the flames die. Serve with warm custard.

d.note: Warm spiced port punch with oranges
